What services does Provenir offer to fintech companies?

Provenir offers a comprehensive AI-Powered Risk Decisioning Platform that enables fintech companies to make faster and smarter decisions. How does Provenir's AI-Powered Risk Decisioning Platform work?

Provenir's platform integrates data from multiple sources, applies advanced AI algorithms, and delivers real-time decisioning capabilities. This process allows financial institutions to assess risk more accurately and efficiently. The platform's flexibility enables users to customize their decisioning criteria, ensuring that they can adapt to changing market conditions and regulatory requirements while maintaining a competitive edge.

Which industries does Provenir support?

Provenir primarily supports the fintech and financial services industries. Our solutions cater to a wide range of sectors including commercial lending, retail financing, auto financing, and small to medium enterprise (SME) lending. We also assist businesses with merchant onboarding and point-of-sale (POS) lending, providing tailored risk decisioning solutions that meet the specific needs of each industry.

Can Provenir's platform be integrated with existing systems?

Yes, Provenir's platform is designed with integration in mind. Utilizing microservices architecture, it can seamlessly connect with existing systems and data sources, allowing financial institutions to enhance their current operations without overhauling their entire infrastructure. This flexibility ensures that clients can leverage their existing investments while benefiting from our advanced risk decisioning capabilities.

What advantages does Provenir offer for risk analytics?

Provenir provides advanced risk analytics that empower financial institutions to make informed decisions quickly. Our platform utilizes machine learning and AI to analyze vast amounts of data, identifying patterns and trends that traditional methods may overlook. This results in more accurate risk assessments, reduced default rates, and improved profitability. Additionally, our real-time decisioning capabilities allow clients to respond swiftly to market changes and customer needs.

Is Provenir suitable for startups in the fintech space?

Absolutely! Provenir's solutions are particularly beneficial for startups in the fintech space, as they provide the agility and scalability needed to grow. Our platform allows startups to quickly implement risk decisioning processes without the need for extensive resources or time-consuming development. With Provenir, fintech startups can focus on innovation and customer acquisition while relying on our robust technology to manage risk effectively.

About GEODATA S.p.a.
--------------------

GEODATA is a multi-disciplinary company with an Italian origin and a global footprint, specialized in providing high-quality consultancy services and solutions for the development of underground infrastructures.  
  
GEODATA has designed for public and private clients:  
\- 3.700 projects involving  
\- 4.000 km of tunnels  
on 5 continents over the last 37 years.  
  
Many of them are large and complex projects involving difficult and complex conditions.  
Thanks to our clients and to the large number of projects undertaken, GEODATA is now recognized internationally as a provider of innovative underground solutions to meet modern needs in five market sectors:  
Metro, Rail, Road, Hydro and Earth.

.

What types of consultancy services does GEODATA offer for underground infrastructure projects?

GEODATA provides a comprehensive range of consultancy services tailored for underground infrastructure projects. These include geological assessments, tunneling design and analysis, civil engineering solutions, and project management. Our expertise extends to various sectors such as metro systems, railways, and hydro projects, ensuring that we can meet the specific needs of each project while adhering to international standards.

How does GEODATA incorporate BIM (Building Information Modeling) into its projects?

At GEODATA, we leverage Building Information Modeling (BIM) to enhance the planning, design, and construction processes of underground infrastructures. BIM allows us to create detailed 3D models that facilitate better visualization, coordination, and collaboration among stakeholders. This technology helps in identifying potential issues early in the project lifecycle, improving efficiency, reducing costs, and ensuring that projects are completed on time.

Which industries does GEODATA serve with its infrastructure solutions?

GEODATA serves a diverse range of industries, including transportation (metro and railway), civil engineering, hydroelectric power, and urban development. Our multidisciplinary approach enables us to provide specialized solutions that cater to the unique challenges of each sector, ensuring the successful development and maintenance of underground infrastructures.

Can GEODATA assist with the design and implementation of metro systems?

Yes, GEODATA has extensive experience in the design and implementation of metro systems. Our team of experts is skilled in all aspects of metro infrastructure, including tunneling, station design, and system integration. We work closely with clients to develop tailored solutions that address the specific requirements of each metro project, ensuring safety, efficiency, and sustainability.

What is GEODATA's approach to sustainability in infrastructure development?

Sustainability is a core principle at GEODATA. We prioritize environmentally friendly practices in all our projects, from the initial design phase through to construction and operation. Our team conducts thorough environmental impact assessments and employs innovative technologies to minimize the ecological footprint of our infrastructure solutions. We aim to create sustainable underground infrastructures that benefit both current and future generations.

How can I get in touch with GEODATA for a consultation or project inquiry?

To get in touch with GEODATA for a consultation or project inquiry, you can visit our website at http://www.geodata.it/ and fill out the contact form. Alternatively, you can reach us via email or phone, both of which are listed on our website. Our team will be happy to discuss your project needs and provide you with the necessary information and support.

About Argos Energies
--------------------

On 1 September 2015, we accomplished the merger between Argos and VARO Energy. As communicated then, both companies and its subsidiaries are integrated into one enlarged VARO Energy Group.  
  
Who we are?  
VARO Energy is an integrated oil refiner and supplier serving North West Europe, safely and efficiently. Our company comprises three core business areas:  
  
Refining, Storage & Logistics, and Distribution & Sales.  
  
In essence, we source crude oil for our refineries in Bavaria, Germany, and Cressier, Switzerland, where we manufacture products such as gasoline, diesel or heating oil. Then, we transport, store and distribute them to our customers in Benelux, France, Germany and Switzerland.  
  
VARO Energy is investing in this market by building a network of refineries, storage tanks and distribution channels to secure the reliable supply of oil products for heating, transportation, construction and the petrochemical industry in North West Europe.  
  
Most importantly, we are an established and experienced refiner. We know that no matter what we do, operating safely and behaving responsibly in the communities we work in is an unconditional priority.

About Temple Emanu-El Tucson
----------------------------

Our synagogue is an exciting and extraordinarily active place of prayer, study, creativity, and social justice. We are a warm and caring community, and we'd love to help you become a part of our congregational family.  
  
Temple Emanu-El is many things for our congregants: a holy place to worship God, a center to learn about and experience our amazingly rich Jewish tradition, a comfortable location to meet and make friends, a working center of living Judaism. It is also a place of creative exploration, where we can seek that which moves and excites us religiously and intellectually.  
  
At Temple Emanu-El, we honor the tradition of lifelong learning, from our award-winning Olga and Bob Strauss Center for Early Childhood Education, to the Sam and Jane Kurn Religious School, to our outstanding award-winning Adult Education Academy. We offer a wide variety of worship services, music and spiritual experiences. Our congregants are engaged in living Judaism through meaningful social action, community outreach, at the annual congregational retreat, active Women of Reform Judaism and Men's Club auxiliaries, innovative programming and a wide variety of social events. Temple Emanu-El was the first synagogue in Arizona, and we remain energetic pioneers of Jewish life in Arizona.

Guerrilla is one of Europe's leading game development companies and a wholly-owned subsidiary of Sony Interactive Entertainment Europe. Our studio is located in the cultural and historical center of Amsterdam, The Netherlands — a great place to work and play.  
  
Guerrilla was founded in 2000 as the result of a merger between three smaller Dutch studios, and acquired by Sony Interactive Entertainment after the release of Killzone in 2004. In the decade that followed, Guerrilla expanded Killzone into a full-fledged franchise with three sequels and two handheld spin-offs. Guerrilla's most recent title, released for PS4 in 2017 and for PC in 2020, is the critically and popularly acclaimed open world action-RPG Horizon Zero Dawn. About New10
-----------

New10 biedt zakelijke leningen voor mkb-ondernemers. Wij snappen dat je als ondernemer door wilt bouwen aan je bedrijf. Daarom maken we het financieren van je plannen zo snel, simpel en duidelijk mogelijk. Je vraagt bij ons zelfstandig een zakelijke lening aan. Geheel online: van financiële gegevens uploaden tot contracten tekenen. Daardoor weet je binnen 15 minuten wat er mogelijk is en kun je waar en wanneer je wilt door met de aanvraag.  
  
ABN AMRO heeft New10 geïnitieerd om een nieuwe propositie van online lenen neer te zetten voor mkb-ondernemers. We combineren de financiële kennis van de bank met de wendbaarheid van een startup. Je leent met de aantrekkelijke rente die je van de bank gewend bent, met het gemak en de snelheid van een online financieringspartner. Dat noemen wij: de nieuwe norm in zakelijk lenen.  
  
Benieuwd wat er voor jouw onderneming mogelijk is? Doe de check op new10.com.

### Frequently Asked Questions about Post Press Specialties Inc

What types of print finishing services does Post Press Specialties offer?

Post Press Specialties specializes in a variety of print finishing services including Folding and Gluing, Perfect Binding, Die-Cutting, Foil Embossing, 3D Spot Varnishing, and Commercial Bindery. Each service is designed to enhance the quality and presentation of printed materials, ensuring that your projects stand out.

How does Post Press Specialties ensure the quality of its print finishing services?

At Post Press Specialties, quality is our top priority. We utilize state-of-the-art equipment and employ skilled technicians who are experts in print finishing. Each job undergoes rigorous quality control checks at various stages of production to ensure that the final product meets our high standards and your expectations.

What industries does Post Press Specialties serve?

We serve a wide range of industries including publishing, marketing, packaging, and commercial printing. Our diverse capabilities allow us to cater to the specific needs of each sector, providing tailored solutions that enhance the effectiveness of their printed materials.

Can Post Press Specialties handle large volume orders?

Yes, Post Press Specialties is equipped to handle both small and large volume orders. Our efficient processes and dedicated team allow us to manage high-capacity jobs without compromising on quality or turnaround time, making us a reliable partner for businesses of all sizes.

What is the turnaround time for print finishing services?

Turnaround times can vary depending on the complexity and volume of the job. However, we pride ourselves on our speed and efficiency. Typically, we aim to complete most projects within a few days. For urgent requests, we offer expedited services to meet tight deadlines.

How can I request a quote for my print finishing project?

To request a quote, you can visit our website and fill out the contact form with details about your project, including the type of finishing services you need, the quantity, and any specific requirements. Our team will review your request and get back to you promptly with a competitive quote.

What services does Meduit offer for revenue cycle management?

Meduit provides a comprehensive suite of revenue cycle management services designed to optimize financial performance for healthcare organizations. Our offerings include compliance consulting, financial consulting, data analytics, medical debt collection, patient financing, and insurance denial management. We focus on enhancing operational efficiency and ensuring that healthcare providers can maximize their revenue while maintaining compliance with industry regulations.

How does Meduit ensure data security in its operations?

At Meduit, we prioritize data security and compliance with healthcare regulations such as HIPAA. We implement robust security measures, including encryption, secure access controls, and regular audits to protect sensitive patient information. Our team is trained in best practices for data handling, ensuring that all financial and healthcare data is managed securely and responsibly.

What industries does Meduit serve?

Meduit specializes in providing revenue cycle management solutions primarily for the healthcare industry. This includes hospitals, outpatient facilities, physician practices, and other healthcare providers. Our expertise extends to various sectors within healthcare, including workers' compensation, self-pay collections, and healthcare receivables management, allowing us to tailor our services to meet the unique needs of each organization.

Can Meduit assist with insurance denial management?

Yes, Meduit offers specialized services in insurance denial management. Our team analyzes denial trends, identifies root causes, and implements strategies to reduce denials and improve claims processing. We work closely with healthcare providers to ensure that they receive timely reimbursements and minimize revenue loss due to denied claims.

What is the role of data analytics in Meduit's services?

Data analytics plays a crucial role in Meduit's revenue cycle management services. We utilize advanced analytics to gain insights into financial performance, identify inefficiencies, and forecast trends. This data-driven approach allows us to make informed decisions, optimize processes, and enhance overall revenue cycle performance for our clients.

How does Meduit support patient financing and medical debt collection?

Meduit provides patient financing solutions to help healthcare organizations offer flexible payment options to patients, making healthcare more accessible. Additionally, our medical debt collection services are designed to recover outstanding balances while maintaining a positive patient experience. We focus on compassionate communication and effective collection strategies to ensure that patients are treated with respect while also helping healthcare providers recover their revenues.

About Yuen Lui Studios
----------------------

Yuen Lui Studio has been creating beautiful photographic portraits for families in the Pacific Northwest for over 70 years. Our company was founded by Yuen Lui, a Chinese immigrant who built his first studio in the Chinatown/International District of Seattle in 1947. The business grew to include several locations in Seattle Washington, Portland Oregon and Orange County, California. Today, Yuen Lui Studio is still family owned and operated.  
  
What sets us apart from other portrait studios - besides our longevity, is our beautiful lighting and composition. We offer consistent results that only experienced professional photographers can achieve. Yuen Lui Photography continues a tradition of excellence, providing uncompromising quality at an affordable price. Customer satisfaction is our number one goal, we want you to love your portraits and love your photo experience.  
  
You can choose to have your portraits taken at one of our studios or outside at a local beach or park. We also offer a variety of affordable portrait packages that give you the flexibility to purchase what you want. Whether it be finished prints or digital image files, the choices are yours.  
  
Childhood is fleeting, families grow and change, but our portraits last a lifetime. Call today to schedule your appointment and see why thousands of customers continue to trust Yuen Lui Studio to create beautiful and lasting portraits.

What types of photography services does Yuen Lui Studio offer?

Yuen Lui Studio specializes in a variety of photography services, including headshots, portrait photography, senior portraits, family photos, and business photography. With over 70 years of experience, our team is dedicated to capturing beautiful and timeless images that reflect the unique personalities and stories of our clients.

How can I schedule a session with Yuen Lui Studio?

To schedule a photography session with Yuen Lui Studio, you can visit our website and fill out the contact form, or you can call our studio directly. Our friendly staff will assist you in selecting the right package for your needs and help you choose a date and time that works best for you.

What should I expect during my photography session?

During your photography session at Yuen Lui Studio, you can expect a relaxed and enjoyable experience. Our professional photographers will guide you through poses and expressions to ensure you feel comfortable and confident. We encourage you to bring any personal items or props that reflect your personality, and we will work with you to create stunning images that you will cherish for years to come.

Do you offer digital images or prints after the session?

Yes, Yuen Lui Studio offers both digital images and high-quality prints after your photography session. You will have the opportunity to review your images and select your favorites for digital download or for printing. We provide a range of print options, including standard prints, canvases, and custom framing to suit your preferences.

What is the best time to schedule a family photo session?

The best time to schedule a family photo session is typically during the golden hour, which is the hour after sunrise or before sunset. This time provides soft, flattering light that enhances the beauty of your portraits. However, we can accommodate sessions throughout the day based on your family's schedule and preferences. It's also advisable to book your session in advance, especially during peak seasons like spring and fall.

Are your services suitable for businesses looking for corporate headshots?

Absolutely! Yuen Lui Studio provides professional business photography services, including corporate headshots. We understand the importance of a strong first impression in the business world, and our photographers are skilled at capturing images that convey professionalism and approachability. We can work with individuals or teams to create consistent branding across all your corporate images.

About SciCan
------------

SciCan provides a complete range of infection control solutions for dentists, ophthalmologists and medical clinics in countries around the world. Much of what we design, build, distribute and maintain is focused on efficiently washing, disinfecting, and sterilizing dental and medical instruments.  
  
In the dental industry, we’re known as the maker of the STATIM® cassette autoclave. It’s the fastest cassette autoclave out there. But we offer more than just technology, and more than just dental.  
  
Working with industry professionals and regulators, we provide the dental, ophthalmology, and endoscopy markets with the most innovative and effective products available. Our global network of infection control experts develop real world solutions based on our big-picture understanding of how good design, effective work flow, and sound ergonomics make for better and safer patient care.  
  
From the largest multi-office practice to the smallest clinic, SciCan products are used to carefully and efficiently clean instruments and fight the spread of diseases like hepatitis B, hepatitis C, and HIV.  
  
SciCan is a COLTENE Group Company. COLTENE is a global leader in dental consumables and small equipment covering the whole dental treatment process. Dentists and dental labs worldwide rely on the company’s products for implant-based therapies and dental reconstructions, as well as traditional therapies. VOCO is one of the leading international manufacturers of dental materials. A family-run medium-sized enterprise, VOCO has a presence in almost all markets across the globe, the name VOCO being synonymous with premium product quality, creative solutions and innovative power. Building on intensive research and development work, VOCO has repeatedly set new standards with its products. Dentists all over the world rely on the quality of our broad product range.  
  
VOCO continues on a course of expansion. The steady growth of the enterprise has not only resulted in an increase in its workforce numbers worldwide, but also in demands made on research and manufacturing capacities: High-end laboratories and state-of-the-art production premises house the development and manufacture of VOCO products.  
  
A globally aligned corporate strategy and a focus on quality and reliability have been the catalysts for establishing the VOCO brand firmly in the international markets. Today, the core markets for VOCO products, besides Germany and other European countries, are the USA and Canada. At the same time, our market shares in Asia, Central and South America as well as Australia also continue to grow.

What services does Pedersen & Partners offer?

We employ a rigorous and systematic approach to our Executive Search process, which includes extensive market research, in-depth candidate assessments, and a thorough understanding of our clients' organizational culture and strategic goals. Our team of experienced consultants utilizes a global network and industry expertise to identify and attract the best talent, ensuring a high-quality match for both clients and candidates.

What is the process for engaging Pedersen & Partners for Leadership Consulting?

Can Pedersen & Partners assist with board composition and governance?

We assist organizations in identifying and recruiting qualified board members, conducting board evaluations, and providing guidance on best practices in governance. Our goal is to help organizations build effective boards that can drive strategic decision-making and enhance overall performance.

What geographic regions does Pedersen & Partners serve?

Pedersen & Partners operates in 50 countries across Europe, the Middle East, Africa, and beyond. With 54 wholly owned offices, we have a strong local presence and a deep understanding of regional markets. This extensive geographic reach enables us to provide our clients with insights and solutions that are both globally informed and locally relevant.

About Federal Bar Council
-------------------------

The Federal Bar Council is a specialty bar association with a focus on the Federal Courts of the Second Circuit.  
  
The Federal Bar Council began in 1928 as a chapter of a national association of attorneys employed by the federal government. Because the national organization refused to admit African Americans, including Francis P. Giles, an Assistant United States Attorney from the Eastern District of New York, and a number of Assistants from the Southern District of New York, the group broke with the national organization. It was created as a separate organization, the Federal Bar Association of New York, New Jersey and Connecticut, by act of the New York State Legislature, signed into law by then Governor Franklin D. Roosevelt, effective April 1, 1932.  
  
Today, the Council is a vibrant organization with over 3,000 members and numerous active committees. the Council is an Accredited Provider of Continuing Legal Education programs in New York State. Members enjoy free CLE as one of the many benefits of membership. In addition to providing over 35 CLE programs annually, the Council hosts an annual Judges Luncheon, the Law Day Dinner and Thanksgiving Luncheon at the Waldorf-Astoria, the annual Winter Bench & Bar Conference, the annual Fall Bench & Bar Retreat, and numerous other meetings and events.

About Buchiglas USA Corp.
-------------------------

General description Buchiglas USA Corp. is a distributor of pilot plants and reactor systems, manufactured by its Swiss parent company Buchi AG, in the territory of the United States and Canada. Industries served by Buchiglas USA Corp. are the pharmaceutical and chemicals industries. In addition to the distribution of equipment, Buchiglas USA Corp. offers a broad range of services such as consulting, engineering, installation and maintenance. The Buchiglas products can be divided in two primary product lines pressure reactors and glass reactors. Buchi Pressure Reactors Buchiglas pressure reactors are multi-purpose chemical reactors with a pressure range of -1 to 400 bar (-14.5 - 5800 psi), in sizes from 10ml to 300 liters, for applications in chemical and pharmaceutical research and production such as hydrogenations, polymerizations, catalyst and corrosion testing. Standardized and engineered systems are available in borosilicate glass, stainless steel, Hastelloy, titanium, tantalum and other high performance materials. Complementary to the pressure reactor systems, Buchiglas offers process control, monitoring and automation. Buchi Glass Reactor Systems Buchi AG also manufactures reactor systems and pilot plants made from borosilicate glass and glass lined steel for use in R&D and production of a wide variety of fine chemicals and active pharmaceutical ingredients. The capacity of the equipment varies between 5 and 15 liters for the minipilot series, 15 to 250 liters for the chemreactor series and up to 10,000 liters for production plants. Buchiglas glass reactors, filters and scrubbers are built with a unique flexible glass connection, for vacuum tight, leakage free, economic and safe processing. The strength of Buchiglas lies in the customized engineering and design of the reactor systems and pilot plants for a multitude of customer requirements and applications.

At West Home, we believe locking into a traditional year long lease should be a choice - not a prerequisite for housing. That is why we empower our community base to live on their own terms across our unfurnished and designer level furnished inventory for stay duration lengths spanning a few nights to a year + and any duration length in between.  
  
We are on a mission to redefine the standard of living by matching experience with expectation.  
  
Innovation, integrity, accountability and transparency, are our guiding core values in our relentless pursuit of delivering meaningful and soulful experiences for our community base. About Manly Warringah Sea Eagles
--------------------------------

The Manly Warringah Sea Eagles are an Australian professional rugby league club based on the Northern Beaches of Sydney. We compete in the National Rugby League's (NRL's) premiership league, the premier rugby league competition of Australasia.  
  
The Sea Eagles first appeared in the 1947 New South Wales Rugby Football League season and currently plays home matches out of its ground Lottoland whilst being based at the New South Wales Academy of Sport in Narrabeen.  
  
Since winning their first premiership in 1972, the Club has won a total of eight first grade titles, with their most recent premiership being the 2011 grand final. The Club's eight titles span five consecutive decades. Since their first Grand Final appearance in 1951, the Club has appeared in 18 Grand Finals in seven consecutive decades. Most recently the Sea Eagles were runners-up in the 2013 season.

Gill Pasternak serves as the Quality Assurance Manager at SciCan, where she leverages her entrepreneurial spirit and extensive expertise in quality management to drive excellence in manufacturing and assembly environments. In her current role, Gill is responsible for overseeing the maintenance of the company’s accreditations, including ISO 13485, MDSAP, and compliance with the Council Directive 93/42/EEC and CFR 820. Her responsibilities encompass managing the Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA) process, vendor management, and conducting both internal and external audits. Gill’s expertise in risk management further enhances SciCan’s operational integrity, ensuring that all products meet stringent safety and efficacy standards.  
  
Additionally, Gill leads the company’s Drug Program in strict adherence to Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) regulations, underscoring her comprehensive understanding of regulatory frameworks. Her proficiency in quality systems, combined with her extensive knowledge of standards such as AS9100, ISO 9000, and TS 16949, positions her as a key player in the organization. With skills in Statistical Process Control (SPC), Root Cause Analysis, Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (FMEA), and Six Sigma methodologies, Gill Pasternak continues to drive quality assurance initiatives that enhance product reliability and customer satisfaction at SciCan.

About INSHUR
------------

We’re on a mission to make insurance fair and easy.  
INSHUR WAS FOUNDED IN 2016 TO REVOLUTIONIZE THE COMMERCIAL AUTO INSURANCE SECTOR.  
  
We're built with next-generation, data-led technology that enables drivers to obtain quotes and receive coverage in mere minutes. We pride ourselves on being digital-first, whilst having a top-rated customer service team standing by to help if our customer needs it.  
  
We completed our Series B funding in 2021, taking the total funding raised for our business to $35 million. The funding fuelled our ambitious global growth plans, enabling us to invest in technology, recruit the best people, and bring new product lines to an expanded market.  
  
Our talented team of over 120 people across the US, UK, and the Netherlands were also recognized at the prestigious British Insurance Awards for our commitment to diversity and inclusion.  
  
➔ 100% digital  
In 2017 INSHUR signed a capacity agreement with Munich Re. Enabling the launch of INSHUR 2.0, a full digital quote and buy mobile insurance product. Initially aimed at the 120,000 drivers in New York’s rideshare space.  
  
➔ Trans-Atlantic  
In November 2018 INSHUR agreed a distribution partnership with Uber, becoming a preferred insurance partner, and launched in the UK followed by the Netherlands in 2020.  
  
➔ Future-proof  
In 2020 INSHUR evolved its underlying technology infrastructure. The new data-led insurance platform is designed to power and protect the new economy players in mobility, delivery and transportation.  
  
➔ Customer-Centric  
To deliver a consistent, seamless customer experience, INSHUR recognized the need to take full ownership of it from quote through claim - building its own, in-house claims organization in 2020.  
  
➔ People-Led  
Innovation and growth is only possible when you have a smart, diverse team of people working together to make it happen. In 2021 we more than doubled in size - hiring over 100 people to join the team.

About Critical Control Energy Services
--------------------------------------

Critical Control Energy Services is North America’s leading gas chart integrator, processing over 200,000 gas charts on a monthly basis. We provide chart integration services to over 900 customers including 80% of the top 25 gas producers in North America. Critical Control Energy Services was established 30 years ago to provide oil and gas measurement solutions and field services.  
  
With expertise in gas measurement, the companies grew in scope to also offer full distribution lines of meters, instruments, accessories, fittings, and valves along with supporting services. Critical Control Energy Services has offices in Texas, Louisiana, West Virginia, Pennsylvania, and Ohio. Our field technicians are strategically located throughout Kentucky, Tennessee, Virginia, Texas, Louisiana, and Pennsylvania. Critical Control Energy Services offer comprehensive gas measurement services throughout the Appalachian Basin.  
  
Get in Touch  
  
Critical Control Energy Services and our Canadian affiliate, Critical Control Technologies, are North America’s leading gas measurement specialists. Through the balance of practicality, innovation and technology, Critical Control Energy Services solutions empower clients to manage critical gas production data.  
  
If you have any questions or require more information, please visit our website (www.criticalcontrol.com) and fill out our contact form or give us a call.

### Frequently Asked Questions about Critical Control Energy Services

Who are the decision makers in Critical Control Energy Services?

The decision makers in Critical Control Energy Services are [Alykhan Mamdani](https://contactout.com/Alykhan-Mamdani-57881114)
, Ashley Free, Damir Silic, etc. Click to Find [Critical Control Energy Services decision makers emails](https://contactout.com/dashboard/search?company=Critical%20Control%20Energy%20Services&seniority=founder%7Cc_suite%7Cvice_president%7Cowner%7Cdirector)
.

What services does Critical Control Energy Services offer?

Critical Control Energy Services specializes in gas chart integration, processing over 200,000 gas charts monthly. Our services include fabrication, field services, operational software, EFM data management, gas analysis/lab services, and advanced data solutions like NetFlow (webSCADA), ProChart, and ProTrend. We cater to a wide range of industries, ensuring accurate and efficient data management for our clients.

How does gas chart integration work?

Gas chart integration involves the collection and processing of gas measurement data from various sources. At Critical Control, we utilize advanced technology to convert physical gas charts into digital data, ensuring accuracy and compliance with industry standards. Our team meticulously reviews and validates the data before delivering it to our clients, enabling them to make informed operational decisions.

What industries does Critical Control Energy Services support?

Critical Control Energy Services supports a diverse range of industries, primarily focusing on the oil and gas sector. Our clients include producers, midstream operators, and service companies that require reliable gas measurement and data management solutions. Our expertise extends to various applications within these industries, ensuring tailored solutions that meet specific operational needs.

Can Critical Control help with regulatory compliance?

Yes, Critical Control Energy Services is committed to helping our clients maintain regulatory compliance. Our gas chart integration services are designed to meet industry standards and regulations, providing accurate data that is essential for compliance reporting. Additionally, our operational software solutions, such as ProTrend, offer tools for monitoring and analyzing data to ensure adherence to regulatory requirements.

What is NetFlow (webSCADA) and how does it benefit my operations?

NetFlow (webSCADA) is an advanced operational software solution offered by Critical Control that provides real-time monitoring and control of gas flow data. This web-based SCADA system allows operators to access critical information remotely, improving decision-making and operational efficiency. By utilizing NetFlow, companies can enhance their data visibility, reduce downtime, and optimize resource allocation.

How can I get started with Critical Control Energy Services?

Getting started with Critical Control Energy Services is simple. You can reach out to our team through our website or contact us directly to discuss your specific needs. We will assess your requirements and provide a tailored solution that aligns with your operational goals. Our dedicated customer support team will guide you through the onboarding process, ensuring a smooth transition to our services.

About RBI Corporation
---------------------

Chartered in 1919 with four employees, RBI Corporation (formerly Richmond Battery & Ignition) opened its doors committed to service. At that time, service was limited to battery maintenance on electric cars! The Company's growth paralleled the automotive aftermarket growth including Briggs & Stratton locks and keys.  
  
In 1946, RBI was appointed as a distributor for the budding small engine division of Briggs & Stratton, with the largest potential being gasoline powered washing machines. Following World War II, business blossomed as gasoline powered equipment took over the lawn and garden industry. Fueling this corporate growth was the addition of complimentary outdoor power equipment parts lines (see products). In 1978, a decision was made to devote 100% of RBI's corporate efforts to this continually growing outdoor power equipment industry and move to its current 53,000 square foot operations. In 1987 a second location was opened adding an additional 20,000 square foot warehouse. Continued growth has required that we open additional shipping facilities. Our Albany, GA warehouse was added in October, 2007 with 20,000 square feet for inventories. Our Louisville, KY warehouse was added in December 2008 with 18,000 square feet. Louisville and Albany locations are key to providing the next day service that our customers have become accustomed to and to growing our new expanded territory in the Southeast.  
  
Our growth has been made possible by RBI's continuing commitment to service. Outstanding service to the outdoor power equipment aftermarket is made possible by an excellent, loyal and committed independent service dealer network.  
  
By maintaining the most modern communications and its pledge of exceptional service, coupled with the continued support from our outstanding dealer network, RBI Corporation looks forward to the exciting challenges in this ever-changing industry.

*   [Email Format](https://contactout.com/company/the-british-press-photographers-association-email-format-6537536)
    

About The British Press Photographers' Association
--------------------------------------------------

The British Press Photographers’ Association was formed in 1984 by a small group of Fleet Street photographers to showcase the work that they were so passionate about. Over the next few years the Association grew staging a series of hugely influential exhibitions and publishing three volumes of “Assignments” – collections of each year’s best work.  
  
In 2003 we adopted a ‘mission statement': "To promote and inspire the highest ethical, technical and creative standards from within the profession and raise awareness and appreciation of our industry outside it."  
  
Later in the same year we staged an exhibition at a central London gallery called UNSEEN to showcase the large number of amazing photographs that, for a wide variety of reasons, never saw the light of day and were never published. We followed that up in 2005 with the seminal ‘Five Thousand Days’ – a book that sold well over 10,000 copies and showed press photography of the highest quality. Since then we have published two more books, had several web based projects and we have supported the Press Photographer’s Year competition since its inception.  
In 2006 we became one of the ‘Gatekeepers’ for the United Kingdom Press Card Authority. As part of the UKPCA we have the ability to assess and potentially approve photographers as holders of the UK Press Card.  
  
In 2011 we made a voluntary submission to the Leveson Inquiry into the Culture, Ethics and Standards of The Press when it became clear that news photographers were being singled out for criticism from many of the celebrity witnesses without any satisfactory replies. We made an appearance at the Inquiry in February 2012 after which Lord Justice Leveson made it clear that he saw The BPPA as part of the solution rather than the problem.  
  
The BPPA continues to make its voice heard on a range of issues that face our profession including our current work around copyright and orphan works legislation.

Headquartered in Reston, Virginia, the company was established in the DC metro area in 2002 and operates in 34 states today. Guidance Residential is a subsidiary of Guidance Financial Group, a global financial company that has pioneered the creation and development of Shariah-compliant investment products for institutional investors and financial intermediaries worldwide, as well as financial products and services that address the unmet needs of millions of Muslim consumers.  
  
As a highly respected and recognized institution in the Islamic Finance industry, the Guidance brand has also become synonymous with leadership and authenticity in Shariah-compliant home finance. Automated Financial Systems, Inc. (AFS) is the industry leader in lending and risk management solutions for financial institutions. Integral to the core AFS lending solution is its unique straight-through processing capability encompassing the lending process from Origination through Servicing.  
  
Experience and excellence are reflected in our market leadership—evidenced through our highly effective data quality, pricing and credit risk benchmarking services. About Actiris
-------------

Actiris est l'Office régional bruxellois de l'Emploi.  
  
En tant que service public d'emploi bruxellois, Actiris a pour ambition de devenir, avec ses partenaires, le fournisseur public de solutions pour l’emploi bruxellois, reconnu comme tel tant par les Chercheurs d’Emploi que par les Employeurs.  
  
Actiris concentre son action et ses moyens autour de deux missions stratégiques et transversales :  
  
1) Assurer le « matching » entre employeurs et chercheurs d’emploi  
  
\- Actiris s’engage à identifier, recueillir et satisfaire les offres d’emploi disponibles sur le marché du travail bruxellois.  
\- Chaque chercheur d'emploi inscrit chez Actiris se verra présenter sans délai des offres d'emploi correspondant à son profil.  
  
2) Organiser la transition vers l'emploi  
  
Avec ses partenaires, Actiris développe une offre de services proposant à chaque chercheur d'emploi bruxellois un accompagnement sur mesure vers l’emploi.  
  
Cet accompagnement prend la forme d’un soutien spécifique au chercheur d’emploi en vue d’élaborer avec lui son « plan d’action personnalisé ». Celui-ci implique, au besoin, l’orientation adéquate des chercheurs d’emploi vers l’ensemble des opérateurs d’emploi, de formation et d’insertion socioprofessionnelle existant à Bruxelles.  
  
Actiris, au cœur de l’emploi.

What types of rugs does Rugs A Million offer?

Rugs A Million offers a diverse selection of rugs, including contemporary, traditional, and modern designs. Our collection features various materials such as wool, synthetic fibers, and natural fibers, catering to different styles and preferences. Whether you're looking for area rugs, runners, or outdoor rugs, we have options to suit every space in your home or office.

Can I find custom-sized rugs at Rugs A Million?

Yes, Rugs A Million provides the option for custom-sized rugs to ensure a perfect fit for your space. Customers can choose from a variety of materials, colors, and patterns to create a rug that meets their specific dimensions and design preferences. Please contact our customer service team for more information on the custom rug process.

Does Rugs A Million offer rug cleaning and maintenance services?

Absolutely! Rugs A Million offers professional rug cleaning and maintenance services to help keep your rugs looking their best. Our team uses specialized techniques and eco-friendly products to clean and restore rugs of all types. Regular maintenance can extend the life of your rug and maintain its appearance, so we recommend scheduling cleaning services as needed.

What industries does Rugs A Million serve?

Rugs A Million serves a wide range of industries, including residential, commercial, hospitality, and interior design. We provide tailored solutions for homes, offices, hotels, and retail spaces, ensuring that our rugs meet the specific needs and aesthetic preferences of each industry. Our team is experienced in working with designers and businesses to create cohesive and stylish environments.

How can I determine the right size rug for my room?

To determine the right size rug for your room, consider the layout and dimensions of your space. A general guideline is to leave at least 18 inches of bare floor around the edges of the rug in larger rooms, while in smaller spaces, a rug that fits under furniture can create a cozy feel. We recommend measuring your room and visualizing the rug placement to find the perfect size. Our team is also available to assist with sizing recommendations.

What is the return policy for rugs purchased from Rugs A Million?

Rugs A Million has a customer-friendly return policy. If you are not completely satisfied with your purchase, you can return the rug within 30 days of delivery for a full refund, provided it is in its original condition and packaging. About Tennessee State Parks
---------------------------

From its beginning in 1937, Tennessee State Parks were established to protect and preserve the unique natural, cultural and historic resources of Tennessee. The public interest has also been served by a variety of benefits for citizens and communities produced by our state park system, promoting stronger communities and healthier citizens across the state through diverse resource-based recreation while conserving the natural environment for today and tomorrow – preserving authentic Tennessee places and spaces for future generations to enjoy. As stewards of the resources in our parks, we seek to manage Tennessee’s state parks in order to preserve and protect valued resources and to provide a balance of services and benefits for the enjoyment of the people.  
  
Our mission is to preserve and protect, in perpetuity, unique examples of natural, cultural, and scenic areas and provide a variety of safe, quality, outdoor experiences through a well-planned and professionally managed system of state parks.  
  
We believe there is inherent value in the natural environment. We believe that the observation and experience of natural things in a setting removed from the hectic world of the day-to-day can uplift and re-create the human spirit. We also believe there is value in physical reminders of our past. Without history, there is nothing upon which to base our understanding of the present or our dreams of the future. We believe that everyone should Have Fun and Adventure, Naturally!

SCREEN Graphic Solutions Co., Ltd. (SCREEN GA) is one of the world’s largest manufacturers and suppliers of production systems for the prepress and printing industries. Its large range of equipment includes the Truepress Jet range of large format inkjet printers, UV inkjet label presses, sheet-fed and web-fed inkjet presses, the EQUIOS workflow system, RIPs, and plate setters.  
  
SCREEN's high-end equipment covers a wide range of markets, such as books, labels, folding carton, newspaper, direct mail, transpromo, packaging, wide format and commercial printing.  
  
The European business unit of SCREEN GA is managed through SCREEN Europe, headquartered in Amstelveen in the Netherlands, where the Truepress POD inkjet printers are available for print sessions in its Solutions & Technology Center.  
  
SCREEN GA is a division of SCREEN Holdings (Kyoto, Japan), which is also a well-known manufacturer of equipment for the semiconductor and flat panel display manufacturing industries.  
  
Since 2005, Inca Digital is part of SCREEN GA and SCREEN GA is also manufacturing various products for a range of OEM partners.

About City of Auburn (Washington)
---------------------------------

Auburn is the center of the largest industrial complex in the northwest and sits in the middle of the major north-south east-west routes of this region. With two rail roads and close proximity to the Ports of Seattle and Tacoma, Auburn was identified by the Department of Commerce this year as one of only 15 Innovation Partnership Zones in Washington State. With continued job expansion and above average retail growth, Auburn enjoys a vibrant and sustainable business environment.  
  
Auburn is about one hour from Mt. Rainier, Crystal Mountain and Snoqualmie Ski Area. It is also home to several biking and walking trails, including the White and Green River trails and the Interurban Trail. Auburn has approximately 30 parks of all sizes for the whole family to enjoy. There are two golf courses in Auburn: the Auburn Golf Course and Washington National Golf Club.  
  
Auburn has reason to be proud of its schools. They pride themselves in providing an excellent education that produces students who have a love of learning and a sense of responsibility. Auburn boasts over two dozen elementary, middle, and high schools, each one unique, but all offering a supportive learning environment designed to foster each student's natural abilities. Green River Community College provides the serious student a quiet, natural environment in which to study. This is a community that puts learning and education first.  
  
Come establish a sense of community in one of the oldest cities in the state of Washington. With unique architecture, combined with historic preservation and renovations, Auburn has retained the look and feel of a real downtown. Auburn's unique historic downtown still provides a gathering place for numerous events.

His remarkable talent, charming Southern drawl, and striking good looks have made him a fan favorite and a highly sought-after leading man.  
  
McConaughey first gained widespread attention for his breakout role in the 1993 film "Dazed and Confused," in which he portrayed the iconic character of Wooderson. His laid-back and effortlessly cool portrayal of the character showcased his natural acting abilities and set the stage for his future success in the entertainment industry. He continued to build his reputation with memorable roles in films such as "A Time to Kill" and "Amistad," which showcased his dramatic range and on-screen presence.  
  
One of McConaughey's most acclaimed performances came in the 2013 film "Dallas Buyers Club," for which he won the Academy Award for Best Actor. In the film, he portrayed the real-life character of Ron Woodroof, a Texas electrician who was diagnosed with AIDS in the 1980s and became a crusader for alternative treatments for the disease. McConaughey's transformative performance and dedication to the role earned him widespread critical acclaim and solidified his status as a top-tier actor in Hollywood.  
  
In addition to his dramatic work, McConaughey has also displayed his comedic chops in films such as "The Wedding Planner," "How to Lose a Guy in 10 Days," and "Failure to Launch." His ability to effortlessly transition between different genres and bring authenticity to his characters has made him a versatile and in-demand actor in the industry.  
  
In recent years, McConaughey has ventured into television, starring in the acclaimed HBO series "True Detective." His portrayal of troubled detective Rust Cohle garnered rave reviews from critics and further showcased his talent as an actor. The series marked a successful foray into television for McConaughey and solidified his status as a multi-faceted performer.  
  
Beyond his acting career, McConaughey is also known for his philanthropic work and commitment to giving back to his community. He established the just keep livin Foundation, which aims to empower high school students to lead active lives and make healthy choices. His dedication to making a positive impact on the lives of others reflects his compassionate and generous nature.  
  
In addition to his philanthropy, McConaughey is also an accomplished author, having released a memoir titled "Greenlights." The book delves into his personal and professional experiences, offering readers a glimpse into his unique perspective on life and the entertainment industry. His honest and introspective writing style has resonated with readers and further cemented his status as a multi-talented creative force.  
  
With his impressive body of work, natural charisma, and genuine commitment to his craft, Matthew McConaughey continues to captivate audiences and leave a lasting impression in the world of entertainment. They also offer various packages and promotions, so be sure to check for any deals that may enhance your stay.

Additionally, their commitment to sustainability and community involvement further enhances their appeal to travelers seeking a distinctive and responsible hospitality experience.

His unique approach combines a keen understanding of market dynamics with a commitment to capital efficiency, allowing him to identify startups led by founders who possess deep insights derived from their personal experiences.  
  
Aaron's expertise in mergers and acquisitions, coupled with his operational management skills, enables him to provide invaluable guidance to portfolio companies as they navigate the complexities of growth and scaling. His analytical mindset and strategic planning capabilities ensure that investments are not only financially sound but also aligned with long-term market trends. As a former Army helicopter pilot, Aaron brings a disciplined and mission-oriented perspective to his work, emphasizing teamwork and resilience in the face of challenges.  
  
Beyond his investment acumen, Aaron is an advocate for innovative governance solutions, such as Ranked Choice Voting, which reflects his commitment to fostering democratic engagement and informed decision-making within the entrepreneurial ecosystem. His multifaceted skill set, combined with a passion for supporting visionary founders, positions him as a pivotal figure in the venture capital landscape, dedicated to driving meaningful change in the technology sector.

About David Cronenberg

David Cronenberg is a groundbreaking Canadian film director and screenwriter widely acclaimed for his unique and disturbing style, often exploring themes of human transformation, bodily decay, and the blurred lines between technology and humanity. Born on March 15, 1943, in Toronto, Canada, Cronenberg has carved out a niche for himself within the realm of "body horror," crafting films that delve deep into the darkest recesses of the human psyche.  
  
Cronenberg's interest in exploring the relationship between the human body and its environment emerged early on. With an education in science and literature, he began crafting films that combined elements of both disciplines, creating a distinct and unsettling visual style that has become his trademark. One of his earliest works, "Videodrome" (1983), is a prime example of this blend, delving into the effects of technology and media on the human body and its consciousness.  
  
Throughout his career, Cronenberg has demonstrated an unwavering commitment to pushing boundaries and challenging societal norms. In films such as "Crash" (1996), based on J.G. Ballard's controversial novel, Cronenberg explores the eroticism of car accidents and the fetishization of bodily wounds. This provocative subject matter sparked widespread debate and earned the film critical acclaim.  
  
Another prominent feature of Cronenberg's work is his meticulous attention to the use of practical effects in creating visceral and often grotesque imagery. Rather than relying on CGI, he prefers to create his disturbing visuals through practical effects, showcasing his skill in capturing the physicality of transformation and decay. In his body horror masterpiece "The Fly" (1986), Cronenberg brings to life a disturbing portrayal of a scientist slowly transforming into a gruesome human-insect hybrid, depicting the physical and psychological toll the transformation takes on the protagonist.  
  
Cronenberg's films also frequently include exploration of the human mind and how it intertwines with the body. In "A History of Violence" (2005), he delves into the hidden depths of the human psyche, examining the duality of human nature and the consequences of violence. The film, which garnered critical acclaim and multiple award nominations, showcases Cronenberg's ability to tackle complex themes while maintaining an unflinching gaze on the human condition.  
  
In addition to his remarkable ability to portray the physical and psychological transformation of his characters, Cronenberg has an innate talent for extracting exceptional performances from his actors. From iconic performances by Jeff Goldblum in "The Fly" to Viggo Mortensen in "Eastern Promises" (2007), the actors in Cronenberg's films often deliver their best work under his masterful direction.  
  
Despite the unsettling nature of his work, Cronenberg has managed to gain international recognition and accolades. His film "Dead Ringers" (1988), a haunting tale of twin gynecologists, earned him a Special Jury Prize at the Cannes Film Festival and showcased his ability to fuse psychological drama with body horror elements seamlessly. Additionally, Cronenberg has been awarded the Order of Canada, the highest civilian honor in the country, in recognition of his contributions to the arts.  
  
Throughout his career, David Cronenberg has continuously pushed the boundaries of cinematic storytelling, fearlessly exploring the dark recesses of the human mind and body. With his distinctive visual style and thought-provoking narratives, he has established himself as one of the most innovative and influential directors in the history of cinema. Always evolving and unafraid to challenge conventional norms, Cronenberg's films leave a deep and lasting impact, inviting audiences to confront their own fears and examine the intricate relationship between the physical and the metaphysical.

About Humber River Hospital
---------------------------

Humber River Hospital, located at 1235 Wilson Avenue in Toronto, Ontario, stands as one of Canada’s largest regional acute care facilities, dedicated to providing exceptional healthcare services to a diverse population of over 850,000 residents in the northwest Greater Toronto Area (GTA). With a robust infrastructure that includes three operational sites and a total of 549 beds, the hospital is staffed by approximately 3,000 dedicated professionals, including around 700 physicians and 400 volunteers, all committed to delivering high-quality patient care.  
  
Affiliated with prestigious institutions such as the University of Toronto and Queen's University, Humber River Hospital is recognized for its innovative medical practices and specialized services. Notably, it is home to Ontario’s first Centre of Excellence for laparoscopic bariatric surgery, reflecting its commitment to advancing surgical techniques and improving patient outcomes. The hospital also offers a wide range of services, from emergency care to specialized surgical procedures, ensuring comprehensive healthcare for its community.  
  
For those seeking specific information about healthcare providers, the Humber River Hospital staff directory is an invaluable resource, providing easy access to contact details and professional backgrounds of the medical team. With a focus on patient-centered care and a commitment to excellence, Humber River Hospital continues to be a cornerstone of health services in the region.

Matthew McConaughey is an American actor who has captured the hearts of audiences with his charming Southern drawl and charismatic screen presence. Born on November 4, 1969, in Uvalde, Texas, McConaughey quickly established himself as a talented and versatile actor, known for his roles in a wide range of films, from romantic comedies to intense dramas.  
  
McConaughey first gained widespread recognition for his breakout role in the 1993 film "Dazed and Confused." His performance as the smooth-talking David Wooderson earned him critical acclaim and set the stage for a successful career in Hollywood. He continued to prove himself as a leading man in films such as "A Time to Kill," "Amistad," and "The Newton Boys," showcasing his ability to tackle complex and challenging roles with ease.  
  
One of McConaughey's most memorable performances came in the 1996 film "Lone Star," in which he portrayed the troubled Sheriff Buddy Deeds. His portrayal of the conflicted lawman earned him further praise from critics and solidified his reputation as a versatile and talented actor. As his career continued to flourish, McConaughey demonstrated his commitment to his craft by taking on a diverse array of roles, refusing to be typecast.  
  
In 2000, McConaughey starred in the romantic comedy "The Wedding Planner," opposite Jennifer Lopez, showcasing his comedic timing and charm. This film marked a turning point in his career, as he continued to take on lighthearted roles in films like "How to Lose a Guy in 10 Days" and "Fool's Gold." However, McConaughey's true talent shone through in his dramatic roles, particularly in the 2013 film "Dallas Buyers Club."  
  
In "Dallas Buyers Club," McConaughey delivered a career-defining performance as Ron Woodroof, a man diagnosed with AIDS who becomes an advocate for others afflicted with the disease. His powerful portrayal earned him numerous accolades, including the Academy Award for Best Actor, solidifying his status as a respected and talented performer. McConaughey's dedication to his role was evident in his physical transformation, as he lost a significant amount of weight to accurately portray the physical toll of the disease.  
  
Following his triumph in "Dallas Buyers Club," McConaughey continued to impress audiences with his performances in films such as "Interstellar" and "The Wolf of Wall Street." His ability to bring depth and authenticity to his characters has made him a sought-after talent in Hollywood, and he has continued to take on challenging and diverse roles that showcase his range as an actor.  
  
In addition to his success on the big screen, McConaughey has also extended his talents to the small screen, starring in the acclaimed HBO series "True Detective." His performance as detective Rust Cohle earned him further praise and solidified his reputation as a versatile and accomplished actor. McConaughey's ability to captivate audiences with his intense and enigmatic characters has made him a standout in the world of television as well.  
  
Beyond his acting talents, McConaughey has also proven himself to be a skilled and engaging storyteller. In 2020, he released his memoir, "Greenlights," in which he reflects on his life and career, offering insights and wisdom gleaned from his experiences. His candor and honesty have resonated with readers, further cementing his reputation as a multi-faceted and compelling personality.  
  
Overall, Matthew McConaughey has left an indelible mark on the world of entertainment, captivating audiences with his magnetic screen presence and unforgettable performances. From his early days as a rising star to his current status as a respected and revered actor, McConaughey continues to impress and inspire with his dedication to his craft and his ability to bring depth and authenticity to his characters. As a true talent in the industry, McConaughey's work will undoubtedly continue to resonate with audiences for years to come.

About Mercator Medical S.A.
---------------------------

Mercator Medical Group is a global concern recognizable in medical industry, based on Polish capital. For over 25 years Mercator has provided – as a producer and distributor – a full range of disposable medical products, mainly gloves (examination, surgical, protective, household, heavy-duty), dressings, disposable apparel, and non-woven surgical drapes. The Group sells products to over 70 countries all around the world with a 2% share on the global market. Mercator Medical Group is 1 of 2 European companies and one of few production conglomerates in the world producing in Asia (the company owns three factories in Thailand). The Polish parent company – Mercator Medical S.A. – has been listed on the Warsaw Stock Exchange since 2013.  
  
Mercator Medical Group is a protection oriented organization that aims to protect all the users, prevent infections and contamination. Our examination gloves provide the best protective barrier against microorganisms and the adverse influence of chemicals used in the hospital environment. On the other hand, our surgical gloves – hermetically packed in pairs – provide protection against infections in a high-risk environment and are intended for invasive surgery requiring aseptic conditions. Additionally, gloves – as a basic protective device – are recommended to be commonly used in everyday works (food preparation, gardening, etc.).  
  
Mercator Medical Group has the widest offer of gloves in constant sale in the Central and Eastern Europe:  
  
52 types | 6 kinds of raw materials | 5 gloves size for examination and 7 gloves size for surgery | 18 colours  
  
What is the real mission of the company? High quality of our products, service excellence, protection and satisfaction of our customers, employees and stakeholders. There are almost three decades of experience behind us and we still go forward, writing the next part of our history.

About Wiley-VCH
---------------

Wiley's Scientific, Technical, Medical, and Scholarly (STMS) business, also known as Wiley-Blackwell, serves the world's research and scholarly communities, and is the largest publisher for professional and scholarly societies. Wiley-Blackwell's programs encompass journals, books, major reference works, databases, and laboratory manuals, offered in print and electronically. Through Wiley Online Library, we provide online access to a broad range of STMS content: over 4 million articles from 1,500 journals, 9,000+ books, and many reference works and databases. Access to abstracts and searching is free, full content is accessible through licensing agreements, and large portions of the content are provided free or at nominal cost to nations in the developing world through partnerships with organizations such as HINARI, AGORA, and OARE.  
  
Wiley's Professional Development business creates products and services that help customers become more effective in the workplace and achieve career success. It brings to life the ideas and best practices of thought leaders in business, finance, accounting, workplace learning, management, leadership, technology, behavioral health, engineering/architecture, and education to serve these communities worldwide.

About Chukong Technologies
--------------------------

Chukong Technologies is a mobile entertainment platform company that provides tools to enhance efficiency and lower costs for developers and mobile content creators across the world. Born from CocoaChina.com, the largest iOS developer community in China, Chukong is headquartered in Beijing, China, and also has operations in Tokyo, Seoul, Taipei, and Menlo Park, California. Chukong sponsors and maintains Cocos2d-x , the cross platform open source game engine that has been downloaded more than 1.1 million times across 150 countries. Seven of the 10 top grossing games in China were built on Cocos2d-x. To complement the game engine, Chukong has created the developer toolset CocoStudio, which makes it easy for teams to design, build and animate games. Chukong’s in-house development studio has built top-ranking games for players around the world. Previously operating under the name Punchbox, Chukong’s game development team, Coco, is behind top games such as the Fishing Joy franchise (one of the most popular and highest grossing mobile games in China). Pocket Climber, and Where’s My XiYangYang. To date, the company has released 8 games developed in-house since it was founded in 2008. Combined with its published titles, the company’s portfolio has more than 1 billion sessions per month, 63 million monthly active users, and 350 million activated downloads. Under their CocoaChina brand, Chukong Technologies partners with international developers who want to access the Chinese mobile gaming market. CocoaChina offers a full suite of services to help developers go East, from offering feedback on game design to maximize montetization and handling local app store distribution to combating fraud and piracy and assisting with translation and localization. Chukong has worked with more than 20 international studios to help bring their games to Chinese audiences, including mobile gaming giants like Nexon, GameLoft, Disney, Gumi, and Konami. In addition, Chukong is helping elite Chinese developers to explore opportunities overseas and has published top grossing and top downloaded games in Taiwan, Korea, United States and many other markets.

About The KURZ Group
--------------------

The KURZ Group (www.kurzusa.com / www.kurz.de) is the global leader in hot stamping technologies, producing stamping and security foils for a wide range of decorative and functional applications.  
  
The company has more than 6,000 employees, as well as 11 production facilities located throughout Europe, the United States and the Pacific region. KURZ also has over 30 international branch offices and 70 distributors and sales offices located throughout the world, providing full-service solutions that meet and exceed the requirements of individual customers in local markets. The KURZ customer support team is on standby at all times to respond to the needs of customers around the globe.  
  
KURZ hot stamping foils are utilized on a wide assortment of products including labels, folding cartons, greeting cards, automotive parts, payment/gift/loyalty cards, electronic devices, household appliances, cosmetics, textiles, furniture and numerous other items. KURZ security portfolio includes the KINEGRAM® for financial instruments such as banknotes and financial cards, identification documents including passports, driver licenses and other government-issued documents; and TRUSTSEAL® AND TRUSTCODE® Brand Enhancement solutions, providing the ultimate in authentication and counterfeit-deterrence, aesthetic design appeal and brand communications.  
  
In addition to foils, KURZ offers a wide range of other products such as stamping tools and application machines.  
  
KURZ Transfer Products, L.P. (KTP) is the U.S.-based subsidiary of The KURZ Group (www.kurzusa.com). Headquartered in Charlotte, North Carolina, KTP has manufacturing facilities in Charlotte and Lexington, North Carolina and regional finishing and distribution centers in Charlotte NC, Lexington NC, Chicago IL, Corona CA, New York NY, and Toronto, Ontario.

About Ultra Clean Systems Inc.
------------------------------

Ultra Clean Systems, Inc., is a US manufacturer of medical grade ultrasonic cleaning systems designed specifically for cleaning surgical instruments.  
  
Headquartered in Oldsmar, Florida, Ultra Clean Systems offers a variety unique ultrasonic cleaning systems appropriate for all sizes of hospitals, ambulatory surgery centers, and budgets.  
  
Our ultrasonic cleaning systems are known for their fast, yet ultra-thorough, 13-minute standard instrument or 15-minute robotic instrument wash cycles and high instrument capacity. Ultra Clean is proud to be an industry leader in this highly specialized field of surgical instrument processing.  
  
Ultra Clean Systems, Inc., is true to its name with our titanium rod transducer (TRT) surgical instrument cleaning systems. Each machine provides the ultimate in speed and thoroughness in a process that is independently validated to clean robotic instruments.  
  
Combined with an array of best-in-class cleaning systems is our UCS line of affiliated consumable products, such as brushes, antifatigue mats, and PPE gear. Together Ultra Clean Systems and UCS fill all the needs of any sterile processing department.  
  
Ultra Clean Systems was founded by O’Brien Cale in 1999. Utilizing his nearly 20 years of industry experience, O' Brien developed a range of products that are the envy of the industry. With his vision and deep understanding of customer needs, O' Brien has guided Ultra Clean Systems to become an industry innovator and leader in ultrasonic cleaning systems.

About DRUNK ELEPHANT
--------------------

Our Philosophy  
We are committed to using only ingredients that either directly benefit the health of the skin or support the integrity of our formulations. We never take into account whether something is synthetic or natural, instead choosing ingredients based on biocompatibility.  
  
The Suspicious 6  
We believe six ubiquitous ingredients are at the root of almost every skin issue we see––essential oils, drying alcohols, silicones, chemical sunscreens, fragrances/dyes, SLS––and when they're entirely removed from one’s routine (when you take a #drunkbreak🐘), skin can reset and return to a healthy, balanced state. That’s our ingredient-elimination philosophy for a total skin reset.  
  
Skincare “Smoothies”  
We think of our skincare routines as smoothies. They’re good for you, they’re easy to mix, and you can change up the recipe whenever you want. Plus, all of our products are biocompatible and bioavailable, which means they’re highly absorbable.  
  
Drunk Head to Toe  
Skin is skin—and whether we call it the scalp or the eye area or the legs, it can only function at its healthiest when it’s treated with smart, nourishing, biocompatible ingredients. So we decided to make a line of hair-care and body products that followed one simple idea: Respect the skin by only using ingredients it can get along with.

About Instituto Geográfico Nacional
-----------------------------------

El Instituto Geográfico Nacional es una de las instituciones de mayor antigüedad en el ámbito del Ministerio de Defensa, con más de 130 años de historia.  
  
Su misión principal es representar el territorio nacional a través de la cartografía oficial y velar para que los mapas de la República Argentina que se confeccionen, ingresen o circulen en el país se ajusten a dicha cartografía oficial.  
  
Son sus funciones también las de establecer el marco geodésico nacional y entender en todo lo relacionado con los sistemas de información geográfica, a fin de satisfacer los objetivos y políticas establecidas por el Poder Ejecutivo Nacional para contribuir a una eficaz definición y representación de la soberanía territorial Argentina.

About Daily Nexus
-----------------

The Daily Nexus is an independent daily news publication at UCSB. The Nexus had its start in the 1930s. Back then, the newspaper was called the Eagle, and UCSB was known as Santa Barbara State College. After the college joined the University of California system, its newspaper changed names various times, existing in former editions as the Roadrunner, El Gaucho, the University Post and the Daily Gaucho. The Daily Nexus received its name in 1970, following the infamous Bank of America burning that occurred in Isla Vista. The editorial board took the name from a Robert Maynard Hutchins quote: “A free press is the nexus of any democracy.”

About Administrative Conference of the United States
----------------------------------------------------

The Administrative Conference of the United States is an independent federal agency dedicated to improving the administrative process through consensus-driven applied research, providing nonpartisan expert advice and recommendations for improvement of federal agency procedures. Its membership is composed of innovative federal officials and experts with diverse views and backgrounds from both the private sector and academia.  
  
The membership of the Conference, also known as the Assembly, includes the Chairman, the Council, members from approximately 50 federal executive departments and agencies and independent regulatory boards and commissions, and 40 members of the public representing diverse views and backgrounds.  
  
The Conference is committed to promoting effective public participation and efficiency in the rulemaking process by leveraging interactive technologies and encouraging open communication with the public as well as making improvements to the regulatory process by reducing unnecessary litigation, improving the use of science and improving the use of applicable laws.  
  
Learn more at www.acus.gov.

About WTVM News Leader 9
------------------------

WTVM News Leader 9 located in an under the radar and over the top location in Columbus, Georgia (a little over an hour south of Atlanta). The Fountain City has a vibrant artsy energy with a unique local history and a killer food scene. It’s also a perfect place to enjoy the outdoors, listen to local bands and taste some local finely brewed boutique beer. In short, we’ve got world-class experiences without the world-class ego (you can thank us for that later).  
  
The station has a unique history, WTVM became the first television station on the air in Columbus, Georgia on October 6, 1953. Allen Woodall, Sr. owned WDAK Radio in Columbus. He went into partnership with Martin Theatres to start WDAK-TV on Channel 28.  
  
Martin Theatres became the sole owners in 1956 and changed the station call letters to WTVM-TV, which stands for TeleVision Martin. They also changed the channel allocation to VHF Channel 9 to serve a larger portion of the West Georgia and East Alabama community.  
  
In its 64 year history, WTVM News Leader 9 has had 5 owners. Western Broadcasting bought the station in 1980. SFN Publishing became the owner in 1984. A group of SFN managers formed Pegasus Broadcasting and purchased WTVM-TV in 1986. AFLAC bought the station in 1989 (their world headquarter are located across the street).  
AFLAC sold WTVM to Raycom Media, Inc. of Montgomery, Alabama, on April 15, 1997 and remains under the Raycom banner today. WTVM News Leader 9 has a long history of being the #1 station in the market on all screens.
