What types of editing and proofreading services does Proofed offer?

Proofed offers a wide range of editing and proofreading services tailored to meet the needs of various clients. Our services include copy editing, proofreading, document formatting, book editing, essay proofreading, PhD editing, and research editing. Each service is designed to enhance clarity, coherence, and overall quality of your written content, ensuring that it meets professional standards.

How does Proofed ensure the quality of its editing services?

At Proofed, we pride ourselves on our team of 750 specialist editors who are trained in various fields. Each editor is selected based on their expertise and experience in specific industries, ensuring that your content is handled by someone knowledgeable in your subject matter. Additionally, we implement a rigorous quality assurance process that includes multiple rounds of review to maintain high standards across all projects.

Can Proofed assist with academic writing, such as dissertations or research papers?

Yes, Proofed specializes in academic editing and proofreading services, including support for dissertations, theses, research papers, and journal articles. Our editors are familiar with academic conventions and can help ensure that your work is polished, properly formatted, and ready for submission. We also offer PhD editing services specifically designed to assist doctoral candidates in refining their research.

What industries does Proofed serve?

Proofed serves a diverse range of industries, including academia, publishing, business, healthcare, and technology. Our editors have expertise in various fields, allowing us to provide tailored editing services that meet the specific needs of different sectors. Whether you are a student, a researcher, or a corporate team, we have the right editor for your project.

How does the process of using Proofed's services work?

Using Proofed's services is simple and straightforward. First, you submit your document through our online platform. After selecting the type of service you need, you will receive a quote based on the document's length and complexity. Once you approve the quote, our dedicated editor will begin working on your document. You can track the progress and communicate with the editor if needed. After the editing is complete, you will receive your polished document back, ready for use.

What is the turnaround time for editing and proofreading services at Proofed?

Turnaround times at Proofed vary depending on the length and complexity of the document, as well as the specific service requested. Generally, we offer several options, including standard and expedited services. Standard turnaround times can range from 24 hours to several days, while expedited services can provide quicker results. For specific projects, you can request a custom timeline when submitting your document.

.

What types of laser eye surgery does London Vision Clinic offer?

London Vision Clinic offers a range of advanced laser eye surgery options, including LASIK, PRK/LASEK, Laser Blended Vision, and ReLEx SMILE. Each procedure is tailored to meet the specific needs of patients, depending on their vision correction requirements and eye health.

How does the LASIK procedure work, and what can I expect during recovery?

LASIK (Laser-Assisted In Situ Keratomileusis) involves using a laser to reshape the cornea, allowing light to be properly focused on the retina. The procedure is quick, typically taking less than 30 minutes for both eyes. Recovery is usually swift, with many patients experiencing improved vision within a day. However, some may experience mild discomfort or fluctuations in vision during the initial healing period.

Is laser eye surgery suitable for everyone?

While laser eye surgery is effective for many individuals, it may not be suitable for everyone. Factors such as age, eye health, and the severity of vision impairment are considered during the initial consultation. The London Vision Clinic conducts thorough assessments to determine the best treatment options for each patient.

What is the difference between LASIK and LASEK surgery?

LASIK and LASEK are both refractive surgeries aimed at correcting vision, but they differ in technique. LASIK involves creating a thin flap in the cornea, while LASEK involves removing the outer layer of the cornea and applying the laser directly to the underlying tissue. LASEK may be recommended for patients with thinner corneas or those who are more active, as it typically has a lower risk of flap-related complications.

What is Laser Blended Vision, and who is it for?

Laser Blended Vision is a specialized treatment designed for individuals over 40 who are experiencing presbyopia, a condition that affects near vision. This technique combines different laser treatments to create a blended vision effect, allowing patients to see clearly at multiple distances without the need for reading glasses. It is ideal for those looking to improve their overall vision quality as they age.

How can I schedule a consultation at London Vision Clinic?

To schedule a consultation at London Vision Clinic, you can visit their website and fill out the online appointment form, or you can call their office directly. During the consultation, a qualified ophthalmologist will assess your vision and discuss the most suitable treatment options based on your individual needs.

About City of Wichita Falls
---------------------------

Wichita Falls officially became a city on September 27,1872, when town lots were sold at what is now the cornerof Seventh and Ohio Streets. The City has a richhistory as a center for oil manufacturing and agriculturalproduction. Today, the City’s pro-business attitudecontinues to encourage entrepreneurship and sustainablelong-term growth. Major area employers include SheppardAir Force Base, North Texas State Hospital, United RegionalHealthcare System, Wichita Falls ISD, and Midwestern StateUniversity.Wichita Falls offers abundant recreational, cultural, andentertainment opportunities. Recreation programs cover awide range of activities including softball, volleyball,kickball, flag football, disk golf, basketball, dance, fitness,special events, senior activities, and more. Local amenitieslike the River Bend Nature Center, Castaway CoveWaterpark, Lake Wichita, and Lake Arrowhead attractoutdoor enthusiasts of all ages. The Kemp Center for theArts, Museum of North Texas History, Kell House Museum,Wichita Falls Railroad Museum, and the Juanita Harvey ArtGallery at MSU provide cultural enrichment and educationopportunities for the whole family. Popular annual eventssuch as the St. Patrick’s Day Festival, Red River WineFestival, Cajun Festival, Oil Bowl, Art and Soul Festival,Freedom Festival, City Light Parade, and THOR 5-K rundraw visitors from throughout the region.

SEEN Group is a globally renowned beauty specialist business headquartered in London, England. With a commitment to excellence, SEEN Group stands out as an industry-leading collective of beauty experts that seamlessly integrates strategy, creative, and communications to elevate brands in the competitive beauty landscape. The company operates through three key divisions, each designed to cater to the diverse needs of beauty brands and consumers alike.  
  
Beauty SEEN focuses on connecting brands with their target audiences through a deep understanding of consumer behavior and market dynamics. By leveraging insights into the 'who' and the 'how,' this division crafts tailored strategies that resonate with consumers and drive engagement. Meanwhile, SEEN Works combines specialist thought leadership with industry-leading creative execution, ensuring that brands not only have a vision but also the tools to bring that vision to life through innovative campaigns and compelling storytelling.  
  
In a rapidly evolving digital landscape, Community X SEEN emerges as a pioneering multi-service nano creator community and marketing platform. This division bridges the gap between beauty creators and global beauty brands, fostering authentic collaborations that amplify brand reach and consumer connection. By harnessing the power of technology and social media, Community X SEEN enables brands to tap into the influence of nano creators, creating a vibrant ecosystem that champions creativity and engagement.  
  
With a foundation built on deep knowledge, courageous thinking, and brilliant ideas, SEEN Group is dedicated to transforming the beauty industry through strategic innovation and impactful marketing solutions. Whether through consumer insights, creative execution, or community engagement, SEEN Group remains at the forefront of beauty, driving success for brands worldwide.

What services does SEEN Group offer in the beauty industry?

SEEN Group offers a comprehensive range of services tailored specifically for the beauty industry. These include public relations (PR), creative content development, strategic communications, digital marketing, and event management. Our team of beauty experts collaborates closely with brands to create impactful strategies that enhance visibility and engagement in a competitive market.

How does SEEN Group approach creative content development?

At SEEN Group, we believe that creative content is at the heart of effective communication. Our approach involves understanding the unique identity of each brand and crafting compelling narratives that resonate with target audiences. We utilize innovative storytelling techniques, high-quality visuals, and strategic distribution to ensure that our content not only captures attention but also drives engagement and conversion.

What industries does SEEN Group specialize in?

While SEEN Group primarily focuses on the beauty industry, our expertise extends to related sectors such as wellness, fashion, and lifestyle. Our multidisciplinary team brings a wealth of experience from various industries, allowing us to provide tailored solutions that meet the specific needs of our clients, regardless of their market segment.

Can SEEN Group assist with digital marketing strategies?

Absolutely! SEEN Group offers a full suite of digital marketing services designed to elevate brands in the beauty sector. Our team specializes in social media management, influencer partnerships, search engine optimization (SEO), and targeted advertising campaigns. We leverage data-driven insights to create strategies that maximize online presence and drive measurable results.

SEEN Group organizes a variety of events tailored to the beauty industry, including product launches, brand activations, trade shows, and influencer gatherings. Our event management team ensures that every detail is meticulously planned and executed, creating memorable experiences that enhance brand visibility and foster meaningful connections with audiences.

How does SEEN Group measure the success of its campaigns?

SEEN Group employs a robust analytics framework to measure the success of our campaigns. We track key performance indicators (KPIs) such as engagement rates, media impressions, website traffic, and conversion metrics. By analyzing this data, we can assess the effectiveness of our strategies and make informed adjustments to optimize future campaigns for even greater impact.

About Thorp Precast Limited
---------------------------

Based in Staffordshire, we specialise in the design, manufacture and erection of architectural cladding and structural precast concrete components.  
  
The company occupies its own 25 acre site equipped with 16 cranes, casting beds and batching plant for the manufacture, handling and storage of large bespoke units.  
  
Structural components include production of vertically cast cross walls, beams, columns, slabs, stairs, bridge and terrace units. Bespoke pre-stressed units are also manufactured.  
  
Architectural components include brick, natural stone and granite faced panels; wet cast reconstituted stone cladding and dressings with a variety of finishes and colours.  
  
The company has a passion for producing high quality finished products on time and within budget.

About Kaduna State Government
-----------------------------

Kaduna, located in the north-central region of Nigeria, is one of the major states of the country. It is thought that Kaduna may have derived its name from the Gbayi ethnic group, who have lived there for centuries or from the Hausa word for crocodile, Kada.  
  
Home to a number of prestigious institutions, Kaduna is known as "The Centre of Learning". The Nigerian Defense Academy (NDA), Ahmadu Bello University (ABU), Nigerian College of Aviation (Zaria), Barewa College (1st English-speaking school in Northern Nigeria) and Nuhu Bamalli Polytechnic among others have their main campuses in Kaduna. Interestingly, the Nok tribe, one of Africa’s earliest civilizations also originates from Kaduna. Read More about the Nok Exhibition recently launched in Kaduna: https://dailytrust.com.ng/nok-exhibition-opens-in-kaduna.html  
  
From the colonial era to the contemporary period, Kaduna has maintained a reputation as a state with a huge pull factor. Myriad tribes around Nigeria have settled in Kaduna and called it their home for years. Till today, the state continues to cosmopolitan.  
  
Kaduna State is currently being governed by Governor Nasir el-Rufa'i who resumed office in May 2015.

About Epsom & Ewell Borough Council
-----------------------------------

Epsom & Ewell Borough Council is the smallest district in Surrey.  
  
We might be small, but we have big plans to serve our population of 80,000 residents. Our close location to London and great transport links make the Borough a great place to live, work and study.  
  
The Council employs a wide range of professions and experts, who deliver key services and projects, from recycling to planning, community support to finance and human resources.  
  
Our main office is located the iconic Town Hall in Epsom town centre. Some of our teams are based in a number of venues across Epsom including the Grade 2 listed Bourne Hall and the Epsom Playhouse.  
  
It is a very exciting time to join our teams at Epsom & Ewell Borough Council.  
  
Over the last months, we have developed stronger working relationships with partners, become more resilient, collaborated, adapted our processes to suit current needs and become more effective and agile in our ways of working.  
  
We have set ambitious targets to combat inequality, climate change and other issues affecting our residents. We strive to make Epsom and Ewell a successful place with a strong dynamic local economy where people can thrive. Now, more than ever, we take pride in the development and delivery of public services, and support equality of opportunity for all.  
  
If you have the passion and the drive to make a real difference and want to work in a caring and supportive environment, we really want to hear from you.

### Frequently Asked Questions about Loveology University

What types of coaching services does Loveology University offer?

Loveology University offers a variety of coaching services tailored to individual and couple needs. These include relationship coaching, life coaching, intimacy coaching, and career change coaching. Each program is designed to empower individuals and couples to enhance their emotional wellbeing, improve their relationships, and achieve personal growth.

Are the programs at Loveology University certified?

Yes, Loveology University provides certified programs, including the Sexpert Certification, which equips participants with the knowledge and skills necessary to support others in sexual health and relationship matters. Our certifications are designed to uphold high standards of education and practice in the fields of love, relationships, and sexual health.

What can I expect from a Loveology Retreat?

A Loveology Retreat offers a transformative experience focused on healing, personal growth, and relationship enrichment. Participants can expect a safe and nurturing environment where they will engage in workshops, group discussions, and individual coaching sessions. The retreats are designed to help attendees reconnect with themselves and their partners, enhance intimacy, and cultivate emotional wellbeing.

How does Loveology University address sexual health and education?

Loveology University emphasizes the importance of sexual health and education as part of its holistic approach to love and relationships. The programs include comprehensive sex education that covers topics such as sexual confidence, human sexuality, and emotional wellbeing. Our goal is to empower individuals with knowledge and skills to foster healthy and fulfilling sexual relationships.

Who can benefit from Loveology University’s services?

Loveology University’s services are designed for adults of all backgrounds who are seeking to improve their love lives, enhance their relationships, or undergo personal transformation. Whether you are single, in a relationship, or navigating a career change, our coaching and retreat programs can provide valuable insights and support tailored to your unique situation.

What is the philosophy behind Loveology University’s approach?

The philosophy of Loveology University is rooted in the belief that love and relationships are essential components of a fulfilling life. Our approach integrates mind, body, and spirit, focusing on emotional wellbeing, personal empowerment, and healing. We aim to create a sanctuary where individuals can explore their relationship dynamics, enhance their intimacy, and cultivate a deeper understanding of themselves and their partners.

About City of Thunder Bay
-------------------------

Located on the north shore of Lake Superior, under the protective watch of the Sleeping Giant, Thunder Bay is rich in people and resources, and connects Northwestern Ontario to the world. Thunder Bay has five Sister Cities through which economic development, education, friendship, goodwill, education, and tourism are promoted.  
  
We value our high quality of life and promote a clean, green, beautiful and healthy community that provides economic opportunity, respects diversity and provides affordable and safe neighbourhoods that are accessible to all. The 4th Annual Demographia International Housing Affordability Survey ranked Thunder Bay number one out of 227 international cities in Major Urban Markets for affordable housing.  
  
Thunder Bay is the largest community on Lake Superior. With a population of 109,140, it is the most populous municipality in Northwestern Ontario.  
  
The City of Thunder Bay provides a balance of services that improves our quality of life and supports our economy in a responsible manner. From parks and recreation to transportation, clean drinking water or waste management, Thunder Bay is always working to live up to our motto, Superior By Nature. To meet the future needs of our community, Thunder Bay is taking a strategic approach that makes the most of our City's strengths. Together, our community is working to achieve our top priorities:  
  
a stronger and more diversified economy  
a cleaner, greener, more beautiful and proud Thunder Bay  
a high quality of life, and  
being one of the best-run cities in Canada.

About Leading Edge Labels Limited
---------------------------------

Founded in 1997, Leading Edge is an award-winning UV Flexo Label & Packaging company based in Gravesend, Kent.  
  
With experience, expertise and a passion for print, our emphasis is on quality and innovation, partnered with excellent customer service and short lead-times.  
  
Serving a wide range of markets our customers include the Major Multiples (and other retail outlets), FMCG Brands, Promotional & Marketing Agencies to Own Label products.  
  
From self-adhesive labels, aerosol (ROSO) labels, shrink sleeves, backing films, blister and insert cards, specialist laminates, protag bottle neck tags and promotional labels (such as peel & reseal and multi-page booklet labels) to something that little bit different, our extensive portfolio of products can help enhance brands, add value and most importantly, help drive sales.  
  
All packaging products are printed using state of the art High Definition plate technology giving your packaging exceptional quality and a product that looks as you or your designer intended..  
  
Packaging can also be produced with in line, one pass decoration and effects including braille, emboss, silk screen, holographic, pearlised or matt effect inks and materials, laminates, glow in the dark, scented or unique numbering.  
  
With Quality at the fore front of everything we do, Leading Edge have consistently won a range of Awards for both business but also industry associated accolades, such as The European Flexographic Technical Association (EFTA). The most recent award was won for our exceptional print quality in comparison to Gravure print on a large consumer brands shrink sleeve product.  
  
As innovative labelling & packaging specialists, we are continually developing products therefore if you have a specific idea or brief in mind (however complex or obscure), we can help find a solution – if we don't already have one that fits the bill!!

Impressora Amazonense Ltda - IMPRAM is a leading graphic industry located in the Pólo Industrial de Manaus, Amazonas, Brazil. With a commitment to excellence, IMPRAM specializes in the production of high-quality packaging, manuals, and a wide range of printed materials on paper and paperboard, including options that are either laminated or combined with corrugated paper, which is also manufactured in-house. This comprehensive approach allows IMPRAM to cater to diverse sectors, including consumer goods, electronics, and pharmaceuticals, providing tailored packaging solutions that meet the unique needs of each industry.  
  
At IMPRAM, innovation and quality are at the forefront of operations. The company employs advanced printing technologies and sustainable practices to ensure that all products not only meet but exceed industry standards. By focusing on both national and international markets, IMPRAM aims to establish itself as a reference point in the graphic industry, not just in Amazonas but throughout Brazil. The company prides itself on valuing its employees, recognizing their skills and talents as essential components of its success. Through continuous improvement and a dedication to customer satisfaction, IMPRAM is poised to lead in the packaging and printing sector, delivering exceptional solutions that enhance brand visibility and product integrity.

About Geoff Carroll

Geoff Carroll serves as the Strategic Advisor for Marketing, Strategy, and Commercialization at Röckenwagner, where he is instrumental in elevating the brand's presence from a regional food service to a nationally recognized player in the artisan foods market. With a rich background in entertainment and consumer marketing, Geoff leverages his expertise to craft compelling consumer brand positioning and innovative product marketing strategies that resonate with diverse audiences. His work encompasses the development of comprehensive go-to-market plans, including impactful media strategies that have driven results exceeding $40 million.  
  
At Röckenwagner, Geoff is currently spearheading key projects that focus on product development roadmaps and franchise planning, ensuring that the culinary legacy of the brand is not only preserved but also expanded. His strategic insights into partnership and licensing—both outbound and inbound—have opened new avenues for growth and acquisition, positioning the brand for sustained success in a competitive landscape.  
  
Geoff’s proficiency in digital merchandising, particularly through platforms like Instacart, allows him to tap into the evolving e-commerce landscape, enhancing the brand's visibility and accessibility. Additionally, his experience with early-stage startups equips him with a unique perspective on growth hacking and market penetration strategies, making him a vital asset in navigating the complexities of the consumer packaged goods sector. With a focus on experiential marketing and event-driven strategies, Geoff is dedicated to creating memorable brand experiences that foster consumer loyalty and drive sales. His multifaceted skill set, combined with a passion for culinary excellence, positions him as a leader in transforming Röckenwagner into a household name in artisan foods.

Can Weller Healthcare IT help with the implementation of Epic Community Connect?

About WinCo Foods
-----------------

WinCo Foods is a family of employee-owned grocery stores, with its own distribution and transportation network. The company can trace its beginnings back to 1967 when Ralph Ward and Bud Williams founded a discount warehouse grocery store in Boise, Idaho under the name of Waremart. The company operated stores under the names of Waremart Food Centers and Cub Foods until 1999 when it changed its storefront name and the corporate name to WinCo Foods, which stands for Winning Company. WinCo Foods is currently owned by its employees.  
  
In 1985, the WinCo Foods Employee Stock Ownership Trust (Employee Pension Plan), headed by then president Bill Long and with full support of store personnel and management, purchased from the Ward family a majority interest of WinCo, giving WinCo employees a real ownership stake in the company. The company continued its rapid growth and by 2000 had replaced a majority of its retail stores with updated and expanded facilities.  
  
WinCo Foods currently has over 20,,000 employees and operates over 130 stores throughout Washington, Idaho, Nevada, California, Oregon, Utah, Arizona, Texas, Oklahoma and Montana.

About Ajanta Pharma Ltd
-----------------------

Ajanta Pharma Limited (APL) is a pharmaceutical company headquartered in Mumbai, India. It has strong presence in Branded Generic business in India & Emerging markets; and Generic business in USA.  
  
In India, company operates in selected therapeutic areas of Cardiology, Dermatology, Ophthalmology and Pain management. It's brands hold leadership positions in sub-therapeutic areas they are present in.  
  
In Emerging Markets, company has presence in Africa, South East Asia, West Asia, and CIS on broader therapeutic segments such as antimalarial, gastro, antibiotics, cardiology, dermatology, pain management, etc.  
  
As on 31st March 2023, Ajanta has 40 ANDA approvals which are commercialised. It holds 3 tentative approvals and 21 ANDAs are awaiting US FDA approval. Company plans to file 5-6 ANDAs during the current financial year.  
  
Company has state-of-the-art research facilities for formulation and API development located at Mumbai, India. R&D capabilities are evident from number of 1st to market products launched by the company providing patients most needed compliance and convenience. A dedicated and focused team of over 850 scientists work for R&D, which is growing continuously.  
  
Ajanta has 6 formulations manufacturing facilities located in India. Besides that, it also has an API manufacturing facility located at Waluj, India. Ajanta’s flagship formulation facilities at Paithan (Maharashtra, India) and Dahej (Gujarat, India) have been approved by US FDA.  
  
Ajanta continuously invests in enhancing the existing manufacturing facilities to meet current cGMP requirements and also construct new facilities to meet company’s growth requirements.  
  
Please visit https://ajantapharma.com/ for more information.

About Department of Health and Social Care
------------------------------------------

The Department of Health and Social Care helps people to live better for longer. We lead, shape and fund health and care in England, making sure people have the support, care and treatment they need, with the compassion, respect and dignity they deserve.  
  
The Department of Health and Social care sets the direction and coordinates action across the health and care system: public health and adult social care as well as the NHS. We create national policies and legislation, providing the long term vision and ambition to meet current and future challenges, and act as a global leader in health and care policy.  
  
We work with our partners to ensure everyone can access the health and care they need, from supporting people to have the best start in life, to staying in good health and, where that might not be possible, supporting people to live as independently as they can and ensuring they receive the best possible care. We want to instil a culture that values compassion, dignity and the highest quality of care.  
  
We support the integrity of the system by providing funding, assuring the delivery and continuity of services, and accounting to Parliament. We champion innovation and improvement by supporting research and technology, promoting honesty, openness and transparency.  
  
Above all, we encourage staff in every health and care organisation, including our own, to understand and learn from people’s experience of health and care and to apply this to everything we do.

About Pilgrim Furniture City
----------------------------

The Pilgrim Furniture City story begins in 1961. That’s the year Jay Albert opened Pilgrim Colonial Furniture in Bristol, Connecticut. Offering quality furniture at a reasonable price, Jay’s business was an immediate success. As the business grew, Jay’s son, Mike Albert worked at the store on weekends. After graduating from college, Mike joined the company full time in the late 1970s, eventually becoming president when Jay retired in 1984. Throughout the 80s and 90s Pilgrim continued to grow adding more product lines to meet the demands of its customers. An old Levitz store became available in nearby Southington, Connecticut.  
  
And so did Steve Bichunsky. Steve, a third generation retailer, learned the business from his father, Herb, owner of Meriden Auction Rooms. Steve’s sales and marketing experience was exactly what Mike was looking for in a partner. Together, Mike and Steve renovated the old Levitz store, and opened the all-new Pilgrim Furniture City in 2001. By moving their business to Southington, they went from a classic 30,000 square foot showroom to a magnificent 90,000 square foot showplace.  
  
With the opening of their Milford, Connecticut store, Mike and Steve were joined by a new managing partner, David Bassett. David brings 19 years of industry experience with Lane Home Furnishings, as well as his experience from his family’s furniture business, Scott Wayside, previously located outside of Boston.  
  
Pilgrim Furniture City now has four superstore locations totaling more than 280,000 square feet of floor space.  
  
In keeping with the business principles set down by Jay Albert back in 1961, Mike, Steve, and David are committed to quality merchandise, reasonable prices, and exceptional customer service. From the sales associates on the floor to the delivery team that arrives at your door, Mike, Steve, David and their 125 employees have that “whatever-it-takes” attitude that will make you a customer for life.

About Ecoprint / More Vang
--------------------------

Ecoprint has come a long way since our humble beginnings in 1977, when our shop was a press bolted to the floor of an old school bus. In those days, serving as the print shop for grassroots environmental organizations, mobility was the key. We have since settled permanently in Alexandria Virginia but have never forgotten the importance of placing environmental sustainability above all else.  
  
With services including, design and graphics, signage and large format production, digital and offset printing and a full service letter shop. Ecoprint offers a one-stop-shop for organizations large and small. And while we have grown considerably since our days on the bus, we still deliver services with the hallmark qualities for which we're known: Personal service, flexibility, clear and open communications. This way of doing business has worked for over 40 years and we believe it will work for 40 more. In fact, many of our clients come from referrals going back to some of our earliest days.  
  
Many industry leaders have been loyal customers for 20 years or more, Brands we work with include PEW Charitable Trust, Jane Goodall Institute, Born Free USA, American Wind Energy Association, Green America, Earthworks and The Nature Conservancy.  
  
Ecoprint's commitment to the environment is unparalleled. In 1989 we were one of the first printers to use recycled paper. In 1991 we were awarded a research grant from the EPA to create our unique metal-free "eco-ink". In 2003 we became the first U.S. Printer to use 100% wind energy. In 2005 we became the first U.S. print shop to become completely Carbon Neutral. Our reforestation efforts began in 2013 with our partnership with Forest Planet, Inc. a company that plants mangrove trees in deforested areas of Madagascar. For every single job order we donate two trees to help rebuild a sustainable environment.  
  
For more information, visit www.ecoprint.com

About Arthur Bell: Merged with Cohen & Company
----------------------------------------------

Arthur Bell has merged with Cohen & Company, an entrepreneurial accounting and advisory firm known for its strong mutual fund, exchange traded funds (ETFs), and private company service offerings. Combined, the two firms create the foremost accounting firm for registered and non-registered funds and their investment advisers within the industry. Under the Cohen & Company name, we become one of the top auditors of mutual funds, ETFs, and hedge funds in the country, and a Top 50 accounting firm servicing over 1,500 funds and over 1,500 businesses.  
  
For the past forty years, Arthur Bell has been dedicated to the alternative investment community, and we will continue to focus on the investment industry as the firm becomes part of Cohen & Company’s Investment Industry Services division. As the two firms share a parallel culture and vision, we will remain committed to the industry and our clients, and we will continue to provide the level of service that has become standard for our firm.

About Inland Publications, Inc.
-------------------------------

The Inlander is Spokane, Washington’s locally owned, independent and award-winning urban news weekly. New print issues are distributed for free every Thursday at nearly 1,000 locations throughout the Spokane-Coeur d’Alene region; it’s also available online at Inlander.com. Inlander also publishes Inlander Health & Home, a bi-monthly glossy lifestyle magazine, and Annual Manual, a regional guidebook published every September. Two glossy city guides, Shop Local (October) and The Menu (April) connect our active readers with the region’s best restaurants, coffee shops, bars and retailers. Our vibrant website and targeted emails, Entree, Weekend Countdown and Sneak Peek, help Inlanders know what shows, concerts, events and new restaurants are coming to the region. Inlander Winter Guide, published every October, highlights the extensive ski destinations in the Pacific Northwest and Canadian Rockies with an extensive distribution network throughout the West Coast.  
  
In addition to our award-winning publications, Inlander produces high-caliber events, like Inlander Restaurant Week. Restaurant Week features more than 100 restaurants offering three-course menus for a set price and has become one of the most anticipated community events of the year.  
  
Since 1993, Inlander has been an independent, family-owned media outlet. The Inlander was founded on independence — on the unwavering commitment that free and independent journalism helps a community thrive, that local ownership is best, and that, in the end, a paper belongs to everyone. The Inlander is our name, but it’s also an identity, a frame of mind, a people and a place, bound by geography and core community values. The people of the Inland Northwest, we are all Inlanders.

Marc Lipsitch is a renowned epidemiologist whose work has had a significant impact on the field of public health. He is currently a Professor of Epidemiology at the Harvard T.H. Chan School of Public Health, where he also serves as the Director of the Center for Communicable Disease Dynamics. Lipsitch's research focuses on the spread and control of infectious diseases, with a particular emphasis on emerging infectious diseases and vaccine-preventable diseases.  
  
Lipsitch's research has covered a wide range of topics, including the dynamics of transmission, the effectiveness of control measures, and the impact of vaccination on population-level immunity. His work has contributed to a better understanding of how infectious diseases spread within populations and has informed public health policies and practices.  
  
One of Lipsitch's most significant contributions to the field of epidemiology is his work on modeling the transmission of infectious diseases. His research has helped to develop mathematical models that can predict the spread of diseases, evaluate the impact of interventions, and inform decision-making in public health. These models have been used to inform responses to outbreaks of infectious diseases, such as the Ebola outbreak in West Africa and the COVID-19 pandemic.  
  
Lipsitch has also been a vocal advocate for the importance of vaccination in preventing the spread of infectious diseases. He has conducted research on the effectiveness of vaccines and the impact of vaccination on population-level immunity. His work has highlighted the importance of maintaining high levels of vaccine coverage to prevent outbreaks of vaccine-preventable diseases and has contributed to the development of strategies for improving vaccine uptake.  
  
In addition to his research, Lipsitch is also a dedicated educator, training the next generation of epidemiologists and public health professionals. He has mentored numerous students and postdoctoral researchers, many of whom have gone on to make significant contributions to the field of epidemiology. Lipsitch is also a sought-after speaker and has given lectures and presentations around the world, sharing his expertise and insights with a wide range of audiences.  
  
Lipsitch's work has earned him numerous accolades and awards, including election to the National Academy of Medicine and the American Academy of Arts and Sciences. He has also been recognized for his leadership in public health, receiving the Wade Hampton Frost Award from the American Public Health Association for his contributions to the field of epidemiology.  
  
In addition to his academic work, Lipsitch has also been an influential voice in public debates about infectious diseases and public health. He has been a frequent contributor to the media, providing expert commentary and analysis on issues such as vaccine hesitancy, the spread of infectious diseases, and the effectiveness of public health interventions. His ability to translate complex scientific concepts into accessible language has made him a trusted source of information for policymakers, journalists, and the public.  
  
Overall, Marc Lipsitch is a preeminent figure in the field of epidemiology, whose research has had a profound impact on our understanding of infectious diseases and how to control their spread. His work has informed public health policies and practices, helped to develop strategies for preventing and controlling infectious diseases, and inspired the next generation of epidemiologists. His dedication to advancing the field of epidemiology and his advocacy for evidence-based public health interventions have made him a respected and influential voice in the world of public health.

### Frequently Asked Questions about Northern Digital (NDI)

Who are the decision makers in Northern Digital Inc. (NDI)?

The decision makers in Northern Digital Inc. (NDI) are Scott Illsley, etc. Click to Find [Northern Digital Inc. (NDI) decision makers emails](https://contactout.com/dashboard/search?company=Northern%20Digital%20Inc.%20(NDI)&seniority=founder%7Cc_suite%7Cvice_president%7Cowner%7Cdirector)
.

What types of spatial measurement solutions does Northern Digital (NDI) offer?

Northern Digital (NDI) specializes in advanced spatial measurement solutions tailored for various medical applications. Our offerings include systems for ultrasound, endoscopy, orthopedics, radiation oncology, neurosurgery, and more. We provide technologies that support minimally invasive surgery, medical navigation, and augmented reality (AR) applications, ensuring precise tracking and measurement in complex medical environments.

How does NDI support OEM customers in the medical field?

NDI partners with OEM customers by providing customizable spatial measurement solutions that integrate seamlessly into their medical devices. Our expertise in low latency 3D tracking and 6 degrees of freedom (6DOF) measurement enables OEMs to enhance their products, improve surgical outcomes, and ultimately enhance patient care. We work closely with our clients to ensure our solutions meet their specific needs and regulatory requirements.

Can NDI's solutions be integrated with existing medical systems?

Yes, NDI's spatial measurement solutions are designed for ease of integration with existing medical systems. Our technologies can be adapted to work with a variety of imaging modalities and surgical instruments, allowing for smooth incorporation into current workflows. We provide comprehensive support during the integration process to ensure that our solutions enhance the functionality of existing systems.

What industries does NDI serve with its spatial measurement technologies?

NDI serves a wide range of industries within the medical field, including but not limited to orthopedic surgery, radiation oncology, interventional radiology, and dental surgery. Our technologies are also applicable in fields such as laparoscopic surgery, spinal surgery, and ENT procedures. By providing advanced measurement solutions, we aim to improve surgical precision and patient outcomes across these diverse medical specialties.

What are the benefits of using NDI's electromagnetic navigation systems?

NDI's electromagnetic navigation systems offer several benefits, including high accuracy, fast measurement rates, and the ability to track guidewires and catheters in real-time. These systems facilitate image-guided surgery, allowing surgeons to navigate complex anatomical structures with confidence. The low latency and high precision of our systems contribute to improved surgical outcomes and enhanced patient safety.

Does NDI offer training and support for its products?

Yes, NDI provides comprehensive training and support for all our products. We understand that effective implementation of our spatial measurement solutions is crucial for maximizing their benefits. Our training programs cover system operation, integration, and best practices in clinical settings. Additionally, our support team is available to assist with any technical inquiries or challenges that may arise during the use of our products.

About World Resources Institute
-------------------------------

WRI's mission is to move human society to live in ways that protect Earth’s environment and its capacity to provide for the needs and aspirations of current and future generations.  
  
We organize our work around six critical goals that the world must achieve this decade in order to secure a sustainable future:  
  
Climate: Protect communities and natural ecosystems from damage caused by greenhouse gas emissions, and generate opportunities for people by catalyzing a global transition to a low-carbon economy.  
  
Energy: Drive the scale-up of clean, affordable power systems throughout the world to deliver sustainable socio-economic development.  
  
Food: Ensure the world’s food systems reduce their impact on the environment, drive economic opportunity, and sustainably feed 9.6 billion people by 2050.  
  
Forests: Alleviate poverty, enhance food security, conserve biodiversity, and mitigate climate change by reducing forest loss and restoring productivity to degraded, deforested lands.  
  
Water: Achieve a water-secure future by mapping, measuring, and mitigating global water risks.  
  
Cities and Transport: Improve quality of life in cities by developing and scaling environmentally, socially, and economically sustainable urban and transport solutions.  
  
We design solutions for and analyze these six critical goals through the lenses of our three Centers of Excellence which focus on Governance, Business and Finance.

About San Bernardino County Workforce Development Board
-------------------------------------------------------

Formerly known as the Workforce Investment Board, the San Bernardino County Workforce Development Board (WDB) is comprised of private business representatives and public partners appointed by the San Bernardino County Board of Supervisors. The Workforce Development Board strengthens the skills of the County’s workforce through partnerships with business, education and community-based organizations. The San Bernardino County Board of Supervisors is committed to providing county resources, which generate jobs and investment. The Workforce Development Board, through San Bernardino County’s Economic Development Agency and Workforce Development Department, operates San Bernardino County’s three America’s Job Centers of California (AJCC). The AJCCs provide individuals with job training, placement and the tools to strengthen their career skills and achieve a higher quality of life. The AJCCs also support and provide services to the County’s businesses, including employee recruitment and business retention programs. Employers and job seekers who are interested in Workforce Development Board programs may call: (800) 451-JOBS or visitwww.csb-win.org. About Litho-Krome Company LLC
-----------------------------

Litho-Krome Company LLC is a world renowned lithographer and printer of Fine Art Reproductions, Gallery Wraps, and Greeting Cards. Founded in 1933, Litho-Krome believes that honesty, integrity, and quality for a competitive price, are paramount for successful business relationships. We focus on innovation within our processes to deliver market leading solutions to our partners. We have received many national and international awards over the years, including several of the distinguished Ben Franklin awards from the Printing Industries of the Americas. The Smithsonian Institute also maintains a permanent display of Litho-Krome prints as examples of excellent print reproduction. At Litho-Krome, we give each of our partners the professional courtesy and attention they deserve. We welcome the opportunity to serve you.

### Frequently Asked Questions about Litho-Krome Company LLC

What types of printing services does Litho-Krome Company LLC offer?

Litho-Krome Company LLC specializes in Fine Art Reproductions, Gallery Wraps, and Greeting Cards. Our lithography services ensure high-quality prints that capture the essence of the original artwork. We also provide finishing and converting services to enhance the final product, ensuring it meets the highest standards of quality.

Can Litho-Krome help with custom printing projects?

Yes, Litho-Krome is equipped to handle custom printing projects. Whether you need a unique size, specific materials, or specialized finishes, our team can work with you to bring your vision to life. We encourage you to reach out for a consultation to discuss your specific requirements.

What industries does Litho-Krome serve?

Litho-Krome serves a diverse range of industries, including art galleries, photographers, and businesses looking for high-quality printed materials. Our expertise in fine art printing makes us a preferred partner for artists and galleries, while our greeting card services cater to retailers and event planners.

How does Litho-Krome ensure the quality of its prints?

At Litho-Krome, we prioritize quality in every step of the printing process. We use state-of-the-art lithography techniques and high-quality materials to ensure that our prints are vibrant and durable. Additionally, our experienced team conducts thorough quality checks to maintain our commitment to excellence.

What is the turnaround time for printing projects at Litho-Krome?

Turnaround times at Litho-Krome can vary depending on the complexity and size of the project. Generally, we aim to complete standard orders within a few weeks. For custom projects or larger orders, we recommend contacting us directly to discuss timelines and ensure we meet your deadlines.

Does Litho-Krome offer any eco-friendly printing options?

Yes, Litho-Krome is committed to sustainability and offers eco-friendly printing options. We utilize environmentally responsible materials and processes wherever possible, including soy-based inks and recycled papers. Our goal is to provide high-quality prints while minimizing our environmental impact.

What services does ABCO Digital offer for enhancing customer engagement?

ABCO Digital offers a range of services designed to enhance customer engagement, including Web-to-Print solutions, Digital Print services, and Marketing Support. Our Web-to-Print platform allows businesses to create, customize, and order marketing materials easily, ensuring that your brand message is consistent and impactful. Additionally, our Digital Print services provide high-quality printing options that can be tailored to meet specific customer needs, helping you connect with your audience more effectively.

How can ABCO help with managing collateral and communications spend?

ABCO provides comprehensive Content Management solutions that give you a complete view of your collateral and communications spend. Our technology enables businesses to track and manage their marketing materials efficiently, ensuring that resources are allocated effectively. By utilizing our services, you can gain insights into spending patterns, optimize inventory levels, and reduce waste, ultimately leading to cost savings and improved ROI on your marketing efforts.

What industries does ABCO Digital support?

ABCO Digital supports a wide range of industries, including retail, healthcare, education, and corporate sectors. Our versatile services are designed to meet the unique needs of each industry, whether it's providing print solutions for promotional materials in retail or managing complex marketing campaigns in healthcare. Our expertise allows us to tailor our offerings to suit the specific requirements of different sectors, ensuring that our clients receive the best possible support.

What is the process for utilizing ABCO's Print-On-Demand services?

Utilizing ABCO's Print-On-Demand services is a straightforward process. First, you can upload your digital files to our Web-to-Print platform. From there, you can customize your materials as needed, selecting options such as size, paper type, and finish. Once your order is placed, our advanced printing technology ensures high-quality output, and we can ship directly to your desired location. This service is ideal for businesses looking to reduce inventory costs and respond quickly to changing marketing needs.

Does ABCO offer support for kitting and fulfillment services?

Yes, ABCO provides comprehensive Kitting and Fulfillment services. We can assemble various marketing materials, promotional items, or product samples into kits tailored to your specifications. Our fulfillment services ensure that these kits are packaged and shipped efficiently to your customers or event locations. This service streamlines your logistics and helps you deliver a cohesive experience to your audience, enhancing your marketing efforts.

Marisha Ray is a powerhouse in the world of voice acting, known for her incredible range and captivating performances. Hailing from the United States, Marisha has become a highly sought-after talent in the industry, earning a legion of dedicated fans who appreciate her exceptional abilities and charismatic personality.  
  
Born and raised in Louisville, Kentucky, Marisha Ray developed an early passion for acting and storytelling. From a young age, she immersed herself in various forms of creative expression, including theater and improv. This solid foundation allowed her to hone her skills while exploring different facets of the performing arts.  
  
Marisha's career in voice acting began to take shape in the early 2000s. Her unique vocal abilities and innate understanding of character psychology quickly caught the attention of industry professionals, leading to a string of prominent roles. One of her earliest breakthroughs came in 2008 when she voiced the enigmatic character of Ocean in the web series "There Will Be Brawl." This challenging role allowed Marisha to showcase her ability to bring complex and multifaceted characters to life.  
  
Since then, Marisha Ray's talent has only grown more prominent. She has lent her voice to numerous acclaimed animated series, becoming a familiar presence in the industry. Her ability to seamlessly transition between a broad range of characters, from fierce warriors to vulnerable heroines, has mesmerized both fans and critics alike.  
  
One of Marisha's most notable roles came as the voice of Keyleth in the beloved animated series "Critical Role." Her ability to capture the essence of the character, seamlessly navigating the emotional journey Keyleth experiences throughout the campaign, has earned her praise and adulation from fans around the world.  
  
In addition to her work in animation, Marisha Ray has also made a significant impact in the realm of video games. She has lent her voice to a wide variety of characters, showcasing her versatility and range. Some of her most notable video game credits include the role of Beauregard in "Pillars of Eternity II: Deadfire" and Aya in "Assassin's Creed Origins." Marisha injects life and depth into these characters, adding an extra layer of immersion and engagement to the gaming experience.  
  
Beyond her exceptional talent, Marisha Ray's infectious enthusiasm and genuine love for her craft have endeared her to fans and colleagues alike. She has embraced the world of Twitch streaming, connecting directly with her audience and inviting them to share in her creative journey. Her warm and relatable personality shines through as she engages in lively discussions and shares her passion for all things geek culture.  
  
Throughout her career, Marisha Ray has consistently demonstrated her ability to breathe life into characters, captivating audiences with her incredible voice acting skills. With a diverse body of work spanning animation and video games, she has established herself as one of the most talented and respected voice actors in the industry. This automation helps users save effortlessly and reach their financial goals faster.

About FOX40 News
----------------

KTXL hit the airwaves on October 26, 1968 and made a name for itself by producing programs such as “Captain Mitch,” “Big Time Wrestling” and “The Bob Wilkins Double Horror Show.”  
  
On October 9, 1986, it became an affiliate of the FOX network and branded itself as FOX40. FOX40’s commitment to “News That Matters” is a promise to our viewers that they matter to us. The station’s mission is to focus on the issues affecting our viewers by not just covering the story, but by digging deeper.  
  
Our drive for excellence includes producing award-winning journalism and offering our viewers creative and engaging content on all platforms. The station has won Associated Press awards, Edward R. Murrow awards, SPJ awards, and Emmys including an Emmy in June of 2019 for its podcast, “Exposed.”  
  
FOX40 Investigates dives into stories that affect our viewers, expose the truth and hold people accountable. FOX40: In Your Neighborhood is a station franchise that celebrates local communities we serve by highlighting the history and charm of the places so many of us call home. We are dedicated to covering local sports in our area with a special emphasis on young athletes which includes our high school football show, Final Quarter.  
  
FOX40 proudly partners with local and national organizations such as the Salvation Army, Shriners Hospitals for Children, Autism Speaks, and several others by hosting blood drives, collecting toys during the holiday season and filling backpacks with back to school supplies for children in need. Our approach clearly demonstrates our passion to lift, support and directly impact the families in our area. FOX40 and its website, fox40.com provide viewers in the Sacramento-Stockton-Modesto market local content across multiple platforms and provide our advertisers unmatched reach and custom marketing solutions.

I Haderslev Kommune gør vi vores bedste for at skabe gode rammer for borgere, erhvervsliv og uddannelse. Vi har gode levesteder, et væld af kulturelle tilbud, skøn natur og en masse spændende job i både private og offentlige virksomheder.  
  
Vi er en sønderjysk kommune med stolte traditioner, og vi samarbejder på en lang række områder med de øvrige sønderjyske kommuner. Siden januar 2016 har vi desuden været medlem af Trekantområdet. Den tætte beliggenhed til motorvejen betyder, at du på kort tid kan nå i en række virksomheder både mod nord, syd, øst og vest.  
  
I Haderslev Kommune er det aktive medborgerskab grundlaget for innovation og udvikling.  
  
Vi har cirka 5000 fagligt dygtige og engagerede medarbejdere, der hver dag bidrager til, at vi leverer en god service både over for kommunens 56.000 borgere men også for erhvervsliv, samarbejdspartnere og uddannelsesinstitutioner.  
  
Har du lyst til at blive en del af holdet, kan du se og søge vores ledige stillinger via www.haderslev.dk/jobs, hvor du også kan tilmelde dig vores jobagent.

About Michelman & Robinson, LLP
-------------------------------

M&R delivers client service excellence. That’s our mission and that’s just what we do.  
  
We are a full-service national law firm with offices in Los Angeles, Orange County (California), San Francisco, Chicago and New York City, and an unyielding commitment to diligently protect clients’ interests and ensure their successes. So how do we do it? With an approach to our clients and their legal work that’s simply different and – we believe – simply better.  
  
Client Inclusion  
  
At M&R, we handle matters in partnership with our clients. Be it a difficult class action case, a multi-party acquisition deal or anything in between, the firm is always mindful to include our clients in the process – from strategy to decision-making. This philosophy and practice of inclusion ensures that clients are continually engaged throughout our representation and aware of the twists and turns inherent in litigation and transactions. Where bombshells are the norm at many traditional law firms, at M&R, client inclusion means that uninvited (and oftentimes costly) surprises are kept to a bare minimum.  
  
Industry Focus  
  
Our nuanced understanding of client industries – which include Advertising & Digital Media, Financial Services, Health Care, Hospitality, Insurance, Juvenile Products and Retail and Apparel – also exemplifies our work. We know that our uncompromising attention to detail and preparation is critical to the firm’s successful representation of clients, as is our unrivaled command of law and procedure. But we also know that’s not enough to meet our clients’ exacting standards, which require an in-depth and practical grasp of their businesses.  
  
Without fail, the firm’s mantras – client inclusion and industry focus – work to our clients’ advantage. We call it the M&R Advantage.  
  
Join us on Facebook:  
www.facebook.com/michelmanrobinson/

About RedEnvelope, Inc.
-----------------------

RedEnvelope is an online ecommerce site which offers unique and personalized gifts for life’s special occasions. RedEnvelope is a part of Provide Commerce, a premier $700 million ecommerce company that operates with well-known brands like ProFlowers, Shari’s Berries, Cherry Moon Farms, Personal Creations, and ProPlants. Provide Commerce is wholly owned subsidiary of Liberty Media Corporation (NASDAQ: LINTA).  
  
The RedEnvelope business unit was acquired out of bankruptcy by Provide Commerce in 2008. The initial focus was to make RedEnvelope a profitable business unit, which occurred within the first 18 months of managing the business. RedEnvelope is known for its iconic “Red Box”, which serves to symbolize the emotional connection between gift giver and recipient through a great gifting experience. RedEnvelope is generally considered to have the highest brand name recognition amongst Provide Commerce brands.  
  
The RedEnvelope team is focused on developing unique and high quality products that help create a “wow” gifting experience. We have invested in expanding our new product development to increase the depth and frequency of product introductions, and have expanded into new categories that resonate with our target customers. We are looking to evolve our marketing practices as today’s digital landscape continues transform our efforts to focus more on finding and connecting with passionate gift-givers, and offering them a tailored and convenient shopping experience.

About SUNY Westchester Community College
----------------------------------------

SUNY Westchester Community College, located at 75 Grasslands Rd, Valhalla, New York, is the largest educational institution in Westchester County and plays a vital role in the community. Founded in 1946 as the New York State Institute of Applied Arts and Sciences, the college has evolved significantly over the decades. In 1957, it moved to its current expansive campus, which spans 218 acres of the historic John Hartford estate. Today, SUNY Westchester Community College serves approximately 12,000 full- and part-time college credit students, with a total enrollment exceeding 24,000 when including continuing education participants.  
  
The college is committed to providing accessible education and fostering personal and professional growth through its diverse programs. Its Continuing Education Division is the largest in the entire SUNY system, offering a wide range of courses for individuals of all ages, from career development to personal enrichment. Additionally, the college provides customized training for local businesses and hosts a vibrant arts and culture series that engages the broader community.  
  
Financial aid is a priority at SUNY Westchester Community College, with nearly one-third of students receiving assistance. The Westchester Community College Foundation contributes significantly, offering $1 million in scholarships annually to support students in achieving their educational goals. For those interested in the academic environment, the college boasts a dedicated faculty, and prospective students may seek a SUNY Westchester Community College teachers list to explore the diverse expertise available. Overall, SUNY Westchester Community College stands as a cornerstone of education and opportunity in Westchester County, enriching the lives of its students and the community at large.

What types of degree programs does SUNY Westchester Community College offer?

SUNY Westchester Community College offers a wide range of degree programs, including associate degrees in arts, sciences, and applied sciences. Students can choose from various fields such as business, health sciences, liberal arts, engineering technology, and more. Additionally, the college provides certificate programs and continuing education courses to help students enhance their skills and advance their careers.

How can I apply for financial aid at SUNY Westchester Community College?

To apply for financial aid at SUNY Westchester Community College, students should complete the Free Application for Federal Student Aid (FAFSA) form. The college's financial aid office provides guidance on the application process, eligibility requirements, and available financial aid options, including grants, scholarships, and loans. It's recommended to apply early to maximize financial aid opportunities.

What support services are available for students at SUNY Westchester Community College?

SUNY Westchester Community College offers a variety of support services to help students succeed academically and personally. These services include academic advising, tutoring, counseling, career services, and accessibility services for students with disabilities. The college also hosts workshops and events to promote student engagement and well-being.

Does SUNY Westchester Community College offer online courses?

Yes, SUNY Westchester Community College offers a selection of online courses and degree programs to accommodate students who prefer flexible learning options. These online courses are designed to provide the same quality of education as in-person classes, allowing students to complete coursework at their own pace while still receiving support from instructors and peers.

What opportunities are available for transferring to a four-year university after attending SUNY Westchester Community College?

Students at SUNY Westchester Community College have numerous opportunities to transfer to four-year universities. The college has established transfer agreements with several institutions, which facilitate the transfer of credits and ensure that students meet the requirements for their chosen bachelor's degree programs. Academic advisors are available to assist students in planning their transfer path and selecting appropriate courses.

How can I get involved in extracurricular activities at SUNY Westchester Community College?

SUNY Westchester Community College encourages student involvement in extracurricular activities to enhance the college experience. Students can join various clubs and organizations, participate in student government, and engage in community service projects. The college also hosts events, workshops, and cultural activities throughout the year, providing opportunities for students to connect with peers and develop leadership skills.

About Capitol Television News Service (CTNS)
--------------------------------------------

For nearly two decades, Capitol Television News Service (CTNS) has been providing television news rooms with coverage of State Capitol activities, features and major breaking stories in the region. Our staff camera crews and reporters cover the Capitol Monday through Friday preparing an average 4 to 5 stories daily. Those stories, VO, SOTs and occasionally package reports are fed via Ku band satellite from our headquarters in downtown Sacramento.  
  
Subscribers to the service get a morning rundown of the planned coverage. Around mid-day, a final rundown is sent out. Script and other information is provided in mid-afternoon. Subscribers can download windows media and MPEG2 files of our daily stories as well. CTNS also sells stories individually from the feed or from our extensive library. We can feed these stories via Ku or C band satellite or via Vyvx (fiber optic).  
  
Contact Karen Ross for subscription information.

Brown, Goldstein & Levy, LLP is a versatile law firm that specializes in a wide range of legal areas. Our practice includes criminal defense, appeals, family law, health care law, class actions, special education, business disputes, disability rights, professional malpractice, wage and hour violations, LGBT rights, housing discrimination, defense of professional licenses, and issues related to the Randolph-Sheppard Act. This diverse expertise allows us to effectively represent clients in various legal matters.

How does Brown, Goldstein & Levy, LLP approach criminal defense cases?

Our approach to criminal defense is rooted in a commitment to protecting our clients' rights and ensuring they receive a fair trial. We thoroughly investigate the circumstances of each case, gather evidence, and develop a robust defense strategy tailored to the specific charges. Our experienced trial lawyers are skilled in negotiation and litigation, enabling us to pursue the best possible outcomes, whether through plea deals or courtroom trials.

Can Brown, Goldstein & Levy, LLP assist with appeals?

Yes, we have a dedicated team that specializes in handling appeals. If you believe that a trial court made an error in your case, our attorneys can review the case details, identify potential grounds for appeal, and represent you in the appellate court. We understand the complexities of the appeals process and are committed to advocating for our clients' rights at every stage.

What services do you offer for individuals facing housing discrimination?

At Brown, Goldstein & Levy, LLP, we take housing discrimination seriously. We provide legal representation for individuals who believe they have been subjected to unfair treatment based on race, color, national origin, religion, sex, familial status, or disability. Our attorneys will work diligently to investigate your claim, gather evidence, and pursue appropriate legal action to ensure your rights are protected under federal and state housing laws.

How does your firm support clients with disabilities?

We are committed to advocating for the rights of individuals with disabilities. Our services include representation in cases involving disability rights, such as discrimination claims, access to public services, and compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA). We work closely with our clients to understand their unique situations and provide tailored legal solutions that empower them to assert their rights.

What is the Randolph-Sheppard Act, and how can your firm assist?

The Randolph-Sheppard Act is a federal law that provides individuals who are blind with the opportunity to operate vending facilities on federal property. At Brown, Goldstein & Levy, LLP, we offer legal assistance to individuals and organizations seeking to understand their rights and obligations under this act. Our attorneys can help navigate the application process, address disputes, and ensure compliance with the law to promote equitable opportunities for individuals with visual impairments.

About Business Today
--------------------

Based in Princeton, NJ and run entirely by Princeton University undergraduates, Business Today, also known as the Foundation for Student Communication, is a nonprofit that aims to be the leading forum for student-executive interaction. Originally founded as a magazine in 1968, BT hopes to create a platform for current and future business leaders to offer thought-provoking (and sometimes provocative) insights into the world around us. BT sees this dialogue as vital for the development of future leaders, and equally inspiring for the business leaders of today.  
  
BT believes in a business world accessible to everyone. We pride ourselves on our expenses-paid events such that financial need is never a barrier for our student participants. Our International Conference draws thousands of applicants every year to be selected for and flown into New York for a 3-day event, culminating in keynotes and seminars by over 80 executives and students representing 30 different countries, and our newest conference, Design Nation, provides a forum for students to learn about the world of design. Our publications, the Magazine and Online Journal (http://journal.businesstoday.org), solicit interview questions from students, and undergrads are encouraged to write articles through a summer journalism fellowship. For the Princeton community, BT holds an on-campus Seminars Series with business leaders and off-campus Breakout trips to explore a specific sector or city. BT aims to engage as many people as possible surrounding our cause by creating programs and content of the highest professional quality.

The George Washington University Law School, established in 1865, proudly holds the title of the oldest law school in Washington, DC. Nestled in the vibrant Foggy Bottom neighborhood, the school is situated at 2000 H Street NW, providing students with a unique opportunity to study law in the heart of the nation’s capital. Accredited by the American Bar Association and a charter member of the Association of American Law Schools, GW Law is committed to academic excellence and the development of future legal leaders.  
  
GW Law offers a comprehensive curriculum that emphasizes practical skills and experiential learning, preparing students for diverse careers in law, public policy, and beyond. The faculty comprises distinguished scholars and practitioners who bring a wealth of knowledge and experience to the classroom. For those interested in exploring the faculty's expertise, a detailed teachers list is available, showcasing the diverse backgrounds and specialties of the professors who guide students through their legal education.  
  
With a strong focus on public interest law, international law, and intellectual property, GW Law provides a rich array of programs and resources that cater to the evolving needs of the legal profession. The school's strategic location allows students to engage with influential legal institutions, government agencies, and nonprofit organizations, enhancing their educational experience and professional networks. As a leader in legal education, The George Washington University Law School continues to shape the future of law through its commitment to innovation, diversity, and social justice.

About Bajaj Auto Ltd
--------------------

A journey that began 75 years ago in a corner of India and has since traversed the world over. Uniting people from across countries, cultures, customs over the years with a multitude of different dreams, there's power in an idea. An idea that gave rise to brands that stood the test of time, with partnerships it inspired, and the people who made it all happen. One idea that sparked a legacy - this is the story of Bajaj Auto.  
  
“Do what you think is best, but be the best in what you do.” – Kamalnayan Bajaj  
  
These words embody the spirit of Bajaj Auto. From 1945 to today, from “Hamara Bajaj” to “The World’s Favourite Indian”- the most loved motorcycle brands in almost 80 countries, Bajaj Auto carries its rich legacy and unconventional thinking, with a penchant for staunch differentiation.  
  
This philosophy has helped us be No.1 or No.2 in over 20 countries with industry-leading EBITDA of ~20%. Some statistics that reflect our strength:  
  
• A Zero Debt 3.5 Billion Dollar Company  
• Word’s largest three-wheeler manufacturer and third largest two-wheeler manufacturer  
• India’s Number 1 motorcycle exporter – 2 out of every 3 motorcycles exported are Bajaj  
• Single largest exporter of Branded Goods – exporting 50% of India’s two and three-wheelers  
• Over 40% revenue from International markets with 15+ million motorcycles sold  
  
With powerful brands, our spectrum ranges from Boxer in Africa to KTM in Europe, from Rouser in Latin America to Pulsar in India, our versatility is evident. International alliances with KTM, Husqvarna, and Triumph has ensured that our horizons are broadened.  
  
A pioneer in motorcycle technology, our R&D is world-class with talent from all corners of the globe with TPM being the prime mover of productivity for the last 25 years. From lean manufacturing, we have now moved to lean engineering & lean marketing, which has led to globally competitive fixed costs.  
  
With ever-expanding plans to win over the world, the sun truly never sets on a Bajaj Motorcycle.

Computer Forms, Inc. produces business checks, forms, corporate communications products, and promotional product items.  
  
Superior Screen Systems (Tri-S) specializes in direct screen printing on glass, plastic or metal bottles and jars. Tri-S also specializes in custom printing on glassware for wine, beer and spirits.  
  
Isoprint specializes in medical component printing. We are ISO 9001:2000 compliant.  
  
At CFI, we practice sustainability. We are committed to working with our customers, employees and suppliers to help promote sustainability, reduce waste, and keep our planet clean. About MOSCHINO
--------------

It was 1983 when Franco Moschino presented his first women's collection during Milan fashion week.  
The success he achieves by bringing his ideas and his way of seeing fashion on the catwalk is unparalleled.  
The years passed and Franco Moschino remained on the crest of the wave, to the point that in 1985 he added a men's prêt-à-porter line to the women's collections.  
Making fashion affordable for everyone, creating unconditionally and making sure everyone can enjoy it: this is the philosophy of the designer, this is what he worked for every day.  
  
His sacrifices and ideals took life concretely in 1988, when Franco Moschino launched a new brand Cheap and Chic woman and Cheap and Chic man.  
A revolutionary clothing line in every way, especially in the price. Cheap and affordable for anyone who could appreciate his style and his way of doing fashion.  
His vision of fashion was in contrast to the surrounding atmosphere. In 1991 he stopped the catwalk, cause the year after he took the ecological and moral choice to launch a provocative decision for an advertising campaign.  
  
A determined man, out of the ordinary and extremely imaginative, Franco Moschino succeeds in giving fashion a wave of novelty: “playing and having fun” while keeping his feet on the ground was his motto.  
In 1994, just over ten years after the birth of his Maison, Franco Moschino was seized by a heart attack and died.  
The creative direction is entrusted to Rossella Jardini, the right arm of the designer. 1999 is the year of change. The company is taken over by Aeffe who, as a first commitment, requires opening boutiques throughout the world.  
October 28th 2013 is a date to remember at Moschino: after 19 years of creative direction, Rossella Jardini gives the baton to the young, talented designer Jeremy Scott.
