About Tutor Doctor
------------------

Tutor Doctor is the fastest growing and top ranked in-home education franchise on the market.  
  
Why?  
  
Years ago, parents were expected to play taxi driver and haul their children who needed tutoring help across town, where they would sit in yet another classroom-type setting.  
  
Never mind that these kids were struggling because of the classroom setting. Never mind that the family had to break up their time at home, so Sally could get the help she needed. Never mind that the families’ bank accounts dwindled because of the expensive, inconvenient tutoring franchises that were out there.  
  
In 2003, when we saw how successful our in-home education business was working for us, we turned to franchising to give students across the globe a fighting chance at success.  
  
It occurred to us that the biggest way we could help these struggling students was to make it as easy on them as we made it on their parents.  
  
We meet students in their homes, on their schedules, and price it so that not only wealthy families can afford the educational advantage tutoring offers.  
  
We have worked tirelessly to develop a model to figure out a way to give business owners who were interested in making a difference in the lives of children and their families a means to do just that, without actually being a tutor themselves.  
  
Today, we have over 500 units in 16 countries and have helped almost 300,000 individuals around the world! We give a FREE consultation to evaluate the possible tutor/student relationship, to build a personalized map for the student’s success.  
  
Because this approach is so powerful, 7 out of 10 consultations close with an average enrollment value of $2,346 and a 59% profit margin, making our tutoring business one of the most successful and fastest-growing on the market.  
  
And because we don’t build brick and mortar classrooms for students to sit in, our in-home tutoring franchisees are some of the most profitable franchisees you’ll find.

It is currently undertaking 21 real estate projects – 12 Integrated Townships, 3 Group Housing, 6 Commercial Malls/office spaces/Hotels/ SCOs. The company is present in 27 cities across 8 states namely Delhi, UP, MP, Punjab, Haryana, Uttarakhand, Rajasthan & Himachal Pradesh.  
  
Omaxe has successfully blended business excellence with social commitment. Omaxe Foundation takes up many CSR projects in the field of health, education, community development etc.

D'Angelo Russell, the American basketball point guard, is a force to be reckoned with on the court. However, it is his skill, talent, and passion for the game that truly set him apart.  
  
Born on February 23, 1996, in Louisville, Kentucky, Russell's love for basketball was evident from a young age. He honed his skills on the courts of his hometown, where he quickly rose to prominence as a standout player. His exceptional speed, agility, and court vision earned him accolades and caught the attention of scouts across the country.  
  
After an impressive high school career, Russell committed to playing college basketball at Ohio State University. During his freshman year, he quickly made his mark as a dynamic playmaker, leading the Buckeyes in scoring and assists. His ability to control the game from the point guard position was evident, as he orchestrated plays with precision, made quick decisions, and showcased his court awareness.  
  
Following an exceptional freshman season, Russell declared for the 2015 NBA Draft, where he was selected as the second overall pick by the Los Angeles Lakers. His arrival in the NBA was highly anticipated, and he did not disappoint. In his rookie season, Russell averaged 13.2 points, 3.4 rebounds, and 3.3 assists per game, displaying his scoring ability and playmaking skills. As his career progressed, Russell continued to develop and refine his game. Known for his smooth ball-handling skills and exceptional shooting range, he became a threat from anywhere on the court. Whether knocking down three-pointers or driving to the hoop with finesse, Russell proved to be a versatile scorer. His ability to create his own shot and find open teammates drew comparisons to some of the game's greatest point guards.  
  
In 2017, Russell was traded to the Brooklyn Nets, where he had the opportunity to become a leader and focal point of the team. Embracing the challenge, he elevated his game to new heights. During the 2018-2019 season, Russell earned his first All-Star selection, averaging 21.1 points and 7.0 assists per game. He became the face of the Nets franchise, leading a young and talented roster to the playoffs for the first time in four years.  
  
Off the court, Russell's magnetic personality and charisma have made him a favorite among fans. He is known for his infectious smile, engaging with fans, and embracing his role as a mentor to younger players. Russell's on-court success and off-court likability have made him a marketable figure, landing him endorsement deals with major brands.  
  
In 2019, Russell joined the Golden State Warriors, where he continued to excel and demonstrate his versatility as a player. Despite a season filled with injuries, Russell's skill set shone through, providing a glimpse of his potential alongside his new teammates. His ability to adapt to different systems and mesh with different playing styles is a testament to his basketball IQ and dedication to his craft.  
  
Throughout his career, Russell has faced both triumphs and challenges, but through it all, he has remained resilient and determined. His passion for the game is evident in his every move on the court, inspiring teammates and fans alike. As he continues to grow and evolve as a player, one thing is certain: D'Angelo Russell is a player to watch, a young talent poised to make a lasting impact on the game of basketball.

About Dura-ID Solutions Limited
-------------------------------

Dura-ID Solutions are the product of an amalgamation merger between IML Labels & Systems, Longcombe Labels and Leedmarque Labels & Print all with the same one goal, to be the solution.  
  
We are global innovators in the manufacture of industrial labels and label printing. Whatever your industry, we have the labelling solution for you. We manufacture high performance labels and tags for tracking and traceability, identification, health & safety, conformity, compliance and distribution in challenging environments.  
  
Dura-ID offers a wide range of high quality materials including extremely specialised products suitable for use in extreme temperatures of up to +1000 degrees Celsius, as well as long-term waterproof, weatherproof and virtually indestructible industrial strength non-tear products.  
  
As well as been the approved supplier for the NeuraLabel 550e laser printer and consumables throughout Europe, Dura-ID also supplies label printers, software packages and thermal transfer ribbons to complement its labelling range. Dura-ID's dedicated Systems Team offer tailor-made servicing and maintenance contracts on printing systems, as well as a wealth of knowledge and expertise for businesses wishing to move into in-house labelling.  
  
We supply labelling software which can be downloaded as a free 30 day trial - See here for the link: https://dura-id.com/hardware-software/software/  
  
Dura-ID has over 80 years’ experience in product identification for a wide range of market sectors including:  
  
\- Steel and other metals  
\- Chemicals (including GHS and CLP regulatory labels)  
\- Construction  
\- Timber  
\- Healthcare  
\- Waste management  
\-Horticulture  
\- Compliance testing  
  
Dura-ID’s team of dedicated professionals have the knowledge and experience to export labels and tags on a global scale.  
  
Dura-ID runs on the ethics of providing excellent service, high quality goods, competitive pricing and 100% customer support.

About Landa Digital Printing
----------------------------

Landa Digital Printing has developed a unique digital technology called Nanography® – a new category of printing for the commercial, packaging and publishing markets. Nanography bridges the critical profitability gap between offset and digital printing, and enables printers to cost-effectively produce short-to-medium run lengths for the first time.  
  
Nanography was invented by Benny Landa, father of digital printing and inventor of the first digital press in 1993. About a decade ago, in the course of researching nanotechnology for energy use, Benny discovered that nanopigments had unique qualities and could produce unprecedented results in printing. Landa Digital Printing was established to commercialize his technological breakthrough and to ignite a second digital revolution in print.  
  
Landa Digital Printing is a division of the Landa Group and is located in Rehovot in the center of Israel.

About Paradise Post Printing
----------------------------

Paradise Post Printing is an award winning, full service commercial printing company that employs 100 quality conscious employees. It was started in 1981 as an extension of the newspaper operation to fully utilize the company's printing equipment and production staff. As the demand for its printing services increased, a series of major capital investments were made throughout the 80's and 90's that included additional press, bindery, and prepress equipment, and the additional square footage necessary to house the rapidly growing operation.  
  
For many years Paradise Post Printing has been a dominant force in the Northern California market because of its reputation for high quality work and superior customer service. Paradise Post Printing is truly a commercial printing company and not just another newspaper that prints commercial work. We are the only printing company in Northern California to offer heatset web in combination with coldset web simultaneously through the same folder.  
  
Paradise Post Printing offers a full spectrum of quality web printing products and additional services that provide a complete turnkey solution for its loyal and diverse customers.

What types of legal services does Collins Hannafin P.C. offer?

Collins Hannafin P.C. offers a wide range of legal services, specializing in areas such as Creditor's Rights, Condominium Law, Divorce Mediation, Employment Law, Personal Injury Law, Elder Law, Civil Litigation, Family Law, Business and Commercial Law, Workers Compensation Law, Foreclosure Law, Land Use and Real Estate Development Law, and Trust and Estate Law. How can I schedule a consultation with Collins Hannafin P.C.?

To schedule a consultation with Collins Hannafin P.C., you can visit our website and fill out the contact form, or you can call our office directly at the provided phone number. Our team will assist you in setting up an appointment that fits your schedule and addresses your legal needs.

During your first consultation at Collins Hannafin P.C., you can expect a thorough discussion of your legal issue. This initial meeting is an opportunity for you to assess whether our services align with your needs.

Does Collins Hannafin P.C. handle cases involving personal injury?

Our goal is to help you seek compensation for medical expenses, lost wages, and other damages resulting from your injury.

What is the process for resolving a divorce through mediation?

Divorce mediation at Collins Hannafin P.C. involves a structured process where both parties work with a neutral mediator to discuss and negotiate the terms of their divorce. The mediator facilitates communication, helps identify issues, and guides the couple toward mutually agreeable solutions regarding child custody, property division, and other relevant matters. This approach aims to minimize conflict and promote a more amicable resolution.

About Wellcome Trust Centre for Human Genetics, University of Oxford
--------------------------------------------------------------------

The Wellcome Trust Centre for Human Genetics (WTCHG) was established in 1994 to undertake research into the genetic basis of common diseases. Since June 1999 the Centre has been located in the Henry Wellcome Building of Genomic Medicine, University of Oxford.  
  
The scientific objective of the Centre is to explore all aspects of the genetic susceptibility of disease including the localisation of genes involved in common diseases, characterisation of the variants responsible for susceptibility, the understanding of how these DNA variants may contribute to risk of disease in the population and finally, how such genetic factors contribute biologically to a disease process.  
  
The Centre houses multi-disciplinary research teams in human genetics, functional genomics, bioinformatics, statistical genetics and structural biology.

About Basic Orange
------------------

Basic Orange bestaat sinds 1995 en heeft dus bijna 25 jaar online ervaring in huis. Wat ooit begon als de eerste Nederlandse webshop voor muziekcd’s, groeide uit tot een succesvol full-service webbureau in hartje Amsterdam. Ons team bestaat inmiddels uit 25 specialisten in uiteenlopende kennisgebieden, waaronder consultancy, concept en interaction design, programming, support, hosting, optimalisatie en personalisatie.  
  
Onze klantenkring is breed en bestaat onder andere uit veel organisaties en bedrijven in de culturele, zorg- en financiële sector. We helpen onze klanten hun doelgroepen effectief te bereiken en te bedienen met creatieve oplossingen. Het gedrag en de behoeften van gebruikers staan hierbij altijd centraal. We maken op maat gemaakte gepersonaliseerde websites, die zich aanpassen aan het gedrag van individuele gebruikers. Zo geven we samen met onze opdrachtgevers invulling aan bijzondere klantervaringen.  
  
Basic Orange is partner van Umbraco, Microsoft, Google, Spotler en Scrum Alliance. Verder werken we samen met een uitgebreid netwerk van copywriters, marketeers, content managers, social media experts en fotografen.  
  
Meer weten over ons en onze klantcases? Kom langs voor een kopje koffie of bekijk https://www.basicorange.nl/

At Trader Joe's, you won’t find a lot of branded items. Instead, you’ll discover a store full of unique and interesting products, along with everyday basics, in the Trader Joe's label.  
  
Our buyers travel the world searching for products we think are exceptional and will find a following among our customers. To earn a spot on our shelves, each product is submitted to a rigorous tasting panel process, in which every aspect of quality is investigated in context of the price we can offer. If a product is assessed as an outstanding value, it becomes an essential part of the Trader Joe's shopping adventure.  
  
We know that maintaining our everyday focus on value is vital, which is why we don’t have sales, we don’t offer coupons, and there are no loyalty programs or membership cards to swipe at our stores. Trader Joe’s believes every customer should have access to the best prices on the best products every day.

About GL Seaman & Company
-------------------------

GL Seaman & Company, a MillerKnoll Certified Dealer, is a greater Dallas-Fort Worth leader in contract furniture and interior construction solutions. Our partners include Knoll, Herman Miller, DIRTT Environmental Solutions, and more than 200 additional manufacturers.  
  
As one of the largest full-service dealers in the Southwestern United States, we manage numerous global, national, and regional projects for some of the nation’s best-known companies. We’ve also been recognized for excellence in all phases of our operations.  
  
THE GL SEAMAN DIFFERENCE   
When our company was founded in 1984, the philosophy was to lead our product offering with extraordinary furniture from high-end manufacturers to accommodate all corporate environments. We chose to be a support arm to the architectural and design community, a commitment we maintain to this day. We also assembled an in-house installation team to ensure the quality of those services and enhance the overall customer experience. As always, GL Seaman will not delegate the planning or execution of any project to a third party. We insist on utilizing our own experts for all furniture-related services, including planning, order management, project management, installation, and maintenance. This unique business model enables us to deliver the extraordinary service and consistency that our customers have relied upon for more than 38 years.  
  
GL Seaman & Company is a woman-owned and managed business and has received WBENC, NCTRCA and HUB certifications.   
  
Learn more at www.glsc.com.

About BOYS & GIRLS CLUBS OF GREATER MILWAUKEE
---------------------------------------------

The mission of Boys & Girls Clubs of Greater Milwaukee is to inspire and empower all young people, especially those who need us most, to realize their full potential as productive, caring, responsible citizens.  
  
While all young people are welcome between the ages of 5 and 18, we place special emphasis on serving young people from disadvantaged circumstances. We are strategically located in areas with the greatest need. The majority of our members are children of color who come from single parent, low-income households in urban neighborhoods.  
  
All programs and initiatives fall within at least one of six core service areas: Character & Leadership Development; Education & Career Development; Sports, Fitness & Recreation; The Arts; Health & Life Skills; and Outdoor & Environmental Education.  
  
For more information about the Clubs, as well as locations, program, donor and volunteer information, please visit our website at www.boysgirlsclubs.org, find us on Facebook at www.facebook.com/bgcmilwaukee or follow us on Twitter at www.twitter.com/bgcmilwaukee.

\- Print-On-Demand (POD), including books  
\- An array of printing services, including digital, wide-format and offset  
\- Customized integrations, storefronts and workflows to fit individual business needs  
\- A variety of bindery and finishing services

About MobileIron
----------------

MobileIron is redefining enterprise security with the industry’s first mobile-centric security platform for the Everywhere Enterprise. In the Everywhere Enterprise, corporate data flows freely across devices and servers in the cloud, empowering workers to be productive anywhere they need to work. To secure access and protect data across this perimeter-less enterprise, MobileIron leverages a zero trust approach, which assumes bad actors are already in the network and secure access is determined by a “never trust, always verify” model.  
  
MobileIron’s platform combines award-winning and industry-leading unified endpoint management (UEM) capabilities with passwordless MFA (Zero Sign-On) and mobile threat defense (MTD) to validate the device, establish user context, verify the network, and detect and remediate threats to ensure that only authorized users, devices, apps, and services can access business resources in a “work from everywhere” world. Over 20,000 organizations, including the world’s largest financial institutions, intelligence agencies, and other highly regulated companies, have chosen MobileIron to enable a seamless and secure user experience in the Everywhere Enterprise.

Quint was founded in 2009 to explore the market opportunity of consumer credit and financial services moving to online and tech enabled operating models. Over the last decade, Quint has built and scaled a number of leading Fintechs and now owns and operates a portfolio of synergistic fintech businesses focused on improving access to credit that predominantly operate in the consumer credit sector across the UK, USA and Australia.  
  
This commitment, performance and innovation is nurtured within a award-winning working environment, where culture and relationships are built around Quint’s values of innovation, integrity, passion, and excellence. Quint’s work ethic has been recognised and celebrated by Sunday Times Best Companies to Work for and the Queen’s Award for Enterprise in Innovation.  
  
Quint’s current portfolio of businesses include MoneyGuru.com, Monevo, Credito and Infinian.  
  
• Money Guru is the UK’s fastest-growing personal money comparison site. It provides users with highly tailored personalised comparisons for credit cards, loans, mortgages and investments.  
  
• Monevo is a personal credit platform & API that powers credit comparison and distribution for over 150 banks and credit providers globally.  
  
• Credito is the UK's most comprehensive credit improvement service. Credito's mission is to improve access to credit & financial inclusion for over 1M UK consumers.  
  
• Infinian provides powerful data and insights to the financial services sector, fintech companies and some of the largest global data businesses and credit bureaux.

About Office Furniture Loft
---------------------------

Since 1969, Office Furniture Loft specializes in the supply and delivery of commercial grade furniture for the small business, large business and home office The strong relationships we have with our manufacturers allows us to pass greater savings on to you.  
  
For those wanting to get the benefits of commercial grade furniture at further reduced price, consider our Used furniture. We restore and inventory used office furniture at our facility in Owings Mills, Maryland. Visit or call and we would be happy to assist you with your selection.  
  
OFL includes a strong team of knowledgeable and experienced members. From management and client services, to our own planning and design teams, to our operations and installation teams, all our teams included seasoned and experienced members.  
  
If you are planning an office move, expansion, or start-up, we are here to help. While furniture needs and projects may seem overwhelming, OFL has the experience and personnel to help you through the process. From concept to design, from supply to completion, OFL provides a full range of services.  
  
We can deliver product on our own trucks within the mid-atlantic region. Delivery to other areas can be accomplished by small package carrier or truckload.  
  
OFL is pleased to do its' part towards re-using office furniture and making it functional and usable for a "second life". We specializes in identifying re-usable product, cleaning and restoring the product to a functional and usable condition, and re-introducing the product back into offices where it can live its' second life.  
  
And so the life cycle of office furniture continues. Natures' raw materials of wood, steel, and energy are saved, landfill usage is spared and open space is preserved. On average, every month Office Furniture Loft re-claims and converts 20,000 pounds of office furniture into usable product.

Over the last 30 years, DIAGAST has developed unparalleled expertise and know-how in the transfusion sector. DIAGAST develops, manufactures and markets reagents (for blood group determination), miniaturized laboratories for manual analysis and automated systems.  
  
  
DIAGAST also ensures the research, manufacturing and marketing of all its products. Moreover, DIAGAST offers a wide range of related services, such as a training center for their automated systems, a hotline and on-site follow-up on automaton calibration. About ScottCare Cardiovascular Solutions
----------------------------------------

ScottCare provides state-of-the-art monitoring technologies, patient data management solutions and labor services to ambulatory care settings including hospitals, cardiac rehab departments and cardiology practices. Our solutions help facilitate accurate and cost-effective diagnosis, rehabilitation and monitoring of cardiovascular patients to aid in the management of cardiovascular disease.  
  
ScottCare's portfolio is led by the top-selling VersaCare system for cardiopulmonary rehab telemetry. On the diagnostic side our advanced technologies include 3-in-1 remote cardiac monitoring (MCT, cellular Event and Holter), CIED patient data management, ambulatory blood pressure monitoring, arrhythmia event monitoring, and cardiac device monitoring labor services.  
  
ScottCare's single-platform CardioView Dx is the industry's most comprehensive, fully integrated product suite for cardiovascular diagnostic monitoring and CIED patient management, which includes OneView CRM, a device neutral platform for managing cardiac implantable electronic device (CIED) data and reports from ALL CRM vendors.  
  
In business since 1989 and based in Cleveland, Ohio, ScottCare is a division of the Scott Fetzer Company, a wholly owned subsidiary of Berkshire Hathaway, Inc.

How does Youth Marketing Connection measure the success of its marketing campaigns?

We employ a variety of metrics and analytics tools to measure the success of our marketing campaigns. Key performance indicators (KPIs) may include engagement rates, reach, brand awareness, conversion rates, and return on investment (ROI). We also gather qualitative feedback from participants and stakeholders to assess the overall impact of our initiatives and make data-driven adjustments as needed.

What makes Youth Marketing Connection different from other marketing agencies?

Youth Marketing Connection stands out due to our deep understanding of Gen-Z and Millennial audiences, honed over 20 years of experience in youth marketing. Our focus on authentic engagement, combined with innovative strategies and a network of Campus Influencers, allows us to create impactful campaigns that resonate with young consumers. We prioritize building meaningful connections between brands and their target audiences, ensuring that our marketing efforts are both effective and relevant.

About Miller Brewing Company
----------------------------

MillerCoors grew from the dreams of two German entrepreneurs who came to America in the mid-19th Century Frederick J. Miller was a determined young brewer who settled in Milwaukee and purchased the Plank Road Brewery where he founded Miller Brewing Company in 1855. He brewed his delicious beer using yeast that he carried in his pocket from Europe. Adolph Coors apprenticed at a brewery in Prussia during his teens and stowed away on a ship to America to realize his dreams of becoming a brewer. Adolph opened the Golden Brewery (later Coors Brewing Company) in Colorado and tapped his first barrel in 1873. Both companies had the good fortune to be founded by visionary businessmen whose families were committed to carrying on their legacies. Both businesses survived Prohibition, the Great Depression and two world wars, even as hundreds of other brewers failed. Their founding companies built their success barrel by barrel. At MillerCoors, they have three hundred years of combined brewing history, and they are committed to building on their founders' legacies. On 1 July 2008 the MillerCoors company was formed as a joint venture with rival Molson Coors to consolidate the production and distribution of its products in the United States, with each parent company's corporate operations and international operations remaining separate and independent of the joint venture.

About Madison Dearborn Partners
-------------------------------

Madison Dearborn Partners, LLC (“MDP”) is a leading private equity investment firm based in Chicago, Illinois. Since MDP’s formation in 1992, the firm has raised six funds with aggregate capital of over $18 billion and has completed investments in approximately 125 companies. Prior to forming the firm, MDP’s founders built a $2.6 billion management buyout and venture capital portfolio at First Chicago Corporation dating back to the early 1980s. MDP’s objective is to invest in companies in partnership with outstanding management teams to achieve significant long-term appreciation in equity value. A flexible investment approach, encompassing both management buyouts and structured minority investments, has been a key tenet to MDP’s investment philosophy for several decades. MDP’s founders adopted an industry focused investment approach over 30 years ago, and the firm has six dedicated teams that have long and successful track records of investing in their respective sectors. The six industry verticals are: Basic Industries, Business & Government Services, Consumer Financial & Transaction Services, Health Care, Telecom, Media & Technology Services. MDP operates from a single office in Chicago. The firm has 46 investment professionals, consisting of 30 Principals and 16 Associates. A strong belief in a partnership approach is at the center of our business philosophy. This approach has served us well over decades of investing, and we believe it distinguishes us as a partner of choice for many first class management teams looking to transform, grow or improve their businesses.

She leads assessments and mobilizes teams to ensure timely and effective responses to crises, while also focusing on capacity building for regional and country office teams. Lydiah's expertise encompasses program management, grants, and program development, with a particular emphasis on human rights and governance. As a leader, she inspires her teams through her dedication to humanitarian principles and her strategic vision, fostering an environment where innovative solutions can thrive. Marshall Denning is a transformative global law firm. Our name—homage to the founding fathers of U.S. and UK jurisprudence—reflects a respect for legal acumen. Legal practice—the core functions that lawyers perform—has not changed much in recent decades. But legal delivery—how, by whom, from what structure, and at what price— has undergone fundamental transformation. Marshall Denning is the first law firm to bridge the practice/delivery gap by integrating legal, technological, and process expertise—providing the marketplace the first integrated, organically built, scalable, cost-effective global alternative to the traditional law firm model.  
  
Marshall Denning is what the marketplace and top-notch legal talent have been waiting for. We have invested in our people and the tools they need to meet client demand-- for value; an understanding of their business and its objectives, risk profile, and DNA; efficiency; risk mitigation; and scalability. We provide our team with a level of ownership benefit unlike any other law firm. The law firm of the future is here – and complete democratization of the practice of law is the result.

Ferrari's story officially began in 1947 when its first road car, the 125 S, emerged from the gate of no. 4 Via Abetone Inferiore in Maranello. The iconic two-seater went on to win the Rome Grand Prix later that year and shortly thereafter was developed into a refined GT roadster. The company has travelled a long way since then, but its mission has remained unaltered: to make unique sports cars that represent the finest in Italian design and craftsmanship, both on the track and on the road.  
  
The very definition of excellence and sportiness, Ferrari needs no introduction. Its principal calling card is the numerous Formula One titles it has won: a total of 16 constructors’ championships and 15 drivers’ championships. And of course, there is the impressive lineup of legendary GT models. Cars that are unique for their design, technology and luxurious styling and that represent the best in Italian the world over.

About NYC Department Probation
------------------------------

The New York City Department of Probation (DOP) stands at the forefront of community corrections, playing a pivotal role in the criminal and juvenile justice systems across the five boroughs. Committed to fostering safer neighborhoods, DOP employs Evidence-Based Practices (EBP) to balance accountability with support, ensuring that individuals on probation have the resources they need to reintegrate successfully into society. The agency focuses on empowering those under its supervision to pursue education, secure employment, and rebuild relationships with family and community, marking this transformative phase as their “New Now.”  
  
DOP offers a range of services designed to support individuals on probation, including access to treatment programs, job training, and educational opportunities. By leveraging innovative technologies and data-driven strategies, the department enhances its ability to monitor compliance while providing essential support services. The agency's work significantly impacts the quality of life for victims, probationers, and their families, making it a crucial component of New York City's public safety framework.  
  
For those looking to make a meaningful difference, DOP provides a rewarding career path as a Probation Officer. With a starting salary of $42,759 and a comprehensive benefits package—including health insurance, a defined benefit pension, and full pay during training—DOP is dedicated to nurturing its workforce. Join us in this essential mission and become an agent of change in your community. For more information, visit our website at http://www.nyc.gov/probation. #JoinDOP

About Secretaria da Fazenda de Minas Gerais
-------------------------------------------

A Secretaria de Estado de Fazenda de Minas Gerais tem por finalidade planejar, coordenar, executar e avaliar a política tributária e fiscal, bem como gerir os recursos financeiros necessários à consecução dos objetivos da administração pública estadual, responsabilizando-se pelo seu provimento, controle e administração.  
  
MISSÃO  
  
A Secretaria de Estado de Fazenda de Minas Gerais tem como Missão Institucional prover e gerir os recursos financeiros do Estado, formulando e implementando políticas que garantam a justiça fiscal, o equilíbrio das contas públicas e o desenvolvimento de ações de governo, em benefício da sociedade mineira.  
  
NEGÓCIO  
  
Provimento e gestão dos recursos financeiros do Estado.  
  
VISÃO  
  
Ser reconhecida como instituição de excelência no cumprimento da sua missão:  
  
●por possuir um fisco reconhecido como justo, eficaz e com ações transparentes;  
  
●por contar com um quadro de funcionários qualificados, motivados e comprometidos com o seu trabalho;  
  
●por responder às mudanças agindo com flexibilidade diante da variação dos cenários político, econômico e social;  
  
●por alcançar o equilíbrio estrutural das contas públicas;  
  
●por contribuir para a transformação de Minas Gerais no melhor Estado para viver, trabalhar e investir.  
  
Valores:  
\-Efetividade  
\-Ética  
\-Justiça Fiscal  
\- Qualidade  
\-Responsabilidade Social  
\-Transparência

About The Telegraph
-------------------

The Telegraph’s mission is to provide content that inspires people to have the perspective they want to progress in life. It delivers quality, trusted, award-winning journalism, 24 hours a day, across its digital and print properties as well as through leading digital partners.  
  
Founded in 1855, The Telegraph has built a diversified commercial model, with equal strength in advertising, subscriptions and circulation, commerce, and events. In 1994, The Telegraph launched an online offering, the first UK publisher to do so. The launch in 2016 of a digital subscriptions model, with clearly defined open and premium content, has enhanced its ability to offer both scale and engagement to support this diversified approach.  
  
The Telegraph’s portfolio includes The Telegraph website and app, The Daily Telegraph and The Sunday Telegraph print titles, and The Telegraph Edition app which offers a digital replication of the newspapers.  
  
27.2 million Britons consume content across the portfolio monthly, with a growing global digital audience through 107 million browsers a month enjoying The Telegraph’s perspective on the world. Additionally, The Daily Telegraph is the UK’s best selling quality broadsheet newspaper.

About Office Of The Information Commissioner (Queensland)
---------------------------------------------------------

The Office of the Information Commissioner (OIC) is Queensland’s independent statutory body established under the Right to Information Act 2009 (Qld) and the Information Privacy Act 2009 (Qld) to promote access to government-held information, and to protect people’s personal information held by the public sector.  
  
The Office of the Information Commissioner (OIC) has five core services:  
  
1 - an independent, timely and fair review of decisions made under the Right to Information Act 2009 (Qld) (RTI Act) and the Information Privacy Act 2009 (Qld) (IP Act)  
  
2 - an independent and timely privacy complaint resolution service  
  
3 - fostering improvements in the quality of practice in right to information and information privacy in public sector agencies  
  
4 - promoting the principles and practices of right to information and information privacy in the community and within government.  
  
5 - assist agencies to achieve compliance with the privacy principles.  
  
OIC also provide a range of online services and information and resources to assist community and government understand their rights and responsibilities under the RTI and IP Act.

About Finep
-----------

A Finep - Inovação e Pesquisa - é uma empresa pública vinculada ao MCTIC. Foi criada em 1967 para institucionalizar o Fundo de Financiamento de Estudos de Projetos e Programas, criado em 1965. Posteriormente, a Finep substituiu e ampliou o papel até então exercido pelo Banco Nacional de Desenvolvimento Econômico e Social (BNDES) e seu Fundo de Desenvolvimento Técnico-Científico (FUNTEC), constituído em 1964 c/ a finalidade de financiar a implantação de programas de pós-graduação nas universidades brasileiras.  
  
Em 1969, o Governo instituiu o FNDCT - Fundo Nacional de Desenvolvimento Científico e Tecnológico, destinado a financiar a expansão do sistema de C&T, tendo a Finep como Secretaria Executiva a partir de 1971. Na década de 1970 a Finep promoveu intensa mobilização na comunidade científica, ao financiar a implantação de novos grupos de pesquisa, a criação de programas temáticos, a expansão da infra-estrutura de C&T e a consolidação institucional da pesquisa e da pós-graduação no País. Estimulou também a articulação entre universidades, centros de pesquisa, empresas de consultoria e contratantes de serviços, produtos e processos.  
  
Iniciativas de C,T&I de empresas em parceria com Instituições Científicas e Tecnológicas, que tiveram grande sucesso econômico, também estão associadas a financiamentos da Finep, como, p. ex.: o desenvolvimento do avião Tucano da EMBRAER, que abriu caminho para que os aviões da empresa se tornassem um importante item da pauta de exportações; um grande programa de formação de RH, no País e no exterior, assim como inúmeros projetos da EMBRAPA e de universidades, que foram essenciais p/ o desenvolvimento tecnológico do sistema agropecuário brasileiro, tornando-o um dos mais competitivos do mundo; projetos de pesquisa e de formação de RH da Petrobras, em parceria c/ universidades, que contribuíram p/ o domínio da tecnologia de exploração de petróleo em águas profundas e que estão fazendo o País alcançar a auto-suficiência no setor.

About County of Santa Clara
---------------------------

The County of Santa Clara is located at the southern end of the San Francisco Bay and encompasses 1,312 square miles.  
  
It has one of the highest median family incomes in the country, and a wide diversity of cultures, backgrounds and talents. The County of Santa Clara continues to attract people from all over the world. With more than 70 agencies/departments and 22,000 employees, the County of Santa Clara plans for the needs of a dynamic community, provides quality services, and promotes a healthy, safe and prosperous community for all. The County provides essential services including public health protection, environmental protection, medical services through Santa Clara Valley Medical Center (SCVMC), child and adult protection services, homelessness prevention and solutions, roads, park services, libraries, emergency response to disasters, protection of minority communities and those under threat, access to a fair criminal justice system, and scores of other services, particularly for those members of our community in the greatest need.  
  
The County's population of nearly 1.9 million is one of the largest in the state, and the largest of the nine Bay Area counties. Its population constitutes about one fourth of the Bay Area's total population. There are 15 cities including Campbell, Cupertino, Gilroy, Los Altos, Los Altos Hills, Los Gatos, Milpitas, Monte Sereno, Morgan Hill, Mountain View, Palo Alto, San Jose, Santa Clara, Saratoga, and Sunnyvale ranging from Palo Alto to the north, to Gilroy in the south. San Jose is the largest city in the County, with a population of 1.035 million, and is the administrative site of County Government. A significant portion of the county's land area is unincorporated ranch and farmland. Nearly 92% of the population lives in cities.  
  
The County of Santa Clara operates 27 parks covering more than 50,000 acres including scenic lakes, streams, and miles of hiking and biking trails.

He uses his positioning, stick work, and physicality to shut down opposing forwards and break up plays. McAvoy possesses a strong understanding of the game, allowing him to anticipate plays and make the necessary adjustments to neutralize threats.  
  
Offensively, McAvoy is equally impressive. With his exceptional puck-moving skills and accurate passing ability, he excels in starting the transition from defense to offense. McAvoy's vision and playmaking ability allow him to set up his teammates for scoring opportunities. Additionally, he possesses a powerful shot from the point, which makes him a threat to score from the blue line.  
  
McAvoy's impact on the game extends beyond his on-ice abilities. His leadership qualities and strong work ethic have not gone unnoticed. Despite his young age, he has quickly become a respected figure in the Bruins' locker room, and his teammates often look to him for guidance and inspiration.  
  
Although Charlie McAvoy is only at the beginning of his NHL career, his potential is undeniable. With his exceptional talent, work ethic, and dedication to improving his game, he is destined to become one of the league's premier defensemen. Watching him play is an exhilarating experience, as he continuously showcases his skills, delivers jaw-dropping plays, and leaves fans begging for more. About Métis Nation Of Alberta
-----------------------------

Since its inception in 1928, the Métis Nation of Alberta (MNA) is the Métis Government for Métis Albertans with its geographical and legal boundaries being the province of Alberta. The MNA is governed by a democratically elected Provincial Council, comprised of a Provincial President, a Vice-President, and six regional Presidents and Vice-Presidents. This Council works toward the mandate of the MNA, supporting practices of transparency, accountability and inclusiveness for Métis Albertans in governments’ policy and decision-making processes. The MNA promotes and facilitates the advancement of Métis people through self-reliance, self-determination and self-management.  
  
As per the Métis National Council, ‘Métis means a person who self-identifies as a Métis, is distinct from other aboriginal peoples, is of historic Métis Nation ancestry, and is accepted by the Métis Nation.’ Historic Métis Nation ‘means the Aboriginal people then known as Métis or half-breeds who resided in the Historic Métis Nation Homeland.’ Métis Nation ‘means the Aboriginal people descended from the Historic Métis Nation, which now comprised of all Métis Nation peoples and is one of the “aboriginal peoples of Canada” as defined in s.35 of the Constitution Act 1982.’  
  
In the past decade, the Métis population has nearly doubled. The Métis are one of the fastest growing populations in Canada with a population estimated at 451,795 in 2011. A significantly high percentage live in Alberta alone. Alberta today accounts for more than 96,865 Métis, which is the largest population among the provinces and territories representing more than 21.4% of all Métis in Canada.

Her exceptional reporting skills soon caught the attention of ABC News, and in 2011, she joined the network as a correspondent.

Her versatility as a journalist is evident in the breadth of topics she has covered, from political campaigns and natural disasters to celebrity interviews and human interest stories. Her ability to adapt and delve deep into each subject, while maintaining her signature investigative approach, has earned her widespread acclaim.  
  
One of Vega's most notable achievements was her coverage of the 2016 presidential election. She crisscrossed the country, reporting from rallies, debates, and campaign events, providing viewers with up-to-the-minute updates and insightful analysis. Her interviews with candidates and voters alike shed light on the political climate of the time, and her reporting was widely lauded for its fairness and objectivity.  
  
In addition to her political reporting, Vega has also demonstrated a keen interest in social justice issues. She has covered stories on immigration, inequality, and the fight for justice in marginalized communities. Her empathetic approach towards these issues has resonated with audiences, highlighting her dedication to giving a voice to the voiceless.  
  
Beyond her work on television, Vega has also made a name for herself through her engaging presence on social media. She uses platforms like Twitter to share behind-the-scenes glimpses into her reporting process, giving her followers a unique perspective into the fast-paced world of journalism. Her authenticity and enthusiasm have garnered her a substantial following, and her impact extends beyond traditional news mediums.  
  
Cecilia Vega's contributions to journalism have not gone unnoticed. She has been recognized with numerous awards, including an Emmy for her reporting on the San Bruno gas explosion and the Gracie Award for Outstanding Correspondent. Her dedication to her craft and commitment to delivering honest and impactful stories have solidified her position as one of the industry's most respected journalists.  
  
In a media landscape that is constantly evolving, Cecilia Vega remains a steadfast figure. Her ability to combine in-depth reporting with a relatable and engaging storytelling style has made her a shining example for aspiring journalists. With her boundless curiosity and unwavering dedication to the truth, Vega continues to be a force to be reckoned with in the world of journalism.

About Chicago Lawyers' Committee For Civil Rights
-------------------------------------------------

We are civil rights lawyers and advocates working to secure racial equity and economic opportunity for all. We provide legal representation through partnerships with the private bar, and collaborate with grassroots organizations and other advocacy groups to implement community-based solutions that advance civil rights.  
  
We are committed to the unfinished business of our nation’s civil rights movement. Our vision is to root out and dismantle deeply entrenched systems of discrimination, racism, and economic oppression. We believe in the power of the law to uplift and give voice to those individuals, organizations, and communities most impacted by poverty and racial disparity, including racial and ethnic groups, religious minorities, women, immigrants, LGBTQ people, and people with disabilities.  
  
We identify and disrupt patterns of discrimination. Through longstanding partnerships with member law firms, we provide high quality legal assistance to clients and communities in litigation and transactional matters. We collaborate with community leaders, advocacy organizations, and attorneys to craft and implement community-based solutions and policy reform. We use a broad range of advocacy tools that include direct legal services, impact litigation, policy advocacy, community education, and coalition building.  
  
We focus on three impact areas: education, voting rights & civic empowerment, and housing & equitable community development.

About Black Coalition For AIDS Prevention
-----------------------------------------

Black CAP is an organization that works to reduce HIV/AIDS in Toronto’s Black, African and Caribbean communities and enhance the quality of life of Black people living with or affected by HIV/AIDS.  
  
HIV/AIDS is spreading quickly in Toronto’s Black communities and we believe that our work is more important than ever. At this time, Black, African and Caribbean people account for more than one-fifth of all new HIV infections in Toronto, in the early nineties we made up only one-tenth of new HIV infections. Issues of HIV related stigma and discrimination, homophobia, anti-Black racism, immigration, poverty, and barriers to social inclusion also continue to make our work harder.

Henny Hales, the visionary Director and Founder of ROAR!, has carved a niche for herself in the food industry, particularly in the realm of healthy eating and innovative food solutions. With a robust background in food and cooking, Henny's journey began with her own successful cooking company and a freelance project management business, where she honed her skills in strategic planning and new business development. This diverse experience laid the groundwork for her passion project: ROAR!, which specializes in producing award-winning Porridge Pods. These convenient, no-added-sugar recipes are crafted with care in the UK, allowing consumers to enjoy a nutritious meal with just the addition of hot water.  
  
At ROAR!, Henny leads a dynamic team focused on redefining breakfast options through creativity and quality. Her expertise in food and event management has been instrumental in the development and launch of the Porridge Pods, ensuring that each product not only meets high nutritional standards but also resonates with health-conscious consumers. Henny's strategic marketing initiatives have successfully positioned ROAR! as a leader in the healthy convenience food market, attracting a loyal customer base that values both taste and health.  
  
Under her guidance, ROAR! is not just a brand; it’s a movement towards healthier eating habits. Henny is committed to continuous innovation, exploring new flavors and ingredients that align with current dietary trends. Her passion for oats and dedication to quality have made ROAR! a standout in the industry, and her leadership continues to inspire those around her to embrace healthier lifestyles through delicious, convenient food options.

About Maziar Doustdar

Maziar Mike Doustdar serves as the Executive Vice President of International Operations at Novo Nordisk, where he plays a pivotal role in addressing one of the most pressing global health challenges: cardiometabolic diseases. With a focus on regions encompassing Europe, Latin America, Africa, the Middle East, Asia, and Oceania, Maziar oversees a vast operational landscape that spans 194 countries and impacts over 1 billion individuals living with conditions such as diabetes, obesity, and cardiovascular diseases. His leadership is instrumental in driving the company’s mission to improve patient outcomes and enhance the quality of life for those affected by these chronic conditions.  
  
In his current role, Maziar is responsible for the total business operation and profit and loss (P&L) management of an impressive annual revenue of approximately $10 billion. He leads a diverse workforce of 16,000 employees, fostering a culture of servant leadership and collaboration across various markets. His expertise in business operations, product launch strategies, and negotiation equips him to navigate the complexities of emerging markets, ensuring that Novo Nordisk remains at the forefront of innovation in the pharmaceutical industry.  
  
Maziar's commitment to cultural diversity and leadership development is evident in his approach to managing international teams, where he emphasizes the importance of understanding local contexts and tailoring strategies to meet the unique needs of each market. As a member of Novo Nordisk's Executive Management, he is not only shaping the future of the organization but also contributing to a global movement aimed at combating the rising tide of cardiometabolic diseases, ultimately striving for a healthier world.

Because of our comprehensive knowledge of the complex medical and legal issues that arise in asbestos cases and our dedication to personally pursue cases expeditiously through trial, we have been able to secure compensation that allows our clients and their families to explore medical treatments not otherwise available to them and peace of mind.  
  
Our record of tangible success includes numerous multimillion-dollar settlements and verdicts on behalf of clients throughout the nation. Rulings in California, Washington and Utah were the largest in the respective states for asbestosis and mesothelioma victims.  
  
We, along with our co-counsel Metzger Law Group, are one of only two firms who have cases filed for damages stemming from artificial stone silicosis.  
  
Brayton Purcell LLP has successfully secured over $3 billion in settlements and verdicts and has also paid out more than $80 million in fees to referring and associated counsel. HomeLend manages the purchase process from Lock, through due diligence all the way to funding, in a frictionless, safe, and hassle-free manner - offering a remarkably cost-effective, highly customizable end-to-end virtual conduit for buyers and sellers. About Rita Feria

Professor Rita De La Feria is a distinguished academic and thought leader in the field of tax law, currently serving as the Chair of Tax Law at the University of Leeds since January 2016. Her extensive expertise encompasses a wide range of areas, including tax policy, European law, and constitutional law, making her a pivotal figure in shaping contemporary tax discourse. At Leeds, she is instrumental in delivering advanced courses such as Tax Law and Policy for LLM and MSc students, as well as Tax Fraud for LLB and BA programs, where she integrates her rich research background into her teaching methodologies.  
  
In addition to her role at Leeds, Professor De La Feria is an International Research Fellow at the Centre for Business Taxation at Oxford University, where she contributes to critical research on the implications of tax policy in a globalized economy. Her involvement as a Visiting Professor at the University of Lisbon further underscores her commitment to fostering international collaboration in legal education and research.  
  
Professor De La Feria has been recognized in the Global Tax 50 list in 2015, highlighting her influence and contributions to the field. She is actively engaged in key projects that explore the intersections of tax law with corporate governance and cross-border transactions, addressing the complexities of tax compliance and enforcement in an increasingly interconnected world. Her scholarly work not only advances academic understanding but also informs policymakers, legal practitioners, and businesses navigating the evolving landscape of tax regulation. Through her leadership and innovative approach, Professor De La Feria continues to inspire the next generation of legal scholars and practitioners in tax law.

About National Council Of Farmer Cooperatives
---------------------------------------------

Since 1929, the National Council of Farmer Cooperatives (NCFC) has been the voice of America’s farmer cooperatives. Our members are regional and national farmer cooperatives, which in turn consist of nearly 2,000 local farmer cooperatives across the country. The majority of America’s 2 million farmers and ranchers belong to one or more farmer cooperatives. NCFC members also include 17 state and regional councils of cooperatives.  
  
Farmer cooperatives handle, process and market almost every type of agricultural commodity; furnish farm supplies; and provide credit and related financial services, including export financing. Earnings from these activities are returned to their farmer members on a patronage basis, helping improve their income from the marketplace.  
  
Farmer cooperatives also provide over 250,000 jobs, with a total payroll in excess of $8 billion, and contribute significantly to the economic well-being of rural America.

What services does the National Council of Farmer Cooperatives (NCFC) provide?

The National Council of Farmer Cooperatives (NCFC) provides a range of services aimed at supporting farmer cooperatives across the United States. These services include advocacy on legislative and regulatory issues, educational resources, and technical assistance. NCFC also offers networking opportunities for cooperatives to collaborate and share best practices, as well as research and analysis on agricultural trends and policies that impact the cooperative sector.

How does NCFC support agricultural cooperatives in policy advocacy?

NCFC actively engages in policy advocacy by representing the interests of farmer cooperatives at the federal and state levels. This includes lobbying for favorable legislation, participating in regulatory discussions, and working with government agencies to ensure that the voices of cooperatives are heard. NCFC also provides its members with updates on relevant policy changes and helps them navigate the complexities of agricultural law and regulation.

What industries does NCFC serve?

NCFC serves a diverse range of industries within the agricultural sector, including but not limited to crop production, livestock, dairy, and specialty crops. The council represents various types of cooperatives, such as marketing cooperatives, supply cooperatives, and service cooperatives. This broad representation allows NCFC to address the unique challenges and opportunities faced by different segments of the agricultural community.

Can NCFC assist with educational resources for cooperative members?

Yes, NCFC offers a variety of educational resources designed to enhance the knowledge and skills of cooperative members. This includes workshops, webinars, and training sessions on topics such as cooperative governance, financial management, and marketing strategies. Additionally, NCFC provides access to research publications and best practice guides that can help cooperatives improve their operations and competitiveness.

How can cooperatives become members of NCFC?

Cooperatives interested in becoming members of NCFC can apply for membership through the NCFC website. The application process typically involves submitting information about the cooperative's structure, operations, and goals. Once the application is reviewed and approved, the cooperative can enjoy the benefits of membership, including access to advocacy efforts, educational resources, and networking opportunities with other cooperatives.

What is the role of NCFC in promoting sustainability in agriculture?

NCFC plays a crucial role in promoting sustainability within the agricultural sector by advocating for practices that enhance environmental stewardship and economic viability. The council supports initiatives that encourage sustainable farming practices, such as soil health management, water conservation, and renewable energy use. NCFC also collaborates with other organizations and stakeholders to develop policies and programs that promote sustainable agriculture and help cooperatives adapt to changing environmental conditions.

----------------------------

Heidelberg Engineering continuously optimizes imaging and healthcare IT technologies to provide ophthalmic diagnostic solutions that empower clinicians to improve patient care. From its inception in 1990, the company has collaborated with scientists, clinicians and industry to develop innovative products that deliver clinically relevant benefits.  
  
Uncompromising quality and education play a large part in fostering the diagnostic confidence that has become synonymous with the global brand. The company’s substantial expertise in the development and implementation of intelligent image and data management solutions complements its distinguished history in the design, manufacture and distribution of ophthalmic diagnostic instruments.  
  
Heidelberg Engineering’s growing product portfolio combines these core technologies: confocal microscopy, scanning lasers and optics, optical coherence tomography (OCT), real-time image processing and analytics, multimodal image management solutions (PACS), electronic medical records (EMR) and data mining.

About Pagevamp
--------------

Pagevamp is the easiest and fastest way to publish a website. Pagevamp allows users to create and update their website from their Facebook Page in one click. Rather than forcing users to learn a whole new site creation and management interface, Pagevamp lets its users update their website from a platform they already know: Facebook. Now anyone can create a good looking and up-to-date website using Pagevamp. Prior to Pagevamp, co-founders Vincent Sanchez-Gomez, Atulya Pandey, and Fred Wang ran a small traditional design agency where they learned that many small business and organization websites never got updated because the existing platforms (cms and wysiwyg) were too difficult to manage without a web expert on hand. They created the first version of Pagevamp at PennApps Hackathon Fall 2012 and released Pagevamp's first public beta in late March, 2013.

About City of Takoma Park
-------------------------

The City of Takoma Park is a municipality of approximately 17,000 residents in Montgomery County, Maryland. Takoma Park is bordered by Washington, D.C. on the south, the unincorporated communities of Silver Spring and Long Branch in Montgomery County on the west and north, and the unincorporated communities of Langley Park and Chillum in Prince George’s County on the north and east. Takoma Park is densely populated but feels comfortable due to its hills and large trees. Takoma Park is known as “Azalea City” because of the many flowering azalea bushes that brighten the area in the spring. Stream valley parks along Sligo Creek and Long Branch Creek cross the city and, along with other city parks, provide bike trails and play areas for the community.  
Government  
  
Takoma Park operates under a Council-Manager form of government. An at-large Mayor and six Councilmembers representing wards comprise the Council. Councilmembers are elected for two-year terms in November of odd-numbered years. The Council sets policy, adopts the annual budget, appoints the City Manager and City Attorney, and appoints members to various boards and commissions. The City Manager directs the day-to-day operations of the city government, hires and manages staff, and proposes an annual budget for consideration by the Council.  
  
The City of Takoma Park provides services through the following departments: Administration, Housing and Community Development, Library, Police, Public Works and Recreation. Social services, schools, courts, and most building inspections and planning and zoning services are provided by Montgomery County.  
  
Takoma Park lies within Montgomery County Council District 5, Maryland General Assembly District 20 and U.S. House of Representatives District 8.

About City of Berkeley
----------------------

The City of Berkeley is distinguished by its diversity, community engagement, and activism. Home to the University of California’s flagship campus, Berkeley’s population is highly educated, diverse, and engaged. The City lies on the east shore of the San Francisco Bay and is sheltered by rolling hills on its eastern border. Berkeley spans 10 square miles with 124,000 residents.  
  
Our climate is mild year-round, with cool summers. An outdoor focus is demonstrated with acres of open space, parks, and an abundance of bike lanes on City streets. Public transportation is well developed and reliable, with three Bay Area Rapid Transit (BART) stations in Berkeley. All of these factors translate to an outstanding quality of life for Berkeley residents, with an abundance of outdoor, recreational, and cultural activities.  
  
The City of Berkeley lies in Alameda County and operates under a Council-Manager form of government. The City is divided into eight districts, and each district elects one representative to the City Council. The eight-member City Council serves four-year terms, and a mayor is elected at large – also on a four-year term.  
  
The City Council appoints a City Manager, who serves as the Chief Executive of the City. Berkeley provides a comprehensive range of municipal services to its population, many of which are not typically provided by cities. In addition to the customary city services, the City of Berkeley operates its own Health, Housing and Community Services Department, providing public health, mental health, and environmental health services to the community.  
  
The City also provides its own residential and commercial solid waste collection, recycling, and disposal service. In addition, the City’s Parks, Recreation, and Waterfront Department offers a number of summer camps and operates a 1,000-berth marina.

About Yuefeng Zhou

Yuefeng Zhou is a highly accomplished Staff Software Engineer at Google, specializing in artificial intelligence (AI) and AI infrastructure. Currently serving as the Team Lead for the GenAI Platform, Yuefeng plays a pivotal role in shaping the future of generative AI technologies. His leadership in this domain involves overseeing the development of scalable and efficient systems that leverage advanced machine learning algorithms to enhance user experiences across various applications. With a deep understanding of distributed systems, Yuefeng is adept at optimizing performance and reliability, ensuring that the GenAI Platform can handle the complexities of modern AI workloads.  
  
Before taking on his current role, Yuefeng was the Technical Lead Manager (TLM) of distributed training within the TensorFlow team, where he significantly contributed to the tf.distribute module. His expertise in machine learning for systems at Google Brain further solidified his reputation as a thought leader in the AI space. Notably, he has worked on dynamic ads infrastructure and advanced retrieval techniques, including deep retrieval and model-based retrieval, showcasing his versatility and innovative approach to solving complex problems.  
  
Yuefeng's technical proficiency spans a wide array of programming languages and technologies, including Java, C++, Python, and Scala, as well as networking and socket programming. His strong foundation in data structures and distributed systems enables him to design robust architectures that support high-performance AI applications. As he continues to drive key projects at Google, Yuefeng remains committed to pushing the boundaries of AI technology, making significant contributions to the field while mentoring the next generation of engineers.

What services does Ronald McDonald House Charities of Kansas City provide to families with sick children?

Ronald McDonald House Charities of Kansas City offers a variety of services aimed at supporting families with children facing serious health challenges. These services include providing a comfortable and supportive place to stay near the hospital, meals and snacks, transportation assistance, and access to family-centered care resources. Our facilities are designed to create a caring and uplifting environment where families can rest and recharge while their children receive medical treatment.

Who is eligible to stay at the Ronald McDonald House in Kansas City?

Families with children who are receiving treatment at local hospitals are eligible to stay at the Ronald McDonald House in Kansas City. Typically, this includes families whose children are undergoing surgeries, treatments for chronic illnesses, or other serious medical conditions. A referral from a medical professional is often required to ensure that families in need can access our services.

How can I support Ronald McDonald House Charities of Kansas City?

There are several ways to support Ronald McDonald House Charities of Kansas City. You can make a monetary donation, which directly helps us provide services to families in need. Additionally, we welcome in-kind donations such as food, household supplies, and toiletries. Volunteering your time is another valuable way to contribute; we have various opportunities for individuals and groups to assist with meal preparation, housekeeping, and special events.

What safety measures are in place at the Ronald McDonald House during the COVID-19 pandemic?

The safety and well-being of our families, staff, and volunteers are our top priorities. During the COVID-19 pandemic, we have implemented enhanced cleaning protocols, social distancing measures, and limited the number of guests in shared spaces. We also require masks in common areas and conduct health screenings for all individuals entering the facility. Our goal is to provide a safe environment for families while they navigate their medical journeys.

Can families stay at the Ronald McDonald House for an extended period?

Yes, families can stay at the Ronald McDonald House for an extended period, depending on their child's treatment needs and availability of rooms. We strive to accommodate families for as long as they require support, ensuring they have a safe and comfortable place to stay while their child receives medical care. Our team works closely with families to assess their needs and provide the necessary resources throughout their stay.

What types of events does Ronald McDonald House Charities of Kansas City host to raise awareness and funds?

Ronald McDonald House Charities of Kansas City hosts a variety of events throughout the year to raise awareness and funds for our mission. These events include community fundraisers, gala dinners, charity runs, and family-friendly activities. We also participate in local awareness campaigns to educate the public about the challenges faced by families with sick children and how they can help. Check our website for upcoming events and ways to get involved.

About Robert Zemekis

Robert Zemeckis is an American filmmaker known for his innovative and groundbreaking work in the field of cinema. With a career spanning over four decades, Zemeckis has established himself as a visionary director and producer, known for pushing the boundaries of technology and storytelling in film.  
  
Born on May 14, 1952, in Chicago, Illinois, Zemeckis developed a passion for filmmaking at a young age. After studying at the University of Southern California's School of Cinematic Arts, he began his career in the industry, working on a variety of projects before making his directorial debut with the film "I Wanna Hold Your Hand" in 1978. This early success paved the way for Zemeckis to become a prominent figure in Hollywood, and he continued to build upon his reputation with subsequent films.  
  
One of Zemeckis' most notable works is the 1985 film "Back to the Future," which he co-wrote and directed. The film, which follows the adventures of a teenager who travels back in time in a modified DeLorean car, is widely regarded as a classic of the science fiction genre. Zemeckis' innovative use of special effects and storytelling techniques helped to redefine the possibilities of filmmaking, and the success of "Back to the Future" solidified his status as a creative force in the industry.  
  
Following the success of "Back to the Future," Zemeckis continued to push the boundaries of filmmaking with projects such as "Who Framed Roger Rabbit" (1988), a groundbreaking film that combined live-action and animation in a seamless and innovative way. The film's success further cemented Zemeckis' reputation as a director with a knack for pushing the boundaries of visual storytelling.  
  
In the 1990s, Zemeckis continued to push the envelope with films such as "Forrest Gump" (1994), a critically acclaimed drama that won six Academy Awards, including Best Director for Zemeckis. The film's use of special effects to insert its lead character into historical footage and events showcased Zemeckis' commitment to innovation and storytelling. "Forrest Gump" was a massive commercial success, grossing over $677 million worldwide and solidifying Zemeckis as one of Hollywood's most sought-after directors.  
  
In the 2000s, Zemeckis continued to explore the intersection of technology and storytelling with films such as "Cast Away" (2000), which starred Tom Hanks as a man stranded on a deserted island, and "The Polar Express" (2004), a pioneering animated film that utilized motion capture technology to bring its characters to life. Zemeckis' willingness to experiment with new technologies and storytelling techniques has set him apart as a filmmaker unafraid to take creative risks.  
  
Zemeckis' career has been marked by a willingness to push the boundaries of filmmaking, and his dedication to innovation has earned him a reputation as a visionary director. His use of cutting-edge technology has set new standards for visual effects and storytelling in film, and his films have continued to resonate with audiences and critics alike. From his early successes with "Back to the Future" to his groundbreaking work on "The Polar Express," Zemeckis has consistently proven himself to be a filmmaker unafraid to challenge conventions and explore new creative frontiers.  
  
In addition to his work as a director, Zemeckis has also made a name for himself as a producer, with credits on films such as "The Frighteners" (1996) and "Real Steel" (2011). His influence on the industry extends beyond his own films, as he has served as a mentor and inspiration to countless filmmakers and artists, and his dedication to innovation has left an indelible mark on the world of cinema.  
  
Overall, Robert Zemeckis has established himself as a leading figure in the film industry through his groundbreaking work as a director and producer. His commitment to pushing the boundaries of technology and storytelling has set new standards for visual effects and narrative in film, and his legacy as a visionary filmmaker continues to inspire new generations of artists and audiences. Whether it's through his early classics like "Back to the Future" or his pioneering use of motion capture in "The Polar Express," Zemeckis' impact on the world of cinema is profound and enduring.

About KNAPP North America
-------------------------

KNAPP North America, headquartered in Kennesaw, Georgia, is a leading force in warehouse automation and intralogistics solutions. As part of the global KNAPP Group, which employs over 6,000 professionals across 53 locations worldwide, the company is dedicated to simplifying complexity in logistics through innovative technology. KNAPP specializes in a diverse range of sectors, including healthcare, fashion/apparel, general retail, food retail, industry, and service, tailoring its solutions to meet the unique demands of each industry.  
  
At the heart of KNAPP’s offerings are advanced automated order picking systems and cutting-edge container handling technology, designed to enhance efficiency and accuracy in warehouse operations. The company’s commitment to continuous innovation is reflected in its state-of-the-art software solutions, which integrate seamlessly with its hardware to provide real-time data and analytics, optimizing inventory management and order fulfillment processes.  
  
KNAPP’s intelligent automation solutions not only streamline logistics but also improve operational agility, allowing businesses to adapt quickly to changing market conditions. By leveraging technologies such as robotics, artificial intelligence, and machine learning, KNAPP North America empowers its clients to achieve greater productivity and reduce operational costs. With a focus on customer-centric solutions and a passion for automation, KNAPP is shaping the future of intralogistics, helping businesses navigate the complexities of modern supply chains with ease. For more information, visit their website at http://www.knapp.com/en.

About Wayside Technology Group
------------------------------

Climb Global Solutions is an international technology company that markets software, hardware, and services – directly and through resellers – to software development and information technology professionals worldwide. The company, which is headquartered in Eatontown, New Jersey, was incorporated in 1982 and has been public since 1995 (NASDAQ:CLMB). At Climb Global Solutions, our mission is to deliver easy access to superior IT products. Through our business divisions, we extend this offering to technology resellers and businesses around the globe.  
  
Climb Global Solutions operates through various business units. The “Climb Channel Solutions” segment distributes technical software and hardware to corporate resellers, value added resellers (VARs), consultants and systems integrators worldwide. The Grey Matter segment is a value-added reseller of software, hardware and services for corporations, government organizations and academic institutions in the USA and Canada. We offer an extensive line of products from leading publishers of software and tools for virtualization/cloud computing, security, networking, storage and infrastructure management, application lifecycle management and other technically sophisticated domains as well as computer hardware.  
  
In 2020, Climb Global Solutions acquired Interwork Technologies and CDF Group. Interwork Technologies is a specialty cybersecurity distributor, based in Canada. CDF Group is a UK-based cloud, software and IT distributor and services provider. CDF primarily goes to market under two brands: Grey Matter, which is a value-added reseller (VAR) providing cloud, software and technical services; and Sigma Software Distribution, which provides innovative software products to VARs throughout EMEA.
