About Hartmann Group
--------------------

One of the biggest family-owned shipping companies worldwide.  
  
The Hartmann Group is an independent, family-owned shipping company, operating worldwide. Our business is based on several foundations: ship owning, full technical and commercial ship management, as well as crewing and training of seafarers.  
  
All in all, the companies of the group employ about 5,000 employees and operate a fleet of more than 150 vessels – gas carriers, product tankers, bulk carriers, pneumatic cement carriers, container ships and multi-purpose vessels. Dedicated technical, commercial and crewing management teams each focus on the Hartmann Group’s core markets, thus ensuring expert knowledge and consistently high quality standards for our customers in the individual segments.  
  
Founded in 1981 by Capt. Alfred Hartmann, the Hartmann Group developed from a one-ship-company to a global network of maritime specialist companies. The constant growth of the group of companies necessitated the founding of a holding company: Originally founded as “Atlas AG”, the company was renamed to “Hartmann AG” in 2008, when Dr. Niels Hartmann took over the post as Chief Executive Officer.  
  
Hartmann AG with its registered office in Leer, East Frisia, Germany, unites the companies of the Hartmann Group under one roof. It defines the Hartmann Group’s long-term goals and its strategic orientation. This comprises the coordination of investments, risk management, participation controlling, strategic personnel development and corporate communications.

About Robert Bartlett

Robert Bartlett is a distinguished English historian known for his extensive work on medieval history, particularly the Anglo-Norman period. His insightful and insightful analysis of medieval England has had a significant impact on the field of history and has garnered widespread acclaim from scholars and readers alike.  
  
Bartlett’s interest in history began at an early age, and he pursued his passion by studying history at the University of Cambridge. He went on to earn his Ph.D. from the same institution, focusing on the political and social history of medieval England. This academic background provided him with a solid foundation for his future research and writings.  
  
One of Bartlett’s most notable works is his book "The Making of Europe: Conquest, Colonization, and Cultural Change, 950-1350", in which he explores the transformative period in European history known as the High Middle Ages. In this book, Bartlett examines the profound changes that occurred in Europe during this time, including the expansion of European power through conquest and colonization, and the resulting cultural and social changes. Through meticulous research and compelling analysis, Bartlett presents a vivid and comprehensive account of this pivotal era in European history.  
  
Another significant contribution by Bartlett is his book "England Under the Norman and Angevin Kings, 1075-1225". This book provides a detailed examination of the political, social, and cultural developments in England during the rule of the Norman and Angevin kings. Bartlett’s expert analysis sheds light on the pivotal events and personalities that shaped England during this period, offering valuable insights into the political and social dynamics of medieval England.  
  
Bartlett has also published extensively on the topic of medieval monarchy and kingship, delving deep into the intricacies of royal power and authority in medieval Europe. His book "The Hanged Man: A Story of Miracle, Memory, and Colonialism in the Middle Ages" is a fascinating exploration of the cult of Saint William of Norwich and its implications for understanding medieval society and culture. Through this book, Bartlett offers a nuanced perspective on the intersection of religion, memory, and power in medieval England, showcasing his mastery of the subject matter.  
  
In addition to his scholarly contributions, Bartlett has also engaged in public history and outreach, making medieval history accessible and engaging for a wide audience. He has appeared in various television documentaries and programs, sharing his expertise and passion for history with viewers around the world. His engaging storytelling and profound knowledge of medieval history have captivated audiences and inspired a renewed interest in this fascinating period of the past.  
  
Bartlett’s impact on the field of history extends beyond his own research and writings. As a respected academic, he has mentored numerous students and scholars, guiding them in their own research and fostering a new generation of historians. His dedication to teaching and mentorship has left a lasting legacy, inspiring others to pursue their own interest in medieval history and make meaningful contributions to the field.  
  
In conclusion, Robert Bartlett is a preeminent historian whose work has greatly enriched our understanding of medieval England and Europe. Through his insightful research, compelling writing, and dedication to public outreach, he has made a significant impact on the field of history and has inspired countless individuals to delve into the complexities of the medieval past. His contributions to the study of medieval history are profound and enduring, cementing his reputation as a leading authority in the field.

About Emma Thompson

Emma Thompson is a revered British actress and screenwriter known for her remarkable versatility and captivating performances. With her undeniable talent, she has seamlessly transitioned between theater, film, and television, leaving an indelible mark on the entertainment industry. Thompson's unique ability to effortlessly embody a wide range of complex characters has earned her countless accolades, including two Academy Awards, three BAFTAs, and a Golden Globe.  
  
Born on April 15, 1959, in London, England, Thompson was immersed in the world of acting from an early age. Her father, Eric Thompson, was a renowned actor and television presenter, while her mother, Phyllida Law, was a notable Scottish actress. Growing up in a household filled with creativity and artistic expression undoubtedly shaped Thompson's passion for the performing arts.  
  
Thompson's professional career began in the 1980s when she joined the Cambridge Footlights, a prestigious drama club famous for producing talented comedians and actors. It was during her time at Cambridge University that she formed a fruitful partnership with actor Stephen Fry, and together they wrote and performed in several successful comedy shows, showcasing Thompson's exceptional comedic timing and wit.  
  
In 1987, Thompson made her breakthrough on the big screen in the romantic drama "Fortunes of War," where she portrayed an idealistic and headstrong Englishwoman caught up in the turmoil of the Second World War. This role was just a taste of the extraordinary performances that would become synonymous with Thompson's name over the following decades.  
  
Thompson's ability to seamlessly switch between genres and effortlessly embody a diverse range of characters has been one of the defining aspects of her career. From Shakespearean classics to contemporary dramas, Thompson has proven time and again that she can tackle any role with finesse and authenticity. One of her most memorable performances was in the 1992 film "Howards End," where she portrayed Margaret Schlegel, a woman navigating the complexities of class and social conventions in Edwardian England. This performance earned her critical acclaim and her first Academy Award for Best Actress.  
  
As a screenwriter, Thompson has also left an indelible mark on the film industry. In addition to her talent in front of the camera, she possesses a unique storytelling ability that shines through in her scripts. One of her most celebrated accomplishments was writing the screenplay for the 1995 adaptation of Jane Austen's "Sense and Sensibility." Not only did Thompson pen the script, but she also took on the lead role of Elinor Dashwood, showcasing her multiple talents simultaneously. The film was a commercial and critical success, receiving widespread acclaim for its wit, impeccable casting, and faithful interpretation of Austen's timeless work. Thompson's exceptional screenplay earned her a second Academy Award, this time for Best Adapted Screenplay.  
  
Thompson's talent isn't confined to the silver screen; she has also graced the theater with her remarkable performances. In 1989, she made her West End debut in the play "Look Back in Anger," where she played the challenging role of Alison Porter. Her ability to effortlessly captivate audiences and convey complex emotions on stage led to numerous critically acclaimed theater performances throughout her career.  
  
Beyond her acting and writing talents, Emma Thompson is also an outspoken advocate for social and environmental causes. She actively campaigns for human rights, gender equality, and environmental sustainability. Thompson has lent her voice to various organizations, using her platform to raise awareness about the issues she holds dear to her heart. Her unwavering dedication to fighting for a better world exemplifies her incredible compassion and integrity.  
  
In conclusion, Emma Thompson's talent and versatility have solidified her position as one of the most eminent British actresses and screenwriters of her generation. Her ability to seamlessly transition between theater, film, and television and her exceptional knack for breathing life into diverse characters has captivated audiences worldwide. With her extraordinary acting skills, impactful screenplays, and passionate advocacy work, Thompson continues to inspire and influence both aspiring and established artists, leaving an enduring legacy on the entertainment industry.

About Ryvu Therapeutics
-----------------------

Ryvu Therapeutics is a clinical-stage drug discovery and development company focused on novel small molecule therapies that address emerging targets in oncology.  
  
Internally discovered pipeline candidates make use of diverse therapeutic mechanisms driven by emerging knowledge of cancer biology, including small molecules directed at kinase, synthetic lethality, and immuno-oncology targets.  
Ryvu’s most advanced programs are RVU120 - a selective CDK8/CDK19 kinase inhibitor with potential for the treatment of hematological malignancies and solid tumors currently in Phase I clinical development for the treatment of acute myeloid leukemia and myelodysplastic syndrome, and Phase I/II for the treatment of r/r metastatic or advanced solid tumors, and SEL24 (MEN1703) - dual PIM/FLT3 kinase inhibitor licensed to the Menarini Group, currently in Phase II clinical studies in acute myeloid leukemia.  
  
In its history, Ryvu Therapeutics has signed 11 partnering and licensing deals with global companies, among others Merck, Menarini Group, Galapagos, Exelixis, and BioNTech. The company was founded in 2007 and is headquartered in Krakow, Poland. Ryvu is listed on the Warsaw Stock Exchange and is a component of sWIG80 index.

What types of therapies does Ryvu Therapeutics focus on?

Ryvu Therapeutics specializes in developing novel small molecule therapies primarily targeting oncology. Their research encompasses various innovative approaches, including immuno-oncology, cancer metabolism, and synthetic lethality. The company aims to address emerging targets in cancer treatment, particularly in areas such as acute myeloid leukemia (AML) and hematologic malignancies.

What is the significance of synthetic lethality in Ryvu's drug discovery process?

Synthetic lethality is a critical concept in Ryvu's drug discovery efforts, as it allows for the identification of therapeutic targets that can selectively kill cancer cells while sparing normal cells. By exploiting the unique genetic vulnerabilities of cancer cells, Ryvu aims to develop therapies that are both effective and have fewer side effects compared to traditional treatments. This approach is particularly valuable in treating cancers that are resistant to conventional therapies.

Can you explain the role of kinase inhibitors in Ryvu's pipeline?

Kinase inhibitors are a key component of Ryvu Therapeutics' pipeline. These small molecules are designed to inhibit specific kinases, which are enzymes that play a crucial role in signaling pathways that regulate cell growth and survival. By targeting these pathways, Ryvu's kinase inhibitors aim to disrupt the proliferation of cancer cells and induce apoptosis, making them a promising option for various oncology indications.

What industries does Ryvu Therapeutics collaborate with?

Ryvu Therapeutics collaborates with various industries, primarily within the biotechnology and pharmaceutical sectors. Their partnerships often involve academic institutions, research organizations, and other biotech companies focused on advancing cancer therapies. Through these collaborations, Ryvu seeks to enhance its research capabilities, share knowledge, and accelerate the development of innovative treatments for cancer patients.

What is the current status of Ryvu's clinical trials?

As a clinical-stage company, Ryvu Therapeutics is actively conducting clinical trials to evaluate the safety and efficacy of its drug candidates. The company regularly updates its clinical trial status on its website and through press releases. Interested parties can find information about ongoing trials, including study designs, eligibility criteria, and locations, by visiting the clinical trials section of Ryvu's website.

How does Ryvu Therapeutics ensure the quality and safety of its drug candidates?

Ryvu Therapeutics adheres to stringent regulatory standards and best practices in drug development to ensure the quality and safety of its candidates. This includes conducting preclinical studies to assess pharmacokinetics, toxicity, and efficacy, followed by rigorous clinical trials that comply with Good Clinical Practice (GCP) guidelines. Additionally, Ryvu collaborates with regulatory authorities to ensure that all necessary safety and efficacy data are collected and analyzed before seeking approval for its therapies.

Seit mehr als 130 Jahren forscht MSD an Arzneimitteln und Impfstoffen zur Bekämpfung der weltweit bedeutendsten Erkrankungen – mit der Mission, die Welt und das Leben von Menschen und Tieren zu verbessern. About Naval Postgraduate School
-------------------------------

The Naval Postgraduate School (NPS), located at 1 University Circle, Monterey, California, is a premier institution dedicated to providing defense-focused graduate education. Established to enhance the operational effectiveness and technological leadership of the Naval service, NPS offers a unique environment for interdisciplinary research and classified studies. The school’s curriculum is designed to equip military officers and civilian leaders with the advanced knowledge and skills necessary to address complex national security challenges.  
  
NPS stands out for its commitment to fostering innovation and developing a warfighting advantage through rigorous academic programs. The faculty comprises a distinguished group of experts in various fields, including engineering, cybersecurity, international relations, and operational research. For those interested in the academic credentials of the institution, a comprehensive Naval Postgraduate School teachers list showcases the diverse backgrounds and extensive experience of the educators who guide students through their studies.  
  
With a focus on real-world applications, NPS emphasizes collaboration with military and civilian agencies, ensuring that research and education are closely aligned with the needs of the defense community. The school’s state-of-the-art facilities and access to classified information provide a unique advantage for students engaged in cutting-edge research. By cultivating a culture of inquiry and innovation, the Naval Postgraduate School plays a vital role in shaping the future leaders of the Naval service and enhancing the United States' strategic capabilities. For more information, visit their official website at https://www.nps.edu.

His expertise in technical recruiting and college recruiting has been instrumental in building a diverse talent pipeline that aligns with the firm’s strategic goals. Matthew is particularly adept at leveraging data-driven insights to refine sourcing strategies, ensuring that EY remains competitive in a rapidly evolving job market.

His commitment to innovation and leadership in personnel management has earned him numerous accolades, solidifying his reputation as an award-winning recruitment leader. About Isabel Sandoval

Isabel Sandoval is a multi-talented filmmaker and actress known for her impactful work in the entertainment industry. As a trans woman of color, she has used her platform to shed light on important issues through her thought-provoking films and performances.  
  
Sandoval was born and raised in the Philippines and discovered her passion for filmmaking at a young age. She studied film and media at the University of San Francisco, where she honed her skills and developed her unique storytelling style. After graduating, she moved to New York City to pursue a career in the film industry, and it wasn't long before she made a name for herself as a talented and innovative filmmaker.  
  
One of Sandoval's most notable works is her film "Lingua Franca," which she wrote, directed, and starred in. The film follows the story of an undocumented trans Filipina immigrant living in Brooklyn and navigating the complexities of love, identity, and survival in a hostile environment. "Lingua Franca" has received critical acclaim for its emotional depth, authenticity, and powerful commentary on the immigrant experience. Sandoval's performance in the film has also been praised for its raw and compelling portrayal of a character facing immense challenges and discrimination.  
  
In addition to "Lingua Franca," Sandoval has directed and acted in several other films that have tackled important social issues and showcased her talent as a filmmaker. Her work often explores themes of identity, immigration, and the human experience, offering audiences a fresh perspective on complex and relevant topics.  
  
Sandoval's dedication to storytelling and advocacy has earned her recognition and praise within the industry and beyond. She has been a vocal advocate for trans representation in film and has used her platform to champion inclusivity and diversity in the entertainment industry. Her work has not only entertained audiences but has also sparked important conversations about the experiences of marginalized communities, and the power of art to drive social change.  
  
As a filmmaker and actress, Sandoval continues to push boundaries and challenge the status quo, creating impactful and thought-provoking work that resonates with audiences around the world. Through her compelling storytelling and powerful performances, she has established herself as a trailblazer in the industry and a fearless advocate for underrepresented voices.  
  
In addition to her work in film, Sandoval is also an accomplished writer and has contributed to various publications with her insightful commentary on LGBTQ+ issues and the importance of inclusive storytelling. She has used her voice to raise awareness and promote understanding, fostering a greater sense of empathy and compassion in her audiences.  
  
Overall, Isabel Sandoval is a true powerhouse in the entertainment industry, using her talent, creativity, and passion to create meaningful and impactful work. As a filmmaker, actress, and advocate, she continues to inspire and empower others, making a lasting impact on the industry and society as a whole. Her dedication to storytelling, representation, and social justice serves as a powerful example for aspiring artists and activists, and her work will undoubtedly continue to shape the cultural landscape for years to come.

The Equestrian, Secular and Chapterial Order of Saint Joachim was established on the 20th of June, 1755 by fourteen nobles and distinguished military leaders of the Holy Roman Empire. The Order continues today as an international order of knighthood dedicated to its founders' original principles.

About Pacific Pug Rescue
------------------------

Pacific Pug Rescue is a 501c3 nonprofit organization incorporated in 2006. We exist to rescue, rehabilitate and place unwanted, abandoned, neglected and abused Pugs and Pug mixes in permanent adoptive homes that have been carefully screened. We rescue Pugs from throughout Oregon, Idaho and Washington regardless of age or medical condition and are dedicated to providing for their short and long-term medical needs. Prior to adoption, Pug dogs are cared for in approved foster homes; they receive medical care and treatment, spaying or neutering, dental checks, vaccinations and microchips. We strive to educate the public about the Pug dog breed, including its personality, health issues and care, and about the importance of domestic animal population control.  
  
PPR is an all volunteer organization. We do not have a shelter facility. All rescued Pugs live with volunteer foster families while waiting to be adopted into caring forever homes.  
  
There is an adoption donation for each Pug to help pay for medical expenses. The adoption donation ranges from $150.00 to $550.00 depending on the age and condition of the Pug.  
  
We are always in need of foster homes! Do you have room in your heart and home for a rescued Pug? We are seeking additional foster homes to provide a loving and safe environment for Pugs in transition.

About Indian Institute Of Management Ahmedabad
----------------------------------------------

The Indian Institute of Management Ahmedabad (IIMA), established on December 11, 1961, stands as a beacon of excellence in management education in India. Located in Vastrapur, Ahmedabad, Gujarat, IIMA has consistently been recognized as the premier business school in the country, attracting top-tier students and faculty from around the globe. With a robust curriculum and a rigorous Post-Graduate Programme (PGP), IIMA has produced a remarkable alumni network, many of whom have ascended to leadership positions in various sectors, including finance, consulting, and social entrepreneurship. Notably, one-third of India's CEOs have their roots in IIMA, underscoring the institute's pivotal role in shaping the nation's business landscape.  
  
IIMA's accolades are numerous; it has consistently ranked among the top business schools in India and the Asia-Pacific region since the 1990s. The institute was the first in India to receive the EQUIS accreditation in 2008, further solidifying its global standing. In 2010, the Financial Times ranked its PGP eighth globally among Master's in Management programmes, and its Post-Graduate Programme for Executives (PGPX) was ranked 11th in 2011. This recognition is a testament to the quality of education and the exceptional faculty at IIMA, whose expertise is reflected in the comprehensive Indian Institute of Management Ahmedabad teachers list. With a commitment to fostering innovation and leadership, IIMA continues to be a transformative force in management education, equipping its graduates with the confidence and skills to excel in an ever-evolving global marketplace.

About Princeton Integrative Health
----------------------------------

Most people accept pain, stress, lack of energy, or inability to focus as normal. These are just realities of life that inevitably get worse as you age. When the problem becomes too much to bear, you see various “specialists” who treat each symptom separately with a different medication. This begins the endless, expensive cycle of chronic illness. Meanwhile, the root causes of these issues are left untreated, so you never really get better.  
That’s sick care, not health care. In a “sick care” model, doctors wait to take action until you’re ill. This is the model rewarded by most insurance companies.  
At Princeton Integrative Health, we believe in health care. Health care proactively prevents and reverses disease and dysfunction by attacking the cause of the problem. By treating you holistically and bringing your systems into balance, we can help you discover what it means to be truly well.

About US Pacific Command
------------------------

The United States Pacific Command (USPACOM) Area of Responsibility (AOR) encompasses about half the earth's surface, stretching from the waters off the west coast of the U.S. to the western border of India, and from Antarctica to the North Pole. There are few regions as culturally, socially, economically, and geo-politically diverse as the Asia-Pacific. The 36 nations that comprise the Asia-Pacific region are home to more than 50% of the world's population, three thousand different languages, several of the world's largest militaries, and five nations allied with the U.S. through mutual defense treaties.  
  
USPACOM is one of six geographic Unified Combatant Commands of the United States Armed Forces. Commander, U.S. Pacific Command (CDRUSPACOM) is the senior U.S. military authority in the Pacific Command AOR. CDRUSPACOM reports to the President of the United States through the Secretary of Defense and is supported by four component commands: U.S. Pacific Fleet, U.S. Pacific Air Forces, U.S. Army Pacific, and U.S. Marine Forces, Pacific. These commands are headquartered in Hawai'i and have forces stationed and deployed throughout the region.  
  
USPACOM recognizes the global significance of the Asia-Pacific region and understands that challenges are best met together. Consequently, USPACOM will remain an engaged and trusted partner committed to preserving the security, stability, and freedom upon which enduring prosperity in the Asia-Pacific region depends.

Health Choice Network (HCN) is a national model of a successful collaboration of community health centers (CHCs) and one of several HRSA-sponsored Health Center Controlled Networks.  
  
HCN is addressing health care disparities, providing health information technologies and strengthening the financial position of the community health care system. Founded in 1994 as a 501c(3) organization, HCN was created and is governed by its members who comprise a minority-based Board of Directors. Network members maintain their vital community orientation by retaining their local-governing, consumer-majority Boards of Directors.  
  
Community Health Centers that own and control the Network operate more efficiently, can deliver care more effectively and are working together to care for more patients.

About Wayside Technology Group
------------------------------

Wayside Technology Group is an international technology channel company that markets software, hardware and services – directly and through resellers – to software development and information technology professionals worldwide. The company, which is headquartered in Eatontown, New Jersey, was incorporated in 1982 and has been public since 1995 (NASDAQ:WSTG). Wayside Technology Group has the spirit of a Silicon Valley startup combined with the drive of an East Coast company. It’s a philosophy that has contributed to Wayside being named one of the Best Places to Work in New Jersey in 2017! Wayside operates through two segments – value added distributor Lifeboat Distribution and value added solutions provider TechXtend.Lifeboat Distribution is a distributor of software and appliances for virtualization, security, networking, application lifecycle management, and other technically sophisticated domains. Lifeboat helps vendor partners recruit multinational networks of resellers, value-added resellers, consultants, and systems integrators, and drive incremental sales revenues that complement the vendors’ existing sales channels. TechXtend (formerly Programmer’s Paradise) is a value added provider of software, hardware and technical services for information technology professionals in corporations, federal, state and local government agencies, and educational institutions across the United States and Canada.

About Pickup
------------

Filiale du groupe La Poste, Pickup est le leader de la livraison hors domicile en France avec ses 15 000 relais et ses 500 consignes. Les relais Pickup sont livrés quotidiennement par les transporteurs Colissimo, Chronopost et DPD France.

About Entrepreneurship Development Institute Of India
-----------------------------------------------------

The Entrepreneurship Development Institute of India (EDI), established in 1983, is a premier autonomous and not-for-profit institution located in Bhat, Gandhinagar, Gujarat. Sponsored by leading financial institutions such as IDBI Bank Ltd., IFCI Ltd., ICICI Bank Ltd., and the State Bank of India (SBI), EDI is dedicated to fostering entrepreneurship across India. With a sprawling campus on twenty-three acres of land provided by the Government of Gujarat, EDI has made significant strides in promoting entrepreneurial education and development.  
  
Over the years, EDI has successfully established twelve state-level exclusive entrepreneurship development centers and institutes, significantly enhancing the entrepreneurial ecosystem in the country. One of its notable achievements is the integration of entrepreneurship education into the curricula of numerous schools, colleges, science and technology institutions, and management schools across various states. This initiative has not only enriched academic programs but also inspired a new generation of entrepreneurs. Recognizing EDI’s expertise, the University Grants Commission appointed it as an expert agency to develop a comprehensive curriculum on entrepreneurship.  
  
EDI's commitment to entrepreneurship development has garnered recognition from the Government of India and various state governments. On an international scale, EDI has collaborated with esteemed organizations such as the World Bank, Commonwealth Secretariat, UNIDO, ILO, and the British Council, among others, to share resources and conduct training programs. This global outreach has further solidified EDI's reputation as a leading institution in entrepreneurship development. For those interested in the faculty and educators shaping the future of entrepreneurship at EDI, a detailed list of the Entrepreneurship Development Institute of India teachers can be found on their official website.

About Linkable Networks
-----------------------

Linkable Networks was founded on the premise that loyalty, not discounts or coupons, drives long-term growth for brands and retailers. Loyalty is what separates consumables from brands and consumers now expect the loyalty experience to be in context of them wherever and whenever they purchase.  
  
Since 2011, we’ve been nose-down building a scalable platform that provides brands and retailers the ability to engage, reward and incent their consumers directly and across any channel – online, mobile and in-store. We pioneered the concept of card-linked-offers and have taken it to the next level – always-on loyalty. Both our self-service and SaaS-based platforms enable the creation of actionable ads, coupons, offers, promotions, rebates and more that let you reward loyalty… not just discount a purchase.  
  
This is the future of Loyalty. And, it starts with a Link.

### Frequently Asked Questions about Linkable Networks

Who are the decision makers in Linkable Networks?

The decision makers in Linkable Networks are [Tom Burgess](https://contactout.com/Tom-Burgess-12080962)

.

What types of loyalty programs does Linkable Networks offer?

Linkable Networks specializes in creating direct-to-consumer loyalty programs that focus on building long-term relationships between brands and their customers. These programs are designed to enhance customer engagement and retention by leveraging digital coupons and personalized rewards, rather than traditional discount strategies. Our solutions allow brands to tailor their loyalty offerings to meet the specific needs and preferences of their target audience.

How does Linkable Networks' attributable media work?

Attributable media from Linkable Networks enables brands to track the effectiveness of their marketing campaigns in real-time. By integrating digital coupons with media placements, we provide insights into how advertising efforts translate into actual sales and customer engagement. This data-driven approach allows brands to optimize their marketing strategies and allocate resources more effectively, ensuring a higher return on investment.

Can Linkable Networks help retailers transition to paperless site-to-store solutions?

Yes, Linkable Networks offers innovative paperless site-to-store solutions that streamline the shopping experience for consumers. By utilizing digital coupons and mobile technology, we help retailers reduce reliance on physical coupons and enhance the efficiency of their operations. This transition not only minimizes waste but also provides customers with a seamless shopping experience, allowing them to redeem offers directly from their mobile devices.

What industries does Linkable Networks serve?

Linkable Networks serves a diverse range of industries, including retail, consumer packaged goods, and e-commerce. Our solutions are designed to meet the unique challenges faced by brands in these sectors, helping them to foster customer loyalty and drive sales. Whether you're a large retailer or a small brand, our services can be tailored to fit your specific needs and objectives.

How can brands measure the success of their loyalty programs with Linkable Networks?

Brands can measure the success of their loyalty programs through comprehensive analytics and reporting tools provided by Linkable Networks. Our platform tracks key performance indicators such as customer engagement rates, redemption rates of digital coupons, and overall sales growth attributed to loyalty initiatives. By analyzing this data, brands can gain valuable insights into customer behavior and make informed decisions to enhance their loyalty strategies.

What sets Linkable Networks apart from other loyalty program providers?

Linkable Networks distinguishes itself by focusing on loyalty as a driver of long-term growth rather than relying solely on discounts and coupons. Our innovative approach combines digital technology with a deep understanding of consumer behavior, allowing brands to create personalized loyalty experiences that resonate with their customers. Additionally, our emphasis on attributable media ensures that brands can track the impact of their marketing efforts, making our solutions both effective and measurable.

About A.M. Nomikos & Son (UK) Limited
-------------------------------------

A.M. Nomikos operates a commercial, corporate and ship management service for ship owning entities.  
The Company employs about 1,000 personnel worldwide, on land and sea based operations. The Head Office and central management is located in Athens with commercial activities situated in London.  
  
History  
A.M. Nomikos was established in Greece in 1958 by Anastasios Nomikos and his wife Angele Nomikos. The company was originally involved in coastal shipping and over the past 6 decades has grown into all main types of Dry Bulk vessels, with a principal focus on the Geared segment. Most recently the company has expanded capabilities in the management of Container ships.  
The company’s UK office was founded in 1983 and has developed into an entity that supports Sale and Purchase and traditional commercial services as well as offering innovative freight solutions. A Supramax pool, AMN Aquarius Inc, was established in 2015.  
  
Shipping Activities  
Ship management services include technical management, crew management, HSEQ management services (Health, Safety, Environment & Security services under ISM & ISPS), vessel OPEx accounting and procurement services.  
  
Commercial management includes the Sale and Purchase of vessels and the use of Period time-charter, FFAs and Freight Options to achieve optimal yield management. The Aquarius Pool aims to provide participants with a method to consolidate and align their commercial interests in the Supramax Dry Bulk sector.  
  
Corporate services include: company incorporation, administration and maintenance of records, bank account establishment, drafting corporate authorities & resolutions, share issues and KYC compliance requirements.  
  
Trading Policy  
The group has pursued a policy of promoting long term relationships with counterparties with an aim to develop an excellent reputation in the chartering market. This has enabled it to grow and develop strong, open and respectful relationships.  
  
A.M. Nomikos prides itself on its ability to achieve high operational standards, with the priority set on safety and environmental protection.

About Axis Bank
---------------

Axis Bank is the third largest private sector bank in India. The Bank offers the entire spectrum of financial services to customer segments covering Large and Mid-Corporates, MSME, Agriculture and Retail Businesses.  
  
The Bank has a large footprint of 4,903 domestic branches (including extension counters) with 15,953 ATMs & cash recyclers spread across the country as on 31st March 2023. The Bank has 6 Axis Virtual Centres with over 1,500 Virtual Relationship Managers as on 31st March 2023. The Overseas operations of the Bank are spread over eight international offices with branches in Singapore, Dubai (at DIFC), and Gift City-IBU; representative offices in Dhaka, Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Sharjah and an overseas subsidiary in London, UK. The international offices focus on Corporate Lending, Coverage Business, Trade Finance, Syndication, Investment Banking, Liability Businesses, and Private Banking/Wealth Management offerings.  
  
Axis Bank is one of the first new generation private sector banks to have begun operations in 1994. The Bank was promoted in 1993, jointly by Specified Undertaking of Unit Trust of India (SUUTI) (then known as Unit Trust of India), Life Insurance Corporation of India (LIC), General Insurance Corporation of India (GIC), National Insurance Company Ltd. (NIC), The New India Assurance Company Ltd. (NIA), The Oriental Insurance Company Ltd. (OIC), and United India Insurance Company Ltd. (UIIC). The shareholding of Unit Trust of India was subsequently transferred to SUUTI, an entity established in 2003. GIC, NIC, NIA, OIC, UIIC have been reclassified from promoter category to public category. As on March 31, 2023, SUUTI and LIC are the promoters of the Bank.  
  
With a balance sheet size of Rs. 13,17,326 crores as on 31st March 2023, Axis Bank has achieved consistent growth and with a 5-year CAGR (2017-18 to 2022-23) of 14% each in Total Assets & Advances and 16% in Deposits.

About Hacienda La Puente USD, Personnel Commission
--------------------------------------------------

Welcome to the Personnel Commission page for the Hacienda La Puente Unified School District (HLPUSD). The Personnel Commission and its staff work to establish policies, practices, and procedures serving classified employees at HLPUSD in the areas of classification and compensation, recruitment and assessment, training, and disciplinary hearings. The classified employees provide essential non-teaching services to students, teachers, and the public. If you are interested in being considered for a position as a classified employee, please visit our Job Seekers page to apply for current recruitments or register for future recruitments. We also encourage you to visit other parts of our website, which offer valuable information on test taking tips, employment benefits, our District and community, information about classified employment, and information about the merit system and its principles.  
  
  
  
Mission Statement  
  
The Personnel Commission is committed to providing professional, timely, efficient, and effective service in attracting and retaining the best-qualified employees based on demonstrated job-related merit and fitness for providing the District with a quality workforce that promotes a culture of teamwork, fairness and an environment dedicated to student success.

About Civica Rx
---------------

Civica, Inc. (Civica Rx) was created in late 2018 to secure the supply of important medicines hospitals use every day. As of Q3 2022, we have provided nearly 100 million vials of essential medicines to hospitals, enough to help treat close to 40 million patients.  
  
Recently, we announced we will manufacture and distribute affordable medications for consumers in an outpatient/retail setting, including affordable insulin beginning in 2024. Insulin is an exciting project as we are partnering with nearly every corner of the diabetes ecosystem, including payers, to bring low-cost insulin to people living with diabetes at no more than $30 a vial and no more than $55 for a pack of five pre-filled pens, regardless of insurance status.  
  
WHY CIVICA?  
Because patients should have the essential medicines they need when they need them. As a rapidly growing, entrepreneurial, nonprofit generic drug company our mission is to ensure quality generic medicines are accessible and affordable to everyone.

About Hello Vino, Inc
---------------------

Hello Vino is the authority in the mobile wine recommendation space. With an installed base of more than 2.5 million wine consumers, its influence extends beyond awareness to actual purchases in the on- and off-premise beverage sales environments. Hello Vino is in the unique position of influencing behavior during all stages of the buyer lifecycle, from awareness at point of purchase to trial, loyalty and advocacy. The Hello Vino platform bridges the gap between the digital and physical worlds - converting digital marketing efforts into both online and offline retail impact.  
  
At its core, the Hello Vino app recommends specific wines by meal selection, personal taste preferences and wine-buying occasions (holidays, events, etc.), delivering highly-relevant content to consumers while making their purchase decisions - the apex of contextual marketing.  
  
Hello Vino educates the next generation of wine consumers. Similar to how Wine Spectator and Wine Advocate influenced previous generations with wine ratings and articles, Hello Vino assists Millennial and Gen-X consumers who use smartphones and the Internet to research purchase decisions.  
  
Hello Vino offers mobile marketing programs to both retailers and brands, delivering contextually- and geographically-targeted messages to consumers based on personalized behavioral data.

About Woof Gang Bakery
----------------------

Woof Gang Bakery is North America’s leader in professional pet grooming, with more than 200 locations open or under development. Woof Gang also offers a unique retail experience, our gourmet bakery treats are made with love and we just offer the best quality pet food. Each location is a committed to the happiness, well-being and health of pets. And also, how they look!  
  
We are a fully franchised concept that leads the pack in unit growth. In 2022 alone, we are on track to open a record 40 new stores throughout the U.S. Our record growth is a direct result of the great and unique brand, increasing guest demand for our services and products, the passion of our franchisees and very strong business model. A Woof Gang Bakery store generates gross revenues of $657k\* in AUV and only requires a $215k\* capital investment, these economics are among the best in the pet franchisee industry.  
  
Want to join the pack and own your own Woof Gang Bakery?  
Visit https://woofgangfranchise.com/ to learn more.  
  
Woof Gang Bakery & Grooming was named a top 10 retailer by Pet Business Media and one of the nation’s fastest-growing pet chains by Pet Insight magazine. The company received the Retailer of the Year Franchise Award from Pet Product News, and Best Overall Multi-unit Retailer and Multiservice Excellence Award from Pet Business Media. Woof Gang Bakery was recognized as one of Central Florida’s fastest-growing and top privately held companies by Orlando Business Journal.  
  
\*Please refer to Franchise Disclosure Document for additional information regarding unit economics and capital requirements.

Red Rock Resorts, Inc. is a gaming, development and management company. The Company's segments include Las Vegas operations, Native American management, and Corporate and other. The Las Vegas operations segment includes all of its Las Vegas area casino properties and the Native American management segment includes its Native American management arrangements. It provides gaming and entertainment for residents of the Las Vegas regional market and visitors. Its Las Vegas portfolio includes approximately 10 gaming and entertainment facilities and over 10 smaller casinos, offering approximately 20, 300 slot machines, over 350 table games and approximately 4, 750 hotel rooms. The Company offers a range of gaming and non-gaming entertainment options. It also controls over seven gaming-entitled development sites consisting of approximately 398 acres in Las Vegas and Reno, Nevada. The Company manages and owns interest in Station Casinos LLC, which is the provider of gaming and entertainment.

About Draper Richards Kaplan Foundation
---------------------------------------

The Draper Richards Kaplan Foundation is a venture philanthropy firm supporting early stage, high impact social enterprises. We believe that with early funding and rigorous support, exceptional social entrepreneurs, tackling some of society’s most complex problems, can make the world a better place. We find, fund and support exceptional entrepreneurs with three years of unrestricted funding and partner with them to help them reach their full potential and build their organizations to scale.  
  
Since we started in 2002, we have invested in more than 90 social entrepreneurs both domestically and internationally in a variety of issue areas and we plan to scale our organization to support an additional 100 social entrepreneurs in the next five yeas. Our entrepreneurs are making lasting change in the world and our portfolio reflects some of the most impactful new organizations in the social sector.

Centerpoint Church was launched as “an alternative to church as usual.” Our heartbeat is to be a church where long-time followers of Jesus could grow in their faith and, simultaneously, people could investigate faith. So, for us “an alternative to church as usual” means: the safest place in the world for anybody struggling with anything; welcoming every person--from every background imaginable--and answering questions people are asking; serving the people in the community; and being all about Jesus. So, if you are a Jesus follower, we want to help you grow in your relationship with Jesus. And, if you are investigating the claims of Jesus, we want you to know that this is a safe place to do that. In fact, you can belong here before you ever believe.  
  
We are a movement on mission, in our city and in our world, to amplify the name of Jesus and to lead people to experience the love and grace He offers.

About OneMarket
---------------

OneMarket from LogicSource is a complete set of products and services created for procurement professionals, by the world’s foremost experts in procurement. All with one goal in mind: to help Sourcing and Procurement teams elevate their impact and visibility as true partners to business leaders.  
  
OneMarket is a simplified source-to-pay technology platform empowered with pre-built tools and templates, supported by market intelligence and price benchmarks and, as standard, enabled by expert resources to manage implementation and ongoing data hygiene.  
  
The platform consists of five integrated software modules that span the Source-to-Pay lifecycle:  
  
OneMarket Insights:  
Enables enriched supplier and spend data analytics for sourcing teams to scope new initiatives and manage compliance to sourcing outcomes and procurement policies.  
  
OneMarket Portfolio:  
Allows teams to track and manage sourcing performance, balance workload across resources and align with finance and business partners on savings recognition.  
  
OneMarket Sourcing:  
Automated sourcing workflows enabled with pre-built tools and templates that accelerate time-to-market and eliminate manual tasks and processes  
  
OneMarket Contracts:  
Enables digitization of all contract meta-data and consolidation to a single repository with advanced search capabilities, event notifications and ongoing data upload support  
  
OneMarket Procure-to-Pay:  
Offers buyer-hosted catalogs, tactical sourcing and rate-card capabilities to add value to transactional procurement and rich data reporting capabilities for Procurement and Finance teams.  
  
Not just software, but a new, cost-effective capability for sourcing and procurement teams to leverage purpose-built tools, access experienced and technically capable resources, and benefit from actionable market intelligence. OneMarket’s combination of capabilities is unique in the market and enables customers to elevate the profile and impact of Procurement at their organizations.

About Hazelden Betty Ford Foundation
------------------------------------

The Hazelden Betty Ford Foundation is the nation's largest nonprofit treatment provider, with a legacy that began in 1949 and includes the 1982 founding of the Betty Ford Center. With 17 sites in California, Minnesota, Oregon, Illinois, New York, Florida, Massachusetts, Colorado and Washington, the Foundation offers prevention and recovery solutions nationwide and across the entire continuum of care for youth and adults. The Foundation includes:  
  
• the nation's largest recovery publishing house  
• a fully-accredited graduate school of addiction studies  
• a dedicated addiction research center  
• intensive educational programs for medical students and professionals  
• community and school-based prevention programs and services  
• unique family and children’s programs  
• an influential institute for recovery advocacy and policy  
  
Diversity, Equity and Inclusion at the Hazelden Betty Ford Foundation  
  
Our collective ability to meet the challenges of today and thrive in the future is directly connected to having a diverse workforce, an inclusive culture, a strong presence in diverse communities, and the provision of culturally responsive care. To that end, in early 2019, the Hazelden Betty Ford Foundation embarked on a strategic and sustainable journey for change in procedures, decision-making processes and the allocation of resources.  
Learn more about what we are doing to affect long-term, sustainable change. https://www.hazeldenbettyford.org/about-us/diversity-equity-inclusion

About Danny Lloyd

Danny Lloyd is an American former child actor who made a remarkable splash in the realm of cinema with his unforgettable debut performance in Stanley Kubrick's chilling horror classic, "The Shining." Born on October 13, 1972, in Chicago, Illinois, Lloyd's natural talent and innate ability to captivate audiences at such a young age allowed him to become a household name overnight.  
  
At the tender age of five, Danny Lloyd was cast as the character of Danny Torrance, the young son of Jack Nicholson's character, in "The Shining." His performance as the telepathic boy who becomes haunted by supernatural forces in the haunted Overlook Hotel was nothing short of astonishing. Despite his age and limited acting experience, Lloyd was able to convey deep emotions, fear, and vulnerability with a maturity that defied his years.  
  
Lloyd's ability to perfectly embody the character of Danny Torrance became the heartbeat of "The Shining." He brought an uncanny level of authenticity to the role, drawing viewers into his world and making them fear for his safety. It was a performance that left a lasting impression on both audiences and critics alike, cementing Lloyd's status as one of the most talented child actors in the industry.  
  
In his portrayal of Danny Torrance, Lloyd skillfully navigated the complex emotions of a young boy experiencing supernatural phenomena. He convincingly portrayed the fear and confusion that comes with witnessing the unraveling of his father's sanity, as well as his own psychic abilities. Lloyd's innocent and cherubic face only magnified the impact of his performance, showing audiences a child caught in an adult nightmare.  
  
Following the enormous success of "The Shining," Lloyd's career took an unexpected turn. Despite receiving critical acclaim for his performance, he decided to step away from acting at the age of eight, leaving audiences clamoring for more of his mesmerizing presence on the screen. While his decision to leave the industry puzzled many, Lloyd chose to prioritize his education and lead a normal childhood, away from the spotlight and the pressures of fame.  
  
Since leaving acting, Lloyd has managed to keep a low profile, avoiding the glitz and glamor of Hollywood. After completing high school as a valedictorian, he pursued higher education and earned multiple degrees. Lloyd obtained a bachelor's degree in Biology from Elmhurst College and a master's degree in Biology Education from Missouri State University. Afterward, he taught biology at a community college and later became a professor of biology at a prestigious institution.  
  
Danny Lloyd's decision to leave acting and forge a career in academia has allowed him to live a private life away from the prying eyes of the media. While many child actors struggle to navigate the challenges of fame, Lloyd gracefully stepped away from the limelight and chose a path that prioritized his personal growth and education.  
  
Even though his acting career was short-lived, Danny Lloyd's legacy lives on in the annals of cinema history. His remarkable debut performance in "The Shining" showcased a talent far beyond his young years, captivating audiences and leaving an indelible mark on the genre. Though he may have chosen a different path, Lloyd's brilliance as a child actor remains an enduring testament to his innate talent and raw ability to captivate the hearts of millions.

About OnLive
------------

OnLive is building the future of cloud computing. The company was founded by Steve Perlman, noted entrepreneur and inventor who spent years in developing the technology before launching the OnLive Game Service in June 2010.  
  
The OnLive Game Service has operated since then with zero downtime, serving millions of users in the US and Europe. OnLive has proved that with our technology, high-end visual computing experiences can be successfully delivered to almost any device. Through the company’s proprietary technology, console-quality games can now be played instantly on Macs, PCs, Android tablets, and TVs — either with our MicroConsole, or on some TVs and connected devices that include our software.  
  
OnLive Desktop, named the #1 app of 2012 by Time Magazine, demonstrates that a remote desktop experience on a mobile device can feel local. OnLive is the leader in delivering graphics-rich interactive applications via the cloud for gaming and other industries.  
  
In August 2012 Lauder Partners acquired the assets of OnLive, Inc. to form a new company that is doing business as OnLive. The new OnLive is moving forward to build a robust, scalable, flexible platform to deliver cloud computing services on a massive scale.
